docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 9.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śubhāśubha-phalair evaṁ mokṣyase karma-bandhanaiḥ | sannyāsa-yoga-yuktātmā vimukto mām upaiṣyasi ||28||
śubhāśubha-phalaiḥ evam mokṣyase karma-bandhanaiḥ sannyāsa-yoga-yuktātmā vimuktaḥ mām upaiṣyasi
docs.text: Thus you shall be freed from the bonds of action that bear good and evil results. With the mind established in the yoga of renunciation, liberated, you shall come to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 9.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: samaḥ aham sarva-bhūteṣu na me dveṣyaḥ asti na priyaḥ ye bhajanti tu mām bhaktyā mayi te teṣu api aham
samo 'haṁ sarva-bhūteṣu na me dveṣyo 'sti na priyaḥ | ye bhajanti tu māṁ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpy aham ||29||
docs.text: I am equal to all beings; no one is hateful or dear to Me. But those who worship Me with devotion are in Me, and I am in them.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 9.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: api cet su-durācāraḥ bhajate mām ananya-bhāk sādhuḥ eva saḥ mantavyaḥ samyak vyavasitaḥ hi
api cet su-durācāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk | sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ ||30||
docs.text: Even if the most sinful person worships Me with exclusive devotion, he should be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 9.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kṣipram bhavati dharmātmā śaśvat śāntim nigacchati kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
kṣipraṁ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvac-chāntiṁ nigacchati | kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati ||31||
docs.text: Quickly he becomes a righteous soul and attains lasting peace. O son of Kunti, declare it boldly that My devotee never perishes.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 9.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mām hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye api syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ striyaḥ vaiśyāḥ tathā śūdrāḥ te api yānti parām gatim
māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye 'pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ | striyo vaiśyās tathā śūdrās te 'pi yānti parāṁ gatim ||32||
docs.text: For those who take refuge in Me, O Partha — even women, vaishyas, shudras, and those of sinful birth — they too attain the supreme goal.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 9.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kim punaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyāḥ bhaktāḥ rājarṣayaḥ tathā anityam asukham lokam imam prāpya bhajasva mām
kiṁ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayas tathā | anityam asukhaṁ lokam imaṁ prāpya bhajasva mām ||33||
docs.text: How much more then the holy brahmanas and devoted royal sages! Having come to this impermanent, joyless world, worship Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 9.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru | mām evaiṣyasi yuktvaivaṁ ātmānaṁ mat-parāyaṇaḥ ||34||
mat-manāḥ bhava mad-bhaktaḥ mad-yājī mām namaskuru mām eva eṣyasi yuktvā evam ātmānam mat-parāyaṇaḥ
docs.text: Fix your mind on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. Having thus united yourself with Me, taking Me as the supreme goal, you shall come to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 9.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca bhūyaḥ eva mahā-bāho śṛṇu me paramam vacaḥ yat te aham prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hita-kāmyayā
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | bhūya eva mahā-bāho śṛṇu me paramaṁ vacaḥ | yat te'haṁ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hita-kāmyayā ||1||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: Again, O mighty-armed one, hear My supreme word, which I shall declare to you who are beloved, for your benefit.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavam maharṣayaḥ aham ādiḥ hi devānām maharṣīṇām sarvaśaḥ
na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavaṁ na maharṣayaḥ | aham ādir hi devānāṁ maharṣīṇāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ||2||
docs.text: Neither the hosts of devas nor the great sages know My origin, for I am the source of the devas and the great sages in every way.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yaḥ mām ajam anādim vetti loka-maheśvaram asammūḍhaḥ saḥ martyeṣu sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate
yo mām ajam anādiṁ ca vetti loka-maheśvaram | asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||3||
docs.text: He who knows Me as unborn, beginningless, and the great Lord of the worlds — he among mortals is undeluded and freed from all sins.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: buddhir jñānam asammohaḥ kṣamā satyaṁ damaḥ śamaḥ | sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ bhavo'bhāvo bhayaṁ cābhayam eva ca ||4|| ahiṁsā samatā tuṣṭis tapo dānaṁ yaśo'yaśaḥ | bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṁ matta eva pṛthag-vidhāḥ ||5||
buddhiḥ jñānam asammohaḥ kṣamā satyam damaḥ śamaḥ sukham duḥkham bhavaḥ abhāvaḥ bhayam abhayam ahiṁsā samatā tuṣṭiḥ tapaḥ dānam yaśaḥ ayaśaḥ bhavanti bhāvāḥ bhūtānām mattaḥ
docs.text: Intelligence, knowledge, freedom from delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-control, calmness, pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear, fearlessness, non-violence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, fame, infamy — all these various qualities of beings arise from Me alone.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāraḥ manavaḥ tathā mad-bhāvāḥ mānasāḥ jātāḥ yeṣām loke imāḥ prajāḥ
maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavas tathā | mad-bhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṁ loka imāḥ prajāḥ ||6||
docs.text: The seven great sages, the four ancient Manus, and all beings in the world are born from My mind.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: etām vibhūtim yogam mama yaḥ vetti tattvataḥ saḥ avikampena yogena yujyate na atra saṁśayaḥ
etāṁ vibhūtiṁ yogaṁ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ | so'vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṁśayaḥ ||7||
docs.text: He who truly knows this glory and power of Mine is endowed with unwavering yoga — of this there is no doubt.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aham sarvasya prabhavaḥ mattaḥ sarvam pravartate iti matvā bhajante mām budhāḥ bhāva-samanvitāḥ
ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate | iti matvā bhajante māṁ budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ ||8||
docs.text: I am the source of everything; from Me all creation emerges. Knowing this, the wise worship Me, endowed with deep feeling.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mac-cittā mad-gata-prāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam | kathayantaś ca māṁ nityaṁ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca ||9||
mac-cittāḥ mad-gata-prāṇāḥ bodhayantaḥ parasparam kathayantaḥ mām nityam tuṣyanti ramanti
docs.text: With their minds fixed on Me, their lives surrendered to Me, enlightening one another, always speaking of Me, they are content and delighted.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: teṣām satata-yuktānām bhajatām prīti-pūrvakam dadāmi buddhi-yogam tam yena mām upayānti te
teṣāṁ satata-yuktānāṁ bhajatāṁ prīti-pūrvakam | dadāmi buddhi-yogaṁ taṁ yena mām upayānti te ||10||
docs.text: To those who are constantly united and who worship Me with love, I give the yoga of understanding (buddhi-yoga) by which they come to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: teṣām eva anukampārtham aham ajñāna-jam tamaḥ nāśayāmi ātma-bhāva-sthaḥ jñāna-dīpena bhāsvatā
teṣām evānukampārtham aham ajñāna-jaṁ tamaḥ | nāśayāmy ātma-bhāva-stho jñāna-dīpena bhāsvatā ||11||
docs.text: Out of compassion for them, I, dwelling in their hearts, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the shining lamp of knowledge.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca param brahma param dhāma pavitram paramam bhavān puruṣam śāśvatam divyam ādi-devam ajam vibhum
arjuna uvāca | paraṁ brahma paraṁ dhāma pavitraṁ paramaṁ bhavān | puruṣaṁ śāśvataṁ divyam ādi-devam ajaṁ vibhum ||12||
docs.text: Arjuna said: You are the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier, the eternal divine Person, the primal God, unborn and all-pervading.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: āhus tvām ṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣir nāradas tathā | asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṁ caiva bravīṣi me ||13||
āhuḥ tvām ṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣiḥ nāradaḥ tathā asitaḥ devalaḥ vyāsaḥ svayam ca eva bravīṣi me
docs.text: All the sages declare this of You, as does the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, Vyasa — and now You Yourself tell me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarvam etad ṛtaṁ manye yan māṁ vadasi keśava | na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṁ vidur devā na dānavāḥ ||14||
sarvam etat ṛtam manye yat mām vadasi keśava na hi te bhagavan vyaktim viduḥ devāḥ dānavāḥ
docs.text: I hold all that You have told me to be true, O Keshava. Indeed, O Lord, neither the devas nor the danavas know Your manifestation.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: svayam eva ātmanā ātmānam vettha tvam puruṣottama bhūta-bhāvana bhūteśa deva-deva jagat-pate
svayam evātmanātmānaṁ vettha tvaṁ puruṣottama | bhūta-bhāvana bhūteśa deva-deva jagat-pate ||15||
docs.text: You alone know Yourself by Your own Self, O Supreme Person, O Source of beings, O Lord of beings, O God of gods, O Ruler of the world.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vaktum arhasi aśeṣeṇa divyāḥ hi ātma-vibhūtayaḥ yābhiḥ vibhūtibhiḥ lokān imān tvam vyāpya tiṣṭhasi
vaktum arhasy aśeṣeṇa divyā hy ātma-vibhūtayaḥ | yābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṁs tvaṁ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi ||16||
docs.text: Please tell me in detail Your divine glories by which You pervade all these worlds and abide in them.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: katham vidyām aham yogin tvām sadā paricintayan keṣu keṣu bhāveṣu cintyaḥ asi bhagavan mayā
kathaṁ vidyām ahaṁ yogiṁs tvāṁ sadā paricintayan | keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo 'si bhagavan mayā ||17||
docs.text: How shall I know You, O Yogin, by constant meditation? In what various aspects are You to be thought of by me, O Lord?
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vistareṇa ātmanaḥ yogam vibhūtim ca janārdana bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptiḥ hi śṛṇvataḥ na asti me amṛtam
vistareṇātmano yogaṁ vibhūtiṁ ca janārdana | bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptir hi śṛṇvato nāsti me 'mṛtam ||18||
docs.text: Tell me again in detail, O Janardana, of Your yoga power and glories, for I am never satiated hearing Your nectar-like words.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyāḥ hi ātma-vibhūtayaḥ prādhānyataḥ kuru-śreṣṭha na asti antaḥ vistarasya me
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hy ātma-vibhūtayaḥ | prādhānyataḥ kuru-śreṣṭha nāsty anto vistarasya me ||19||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: Very well, I shall tell you My divine glories — but only the chief ones, O best of the Kurus, for there is no end to My expanse.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aham ātmā guḍākeśa sarva-bhūtāśaya-sthitaḥ aham ādiḥ ca madhyam ca bhūtānām antaḥ eva ca
aham ātmā guḍākeśa sarva-bhūtāśaya-sthitaḥ | aham ādiś ca madhyaṁ ca bhūtānām anta eva ca ||20||
docs.text: I am the Self, O Gudakesha, seated in the hearts of all beings. I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ādityānām aham viṣṇuḥ jyotiṣām raviḥ aṁśumān marīciḥ marutām asmi nakṣatrāṇām aham śaśī
ādityānām ahaṁ viṣṇur jyotiṣāṁ ravir aṁśumān | marīcir marutām asmi nakṣatrāṇām ahaṁ śaśī ||21||
docs.text: Of the Adityas, I am Vishnu; of lights, the radiant sun; of the Maruts, I am Marichi; among the stars, I am the moon.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vedānām sāma-vedaḥ asmi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ indriyāṇām manaḥ ca asmi bhūtānām asmi cetanā
vedānāṁ sāma-vedo 'smi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ | indriyāṇāṁ manaś cāsmi bhūtānām asmi cetanā ||22||
docs.text: Of the Vedas, I am the Sama Veda; of the devas, I am Vasava (Indra); of the senses, I am the mind; in beings, I am consciousness.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: rudrāṇām śaṅkaraḥ ca asmi vitteśaḥ yakṣa-rakṣasām vasūnām pāvakaḥ ca asmi meruḥ śikhariṇām aham
rudrāṇāṁ śaṅkaraś cāsmi vitteśo yakṣa-rakṣasām | vasūnāṁ pāvakaś cāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇām aham ||23||
docs.text: Of the Rudras, I am Shankara; of the Yakshas and Rakshasas, I am Kubera; of the Vasus, I am Agni; of the mountains, I am Meru.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: purodhasām ca mukhyam mām viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim senānīnām aham skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ
purodhasāṁ ca mukhyaṁ māṁ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim | senānīnām ahaṁ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ ||24||
docs.text: Of priests, know Me to be the chief, Brihaspati, O Partha. Of commanders, I am Skanda; of water bodies, I am the ocean.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: maharṣīṇām bhṛguḥ aham girām asmi ekam akṣaram yajñānām japa-yajñaḥ asmi sthāvarāṇām himālayaḥ
maharṣīṇāṁ bhṛgur ahaṁ girām asmy ekam akṣaram | yajñānāṁ japa-yajño 'smi sthāvarāṇāṁ himālayaḥ ||25||
docs.text: Of the great sages, I am Bhrigu; of words, I am the single syllable Om; of sacrifices, I am japa (silent repetition); of immovable things, I am the Himalayas.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aśvatthaḥ sarva-vṛkṣāṇām devarṣīṇām ca nāradaḥ gandharvāṇām citrarathaḥ siddhānām kapilaḥ muniḥ
aśvatthaḥ sarva-vṛkṣāṇāṁ devarṣīṇāṁ ca nāradaḥ | gandharvāṇāṁ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṁ kapilo muniḥ ||26||
docs.text: Of all trees, I am the Ashvattha (sacred fig tree); of the divine sages, I am Narada; of the Gandharvas, I am Chitraratha; of the perfected beings, I am the sage Kapila.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: uccaiḥśravasam aśvānām viddhi mām amṛtodbhavam airāvatam gajendrāṇām narāṇām ca narādhipam
uccaiḥśravasam aśvānāṁ viddhi mām amṛtodbhavam | airāvataṁ gajendrāṇāṁ narāṇāṁ ca narādhipam ||27||
docs.text: Of horses, know Me as Ucchaihshravas, born of nectar; of lordly elephants, Airavata; and among men, the monarch.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: āyudhānām aham vajram dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk prajanaḥ ca asmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ
āyudhānām ahaṁ vajraṁ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk | prajanaś cāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ ||28||
docs.text: Of weapons, I am the thunderbolt; of cows, I am Kamadhuk (the wish-fulfilling cow). I am Kandarpa (the god of love) the cause of offspring; of serpents, I am Vasuki.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: anantaś cāsmi nāgānāṁ varuṇo yādasām aham | pitṝṇām aryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṁyamatām aham ||29||
anantaḥ ca asmi nāgānām varuṇaḥ yādasām aham pitṝṇām aryamā yamaḥ saṁyamatām
docs.text: Of the Nagas, I am Ananta; of the water beings, I am Varuna. Of the ancestors, I am Aryaman; of the regulators, I am Yama.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: prahlādaś cāsmi daityānāṁ kālaḥ kalayatām aham | mṛgāṇāṁ ca mṛgendro'haṁ vainateyaś ca pakṣiṇām ||30||
prahlādaḥ ca asmi daityānām kālaḥ kalayatām aham mṛgāṇām mṛgendraḥ aham vainateyaḥ pakṣiṇām
docs.text: Of the Daityas, I am Prahlada; of reckoners, I am time. Of beasts, I am the lion; and of birds, I am Garuda.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śastra-bhṛtām aham jhaṣāṇām makaraḥ ca srotasām jāhnavī
pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śastra-bhṛtām aham | jhaṣāṇāṁ makaraś cāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī ||31||
docs.text: Of purifiers, I am the wind; of warriors, I am Rama. Of fishes, I am the shark; of rivers, I am the Ganges.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sargāṇām ādir antaś ca madhyaṁ caivāham arjuna | adhyātma-vidyā vidyānāṁ vādaḥ pravadatām aham ||32||
sargāṇām ādiḥ antaḥ ca madhyam ca eva aham arjuna adhyātma-vidyā vidyānām vādaḥ pravadatām
docs.text: Of all creations, I am the beginning, the end, and the middle, O Arjuna. Of all sciences, I am the science of the Self. Of debaters, I am the logic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: akṣarāṇām akāraḥ asmi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca aham eva akṣayaḥ kālaḥ dhātā aham viśvato-mukhaḥ
akṣarāṇām akāro'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca | aham evākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṁ viśvato-mukhaḥ ||33||
docs.text: Of letters, I am the letter A; of compound words, I am the dvandva. I am indeed the inexhaustible time; I am the creator facing everywhere.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mṛtyuḥ sarva-haraś cāham udbhavaś ca bhaviṣyatām | kīrtiḥ śrīr vāk ca nārīṇāṁ smṛtir medhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā ||34||
mṛtyuḥ sarva-haraḥ ca aham udbhavaḥ bhaviṣyatām kīrtiḥ śrīḥ vāk nārīṇām smṛtiḥ medhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
docs.text: I am all-devouring death, and I am the origin of things yet to be. Among feminine qualities, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, steadfastness, and patience.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: bṛhat-sāma tathā sāmnām gāyatrī chandasām aham māsānām mārgaśīrṣaḥ aham ṛtūnām kusumākaraḥ
bṛhat-sāma tathā sāmnāṁ gāyatrī chandasām aham | māsānāṁ mārgaśīrṣo'ham ṛtūnāṁ kusumākaraḥ ||35||
docs.text: Of hymns, I am the Brihat-sama; of meters, I am Gayatri. Of months, I am Margashirsha; of seasons, I am the flower-bearing spring.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.35

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: dyūtam chalayatām asmi tejaḥ tejasvinām aham jayaḥ asmi vyavasāyaḥ asmi sattvam sattvavatām aham
dyūtaṁ chalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham | jayo'smi vyavasāyo'smi sattvaṁ sattvavatām aham ||36||
docs.text: Of cheats, I am gambling; I am the splendor of the splendid. I am victory, I am determination, and I am the goodness of the good.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.36

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vṛṣṇīnām vāsudevaḥ asmi pāṇḍavānām dhanañjayaḥ munīnām api aham vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśanā kaviḥ
vṛṣṇīnāṁ vāsudevo'smi pāṇḍavānāṁ dhanañjayaḥ | munīnām apy ahaṁ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśanā kaviḥ ||37||
docs.text: Of the Vrishnis, I am Vasudeva (Krishna); of the Pandavas, I am Dhananjaya (Arjuna). Of the sages, I am Vyasa; of the poets, I am Ushana (Shukracharya).
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.37

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: daṇḍaḥ damayatām asmi nītiḥ jigīṣatām maunam ca eva guhyānām jñānam jñānavatām aham
daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣatām | maunaṁ caivāsmi guhyānāṁ jñānaṁ jñānavatām aham ||38||
docs.text: Of punishers, I am the rod of punishment; of those who seek victory, I am statesmanship. Of secrets, I am silence; of the wise, I am wisdom.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.38

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yac cāpi sarva-bhūtānāṁ bījaṁ tad aham arjuna | na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṁ carācaram ||39||
yat ca api sarva-bhūtānām bījam tat aham arjuna na tat asti vinā mayā bhūtam carācaram
docs.text: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that I am, O Arjuna. There is no being, moving or unmoving, that can exist without Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.39

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na antaḥ asti mama divyānām vibhūtīnām parantapa eṣaḥ tu uddeśataḥ proktaḥ vibhūteḥ vistaraḥ mayā
nānto'sti mama divyānāṁ vibhūtīnāṁ parantapa | eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā ||40||
docs.text: There is no end to My divine glories, O Parantapa. What I have declared is only a brief indication of the extent of My glories.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.40

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śrīmad ūrjitam eva vā | tat tad evāvagaccha tvaṁ mama tejo'ṁśa-sambhavam ||41||
yat yat vibhūtimat sattvam śrīmat ūrjitam eva vā tat tat eva avagaccha tvam mama tejaḥ aṁśa sambhavam
docs.text: Whatever being is glorious, prosperous, or powerful — know that to be a manifestation of a fraction of My splendor.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.41

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: athavā bahunaitena kiṁ jñātena tavārjuna | viṣṭabhyāham idaṁ kṛtsnam ekāṁśena sthito jagat ||42||
athavā bahunā etena kim jñātena tava arjuna viṣṭabhya aham idam kṛtsnam ekāṁśena sthitaḥ jagat
docs.text: But what need is there, Arjuna, for all this detailed knowledge? With a single fragment of Myself, I pervade and support this entire universe.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 10.42

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca | mad-anugrahāya paramaṁ guhyam adhyātma-saṁjñitam | yat tvayoktaṁ vacas tena moho'yaṁ vigato mama ||1||
mad-anugrahāya paramam guhyam adhyātma-saṁjñitam yat tvayā uktam vacaḥ tena mohaḥ ayam vigataḥ mama
docs.text: Arjuna said: By the supreme secret concerning the Self, which You have spoken out of compassion for me, this delusion of mine is removed.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: bhavāpyayau bhūtānām śrutau vistaraśaḥ mayā tvattaḥ kamala-patrākṣa māhātmyam avyayam
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṁ śrutau vistaraśo mayā | tvattaḥ kamala-patrākṣa māhātmyam api cāvyayam ||2||
docs.text: The origin and dissolution of beings have been heard by me in detail from You, O lotus-eyed one, and also Your imperishable glory.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṁ parameśvara | draṣṭum icchāmi te rūpam aiśvaraṁ puruṣottama ||3||
evam yathā āttha ātmānam parameśvara draṣṭum icchāmi te rūpam aiśvaram puruṣottama
docs.text: O Supreme Lord, as You have described Yourself, O Supreme Person, I wish to see Your divine form.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: manyase yadi tac chakyaṁ mayā draṣṭum iti prabho | yogeśvara tato me tvaṁ darśayātmānam avyayam ||4||
manyase yadi śakyam mayā draṣṭum prabho yogeśvara darśaya ātmānam avyayam
docs.text: If You think it is possible for me to see it, O Lord, O Lord of Yoga, then show me Your imperishable Self.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśaḥ sahasraśaḥ nānā-vidhāni divyāni nānā-varṇākṛtīni
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ | nānā-vidhāni divyāni nānā-varṇākṛtīni ca ||5||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: Behold, O Partha, My forms by the hundreds and thousands, of many kinds, divine, of many colors and shapes.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: paśyādityān vasūn rudrān aśvinau marutas tathā | bahūny adṛṣṭa-pūrvāṇi paśyāścaryāṇi bhārata ||6||
ādityān vasūn rudrān aśvinau marutaḥ bahūni adṛṣṭa-pūrvāṇi āścaryāṇi bhārata
docs.text: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Ashvins, and the Maruts. Behold many wonders never seen before, O Bharata.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: iha eka-stham jagat kṛtsnam sa-carācaram mama dehe guḍākeśa anyat draṣṭum icchasi
ihaika-sthaṁ jagat kṛtsnaṁ paśyādya sa-carācaram | mama dehe guḍākeśa yac cānyad draṣṭum icchasi ||7||
docs.text: Behold now the entire universe, with all things moving and non-moving, standing together in one place in My body, O Gudakesha, and whatever else you wish to see.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na tu māṁ śakyase draṣṭum anenaiva sva-cakṣuṣā | divyaṁ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogam aiśvaram ||8||
na śakyase draṣṭum sva-cakṣuṣā divyam dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya yogam aiśvaram
docs.text: But you cannot see Me with your own eyes. I give you divine eyes. Behold My supreme yogic power.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sañjaya uvāca | evam uktvā tato rājan mahā-yogeśvaro hariḥ | darśayām āsa pārthāya paramaṁ rūpam aiśvaram ||9||
sañjayaḥ uvāca rājan mahā-yogeśvaraḥ hariḥ darśayām āsa pārthāya paramam rūpam aiśvaram
docs.text: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus, O King, the great Lord of Yoga, Hari, then showed Arjuna His supreme divine form.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aneka vaktra nayanam adbhuta darśanam divya ābharaṇam udyata āyudham
aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekādbhuta-darśanam | aneka-divyābharaṇaṁ divyānekodyatāyudham ||10||
docs.text: With many mouths and eyes, with many wondrous sights, with many divine ornaments, with many divine weapons uplifted.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: divya mālya ambara dharam gandha anulepanam sarvāścaryamayam anantam viśvato-mukham
divya-mālyāmbara-dharaṁ divya-gandhānulepanam | sarvāścaryamayaṁ devam anantaṁ viśvato-mukham ||11||
docs.text: Wearing divine garlands and garments, anointed with divine fragrances, all-wonderful, resplendent, infinite, with faces everywhere.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: divi sūrya sahasrasya yugapat utthitā bhāḥ sadṛśī bhāsaḥ mahātmanaḥ
divi sūrya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā | yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ ||12||
docs.text: If a thousand suns were to rise simultaneously in the sky, that splendor might resemble the radiance of that great soul.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tatra eka-stham jagat kṛtsnam pravibhaktam anekadhā deva-devasya śarīre pāṇḍavaḥ
tatraika-sthaṁ jagat kṛtsnaṁ pravibhaktam anekadhā | apaśyad deva-devasya śarīre pāṇḍavas tadā ||13||
docs.text: Then Arjuna saw the entire universe, divided into many parts, all standing together in one place in the body of the God of gods.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭa-romā dhanañjayaḥ | praṇamya śirasā devaṁ kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata ||14||
vismayāviṣṭaḥ hṛṣṭa-romā dhanañjayaḥ praṇamya śirasā devam kṛtāñjaliḥ abhāṣata
docs.text: Then, filled with wonder, his hair standing on end, Dhananjaya bowed his head before the Lord, and with folded hands spoke.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca | paśyāmi devāṁs tava deva dehe sarvāṁs tathā bhūta-viśeṣa-saṅghān | brahmāṇam īśaṁ kamalāsana-stham ṛṣīṁś ca sarvān uragāṁś ca divyān ||15||
paśyāmi devān tava dehe bhūta-viśeṣa-saṅghān brahmāṇam kamalāsana-stham ṛṣīn uragān divyān
docs.text: Arjuna said: O Lord, I see all the gods in Your body, and also multitudes of all kinds of beings — Brahma the Lord seated on a lotus, all the sages, and the divine serpents.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aneka bāhu udara vaktra netram ananta-rūpam na antam na madhyam na ādim viśveśvara viśva-rūpa
aneka-bāhūdara-vaktra-netraṁ paśyāmi tvāṁ sarvato'nanta-rūpam | nāntaṁ na madhyaṁ na punas tavādiṁ paśyāmi viśveśvara viśva-rūpa ||16||
docs.text: I see You with many arms, bellies, mouths, and eyes, infinite in form on every side. I see no end, no middle, and no beginning in You, O Lord of the Universe, O Universal Form.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kirīṭinam gadinam cakriṇam tejo-rāśim dīptimantam durnirīkṣyam dīptānalārka-dyutim aprameyam
kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ cakriṇaṁ ca tejo-rāśiṁ sarvato dīptimantam | paśyāmi tvāṁ durnirīkṣyaṁ samantād dīptānalārka-dyutim aprameyam ||17||
docs.text: I see You wearing a crown, bearing a mace and discus, a mass of radiance shining everywhere, difficult to look at on all sides, blazing like fire and the sun, immeasurable.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tvam akṣaram paramam veditavyam viśvasya nidhānam avyayaḥ śāśvata-dharma-goptā sanātanaḥ puruṣaḥ mataḥ me
tvam akṣaraṁ paramaṁ veditavyaṁ tvam asya viśvasya paraṁ nidhānam | tvam avyayaḥ śāśvata-dharma-goptā sanātanas tvaṁ puruṣo mato me ||18||
docs.text: You are the imperishable, the supreme to be known. You are the ultimate resting place of this universe. You are the imperishable protector of eternal dharma. You are the eternal Supreme Person — this is my conviction.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: anādi madhya antam ananta-vīryam ananta-bāhum śaśi-sūrya-netram dīpta-hutāśa-vaktram sva-tejasā viśvam tapantam
anādi-madhyāntam ananta-vīryam ananta-bāhuṁ śaśi-sūrya-netram | paśyāmi tvāṁ dīpta-hutāśa-vaktraṁ sva-tejasā viśvam idaṁ tapantam ||19||
docs.text: I see You without beginning, middle, or end, with infinite power, infinite arms, the sun and moon as Your eyes, Your mouth a blazing fire, scorching the entire universe with Your radiance.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: dyāvā-pṛthivyor idam antaraṁ hi vyāptaṁ tvayaikena diśaś ca sarvāḥ | dṛṣṭvādbhutaṁ rūpam ugraṁ tavedaṁ loka-trayaṁ pravyathitaṁ mahātman ||20||
dyāvā-pṛthivyoḥ antaram vyāptam tvayā ekena diśaḥ sarvāḥ rūpam ugram loka-trayam pravyathitam
docs.text: The space between heaven and earth, and all the directions, are pervaded by You alone. Seeing this wondrous and terrible form of Yours, the three worlds tremble, O great soul.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: amī hi tvāṁ sura-saṅghā viśanti kecid bhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti | svastīty uktvā maharṣi-siddha-saṅghāḥ stuvanti tvāṁ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ ||21||
sura-saṅghāḥ viśanti bhītāḥ prāñjalayaḥ gṛṇanti svasti maharṣi-siddha-saṅghāḥ stuvanti stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
docs.text: Hosts of gods are entering You; some, afraid, pray with folded hands. Hosts of great sages and perfected beings cry 'May all be well!' and praise You with abundant hymns.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā viśve'śvinau marutaś coṣmapāś ca | gandharva-yakṣāsura-siddha-saṅghā vīkṣante tvāṁ vismitāś caiva sarve ||22||
rudrādityāḥ vasavaḥ sādhyāḥ viśve aśvinau marutaḥ gandharva yakṣa asura siddha vismitāḥ sarve
docs.text: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, Vishvedevas, Ashvins, Maruts, ancestors, Gandharvas, Yakshas, Asuras, and Siddhas — all gaze upon You in astonishment.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: rūpam mahat bahu-vaktra-netram bahu-bāhūru-pādam bahūdaram bahu-daṁṣṭrā-karālam lokāḥ pravyathitāḥ tathā aham
rūpaṁ mahat te bahu-vaktra-netraṁ mahā-bāho bahu-bāhūru-pādam | bahūdaraṁ bahu-daṁṣṭrā-karālaṁ dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitās tathāham ||23||
docs.text: Seeing Your great form with many mouths and eyes, many arms, thighs, and feet, many bellies, and many terrible fangs — the worlds tremble, and so do I.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: nabhaḥ-spṛśam dīptam aneka-varṇam vyāttānanam dīpta-viśāla-netram pravyathitāntarātmā dhṛtim na vindāmi śamam viṣṇo
nabhaḥ-spṛśaṁ dīptam aneka-varṇaṁ vyāttānanaṁ dīpta-viśāla-netram | dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṁ pravyathitāntarātmā dhṛtiṁ na vindāmi śamaṁ ca viṣṇo ||24||
docs.text: Seeing You touching the sky, blazing, many-colored, with open mouths and blazing wide eyes — my inner self trembles. I find neither courage nor peace, O Vishnu.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: daṁṣṭrā-karālāni ca te mukhāni dṛṣṭvaiva kālānala-sannibhāni | diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma prasīda deveśa jagan-nivāsa ||25||
daṁṣṭrā-karālāni mukhāni kālānala-sannibhāni diśaḥ na jāne śarma na labhe prasīda deveśa jagan-nivāsa
docs.text: Seeing Your mouths terrible with fangs, resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution — I lose my sense of direction and find no comfort. Be gracious, O Lord of lords, O refuge of the universe.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: amī ca tvāṁ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ sarve sahaivāvani-pāla-saṅghaiḥ | bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūta-putras tathāsau sahāsmadīyair api yodha-mukhyaiḥ ||26||
dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ sarve avani-pāla-saṅghaiḥ bhīṣmaḥ droṇaḥ sūta-putraḥ asmadīyaiḥ yodha-mukhyaiḥ
docs.text: All the sons of Dhritarashtra, along with hosts of kings, Bhishma, Drona, and Karna, together with the chief warriors on our side also —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti daṁṣṭrā-karālāni bhayānakāni | kecid vilagnā daśanāntareṣu sandṛśyante cūrṇitair uttamāṅgaiḥ ||27||
vaktrāṇi tvaramāṇāḥ viśanti daṁṣṭrā-karālāni bhayānakāni vilagnāḥ daśanāntareṣu cūrṇitaiḥ uttamāṅgaiḥ
docs.text: They rush into Your terrible mouths with frightening fangs. Some are seen stuck between Your teeth with their heads crushed.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yathā nadīnām ambu-vegāḥ samudram abhimukhāḥ dravanti nara-loka-vīrāḥ vaktrāṇi abhivijvalanti
yathā nadīnāṁ bahavo'mbu-vegāḥ samudram evābhimukhā dravanti | tathā tavāmī nara-loka-vīrā viśanti vaktrāṇy abhivijvalanti ||28||
docs.text: As many torrents of rivers flow toward the ocean, so do these heroes of the human world enter Your blazing mouths.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yathā pradīptam jvalanam pataṅgāḥ viśanti nāśāya samṛddha-vegāḥ lokāḥ
yathā pradīptaṁ jvalanaṁ pataṅgā viśanti nāśāya samṛddha-vegāḥ | tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokās tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddha-vegāḥ ||29||
docs.text: As moths rush into a blazing fire for their destruction, so do all people rush into Your mouths with great speed for their destruction.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl lokān samagrān vadanair jvaladbhiḥ | tejobhir āpūrya jagat samagraṁ bhāsas tavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣṇo ||30||
lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāt lokān samagrān vadanaiḥ jvaladbhiḥ tejobhiḥ ugrāḥ pratapanti
docs.text: You lick up and devour all the worlds from every side with Your blazing mouths. Your fierce radiance fills and scorches the entire universe, O Vishnu.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ākhyāhi me kaḥ bhavān ugra-rūpaḥ namaḥ astu deva-vara prasīda vijñātum ādyam pravṛttim
ākhyāhi me ko bhavān ugra-rūpo namo'stu te deva-vara prasīda | vijñātum icchāmi bhavantam ādyaṁ na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim ||31||
docs.text: Tell me, who are You in this fierce form? Obeisance to You, O best of gods, be gracious. I wish to know You, the primal one, for I do not understand Your purpose.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kālaḥ asmi loka-kṣaya-kṛt pravṛddhaḥ lokān samāhartum pravṛttaḥ ṛte api tvām na bhaviṣyanti yodhāḥ
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | kālo'smi loka-kṣaya-kṛt pravṛddho lokān samāhartum iha pravṛttaḥ | ṛte'pi tvāṁ na bhaviṣyanti sarve ye'vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ ||32||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: I am Time, the mighty destroyer of worlds, here engaged in destroying all people. Even without you, all the warriors standing in the opposing armies shall not survive.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tasmāt tvam uttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyaṁ samṛddham | mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvam eva nimitta-mātraṁ bhava savya-sācin ||33||
tasmāt uttiṣṭha yaśaḥ labhasva jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyam samṛddham mayā nihatāḥ pūrvam eva nimitta-mātram savya-sācin
docs.text: Therefore arise, gain glory. Conquer your enemies and enjoy a prosperous kingdom. They have already been slain by Me. Be merely an instrument, O Savyasachin.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: droṇam bhīṣmam jayadratham karṇam mayā hatān tvam jahi mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ yudhyasva jetāsi sapatnān
droṇaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ ca jayadrathaṁ ca karṇaṁ tathānyān api yodha-vīrān | mayā hatāṁs tvaṁ jahi mā vyathiṣṭhā yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān ||34||
docs.text: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors have already been slain by Me. Slay them without distress. Fight — you shall conquer your enemies in battle.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: etat śrutvā vacanam keśavasya kṛtāñjaliḥ vepamānaḥ kirīṭī sagadgadam bhīta-bhītaḥ praṇamya
sañjaya uvāca | etac chrutvā vacanaṁ keśavasya kṛtāñjalir vepamānaḥ kirīṭī | namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṁ sagadgadaṁ bhīta-bhītaḥ praṇamya ||35||
docs.text: Sanjaya said: Having heard these words of Krishna, the crowned Arjuna, trembling with folded hands, bowing down, spoke to Krishna in a faltering voice, greatly afraid.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.35

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca | sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā jagat prahṛṣyaty anurajyate ca | rakṣāṁsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddha-saṅghāḥ ||36||
sthāne hṛṣīkeśa prakīrtyā jagat prahṛṣyati anurajyate rakṣāṁsi bhītāni diśaḥ dravanti siddha-saṅghāḥ namasyanti
docs.text: Arjuna said: It is fitting, O Hrishikesha, that the world rejoices and is devoted to glorifying You. The demons flee in fear in all directions, and all the hosts of perfected beings bow to You.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.36

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kasmāc ca te na nameran mahātman garīyase brahmaṇo'py ādi-kartre | ananta deveśa jagan-nivāsa tvam akṣaraṁ sad-asat tat paraṁ yat ||37||
kasmāt na nameran mahātman garīyase brahmaṇaḥ ādi-kartre ananta deveśa akṣaram sat asat tat param
docs.text: And why should they not bow to You, O great soul, who are greater even than Brahma, the original creator? O infinite one, Lord of gods, refuge of the universe — You are the imperishable, the being, the non-being, and that which is beyond both.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.37

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tvam ādi-devaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇas tvam asya viśvasya paraṁ nidhānam | vettāsi vedyaṁ ca paraṁ ca dhāma tvayā tataṁ viśvam ananta-rūpa ||38||
ādi-devaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ viśvasya nidhānam vettā vedyam param dhāma tvayā tatam ananta-rūpa
docs.text: You are the primal God, the ancient Person, the supreme resting place of this universe. You are the knower and the knowable, and the supreme abode. The entire universe is pervaded by You, O infinite form.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.38

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vāyur yamo'gnir varuṇaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ prajāpatis tvaṁ prapitāmahaś ca | namo namas te'stu sahasra-kṛtvaḥ punaś ca bhūyo'pi namo namas te ||39||
vāyuḥ yamaḥ agniḥ varuṇaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ prajāpatiḥ prapitāmahaḥ namaḥ namaḥ sahasra-kṛtvaḥ bhūyaḥ api
docs.text: You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, the moon, Prajapati, and the great-grandfather. Obeisance to You a thousand times, and again and again obeisance to You!
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.39

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: namaḥ purastād atha pṛṣṭhatas te namo'stu te sarvata eva sarva | ananta-vīryāmita-vikramas tvaṁ sarvaṁ samāpnoṣi tato'si sarvaḥ ||40||
namaḥ purastāt pṛṣṭhataḥ sarvataḥ sarva ananta-vīrya amita-vikramaḥ sarvam samāpnoṣi tataḥ asi sarvaḥ
docs.text: Obeisance to You from the front, from behind, from all sides, O everything! You are of infinite power and immeasurable prowess. You pervade everything, and therefore You are everything.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.40

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sakheti matvā prasabhaṁ yad uktaṁ he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti | ajānatā mahimānaṁ tavedaṁ mayā pramādāt praṇayena vāpi ||41||
sakhā iti matvā prasabham he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakhe ajānatā mahimānam pramādāt praṇayena
docs.text: Thinking of You as a friend, I carelessly called You 'Hey Krishna,' 'Hey Yadava,' 'Hey friend' — not knowing Your greatness, out of negligence or love.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.41

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: avahāsārtham asatkṛtaḥ vihāra śayyā āsana bhojaneṣu ekaḥ acyuta kṣāmaye aprameyam
yac cāvahāsārtham asatkṛto'si vihāra-śayyāsana-bhojaneṣu | eko'thavāpy acyuta tat-samakṣaṁ tat kṣāmaye tvām aham aprameyam ||42||
docs.text: And if I disrespected You while playing, resting, sitting, or eating together — whether alone or in the presence of others — O Achyuta, I ask forgiveness of You, the immeasurable one.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.42

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: pitā lokasya carācarasya pūjyaḥ guruḥ garīyān na tvat-samaḥ abhyadhikaḥ kutaḥ apratima-prabhāva
pitāsi lokasya carācarasya tvam asya pūjyaś ca gurur garīyān | na tvat-samo'sty abhyadhikaḥ kuto'nyo loka-traye'py apratima-prabhāva ||43||
docs.text: You are the father of this world, of all that moves and does not move. You are its most worthy object of worship, the greatest teacher. None is equal to You in the three worlds — how then could anyone be greater, O incomparable one?
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.43

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: praṇamya praṇidhāya kāyam prasādaye īśam īḍyam pitā iva putrasya sakhā iva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyāḥ soḍhum
tasmāt praṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṁ prasādaye tvām aham īśam īḍyam | piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum ||44||
docs.text: Therefore, prostrating my body, I seek Your grace, O praiseworthy Lord. As a father tolerates a son, a friend a friend, a beloved the beloved — please tolerate me, O Lord.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.44

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: adṛṣṭa-pūrvam hṛṣitaḥ asmi bhayena pravyathitam manaḥ darśaya rūpam prasīda deveśa jagan-nivāsa
adṛṣṭa-pūrvaṁ hṛṣito'smi dṛṣṭvā bhayena ca pravyathitaṁ mano me | tad eva me darśaya deva rūpaṁ prasīda deveśa jagan-nivāsa ||45||
docs.text: I am delighted to have seen what was never seen before, yet my mind is disturbed with fear. Show me that other form, O Lord. Be gracious, O Lord of gods, O refuge of the universe.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.45

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kirīṭinam gadinam cakra-hastam icchāmi draṣṭum catur-bhujena sahasra-bāho viśva-mūrte
kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ cakra-hastam icchāmi tvāṁ draṣṭum ahaṁ tathaiva | tenaiva rūpeṇa catur-bhujena sahasra-bāho bhava viśva-mūrte ||46||
docs.text: I wish to see You with Your crown, mace, and discus in hand. Assume that four-armed form, O thousand-armed one, O Universal Form.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.46

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mayā prasannena rūpam param darśitam ātma-yogāt tejo-mayam viśvam anantam ādyam tvad-anyena na dṛṣṭa-pūrvam
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṁ rūpaṁ paraṁ darśitam ātma-yogāt | tejo-mayaṁ viśvam anantam ādyaṁ yan me tvad-anyena na dṛṣṭa-pūrvam ||47||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: By My grace, through My own power, O Arjuna, I have shown you this supreme, radiant, universal, infinite, primeval form — which no one other than you has ever seen.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.47

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na veda yajña adhyayanaiḥ na dānaiḥ na kriyābhiḥ na tapobhiḥ ugraiḥ nṛ-loke kuru-pravīra
na veda-yajñādhyayanair na dānair na ca kriyābhir na tapobhir ugraiḥ | evaṁ-rūpaḥ śakya ahaṁ nṛ-loke draṣṭuṁ tvad-anyena kuru-pravīra ||48||
docs.text: Not by the Vedas, sacrifices, study, charity, rituals, or severe austerities can I be seen in this form in the human world by anyone other than you, O best of the Kurus.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.48

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍha-bhāvo dṛṣṭvā rūpaṁ ghoram īdṛṅ mamedam | vyapeta-bhīḥ prīta-manāḥ punas tvaṁ tad eva me rūpam idaṁ prapaśya ||49||
mā vyathā vimūḍha-bhāvaḥ ghoram rūpam vyapeta-bhīḥ prīta-manāḥ prapaśya
docs.text: Do not be distressed, do not be bewildered by seeing this terrible form of Mine. Free from fear, with a pleased mind, behold once again My familiar form.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.49

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sañjaya uvāca | ity arjunaṁ vāsudevas tathokvā svakaṁ rūpaṁ darśayām āsa bhūyaḥ | āśvāsayām āsa ca bhītam enaṁ bhūtvā punaḥ saumya-vapur mahātmā ||50||
vāsudevaḥ svakam rūpam darśayām āsa āśvāsayām āsa bhītam saumya-vapuḥ mahātmā
docs.text: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus, Vasudeva showed His own form again. The great soul, assuming His gentle form once more, consoled the frightened Arjuna.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.50

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca | dṛṣṭvedaṁ mānuṣaṁ rūpaṁ tava saumyaṁ janārdana | idānīm asmi saṁvṛttaḥ sa-cetāḥ prakṛtiṁ gataḥ ||51||
dṛṣṭvā mānuṣam rūpam saumyam janārdana idānīm saṁvṛttaḥ sa-cetāḥ prakṛtim gataḥ
docs.text: Arjuna said: Seeing Your gentle human form, O Janardana, I am now composed, with a clear mind, and have returned to my normal nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.51

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: su-durdarśam rūpam dṛṣṭavān asi devāḥ api nityam darśana-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | su-durdarśam idaṁ rūpaṁ dṛṣṭavān asi yan mama | devā apy asya rūpasya nityaṁ darśana-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||52||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: This form of Mine that you have seen is very difficult to see. Even the gods are ever longing to see this form.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.52

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na vedaiḥ na tapasā na dānena na ijyayā śakyaḥ evaṁ-vidhaḥ draṣṭum
nāhaṁ vedair na tapasā na dānena na cejyayā | śakya evaṁ-vidho draṣṭuṁ dṛṣṭavān asi māṁ yathā ||53||
docs.text: Not by the Vedas, nor austerity, nor charity, nor sacrifice can I be seen as you have seen Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.53

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: bhaktyā ananyayā śakyaḥ jñātum draṣṭum tattvena praveṣṭum parantapa
bhaktyā tv ananyayā śakya aham evaṁ-vidho'rjuna | jñātuṁ draṣṭuṁ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṁ ca parantapa ||54||
docs.text: But by exclusive devotion alone, O Arjuna, can I be known, seen in truth, and entered into, O scorcher of foes.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.54

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mat-karma-kṛn mat-paramo mad-bhaktaḥ saṅga-varjitaḥ | nirvairaḥ sarva-bhūteṣu yaḥ sa mām eti pāṇḍava ||55||
mat-karma-kṛt mat-paramaḥ mad-bhaktaḥ saṅga-varjitaḥ nirvairaḥ sarva-bhūteṣu saḥ mām eti
docs.text: One who works for Me, considers Me supreme, is devoted to Me, is free from attachment, and bears no enmity toward any being — such a one comes to Me, O Pandava.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 11.55

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca evam satata-yuktāḥ ye bhaktāḥ tvām paryupāsate ye ca api akṣaram avyaktam teṣām ke yoga-vittamāḥ
arjuna uvāca | evaṁ satata-yuktā ye bhaktās tvāṁ paryupāsate | ye cāpy akṣaram avyaktaṁ teṣāṁ ke yoga-vittamāḥ ||1||
docs.text: Arjuna said: Those devotees who are constantly engaged in worshipping You, and those who worship the imperishable unmanifest — which of them are more perfect in yoga?
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca mayi āveśya manaḥ ye mām nitya-yuktāḥ upāsate śraddhayā parayā upetāḥ te me yuktatamāḥ matāḥ
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | mayy āveśya mano ye māṁ nitya-yuktā upāsate | śraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ ||2||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: Those who fix their minds on Me and worship Me with ever-steadfast devotion and supreme faith — they are considered by Me to be the most perfect in yoga.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ye tu akṣaram anirdeśyam avyaktam paryupāsate sarvatra-gam acintyam kūṭa-stham acalam dhruvam sanniyamya indriya-grāmam sarvatra sama-buddhayaḥ te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ

ye tv akṣaram anirdeśyam avyaktaṁ paryupāsate | sarvatra-gam acintyaṁ ca kūṭa-stham acalaṁ dhruvam ||3|| sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ sarvatra sama-buddhayaḥ | te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ ||4||
docs.text: But those who worship the imperishable, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the all-pervading, the inconceivable, the unchanging, the immovable, the eternal — having restrained all their senses, being equal-minded everywhere, and engaged in the welfare of all beings — they also attain Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kleśaḥ adhikataraḥ teṣām avyaktāsakta-cetasām avyaktā hi gatiḥ duḥkham dehavadbhiḥ avāpyate
kleśo'dhikataras teṣām avyaktāsakta-cetasām | avyaktā hi gatir duḥkhaṁ dehavadbhir avāpyate ||5||
docs.text: Greater is the difficulty of those whose minds are set on the unmanifest, for the path of the unmanifest is hard to reach for the embodied beings.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-parāḥ ananyena yogena mām dhyāyantaḥ upāsate teṣām aham samuddhartā mṛtyu-saṁsāra-sāgarāt bhavāmi na cirāt pārtha mayi āveśita-cetasām
ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-parāḥ | ananyenaiva yogena māṁ dhyāyanta upāsate ||6|| teṣām ahaṁ samuddhartā mṛtyu-saṁsāra-sāgarāt | bhavāmi na cirāt pārtha mayy āveśita-cetasām ||7||
docs.text: But those who surrender all actions to Me, regarding Me as the supreme goal, worshipping Me with exclusive devotion and meditating on Me — for them whose minds are absorbed in Me, O Partha, I become the swift deliverer from the ocean of birth and death.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mayi eva manaḥ ādhatsva mayi buddhim niveśaya nivasiṣyasi mayi eva ataḥ ūrdhvam na saṁśayaḥ
mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṁ niveśaya | nivasiṣyasi mayy eva ata ūrdhvaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ||8||
docs.text: Fix your mind on Me alone, place your intellect in Me. You shall then dwell in Me hereafter — of this there is no doubt.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: atha cittam samādhātum na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram abhyāsa-yogena tataḥ mām iccha āptum dhanañjaya
atha cittaṁ samādhātuṁ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram | abhyāsa-yogena tato mām icchāptuṁ dhanañjaya ||9||
docs.text: If you are unable to fix your mind steadily on Me, then seek to reach Me by the yoga of repeated practice, O Dhananjaya.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: abhyāse api asamarthaḥ asi mat-karma-paramaḥ bhava mad-artham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi
abhyāse'py asamartho'si mat-karma-paramo bhava | mad-artham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi ||10||
docs.text: If you are unable even to practice, then be devoted to performing actions for My sake. Even by performing actions for My sake, you shall attain perfection.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: atha etat api aśaktaḥ asi kartum mad-yogam āśritaḥ sarva-karma-phala-tyāgam tataḥ kuru yatātmavān
athaitad apy aśakto'si kartuṁ mad-yogam āśritaḥ | sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān ||11||
docs.text: If you are unable even to do this, then taking refuge in My yoga, renounce the fruits of all actions with self-control.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śreyaḥ hi jñānam abhyāsāt jñānāt dhyānam viśiṣyate dhyānāt karma-phala-tyāgaḥ tyāgāt śāntiḥ anantaram
śreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṁ viśiṣyate | dhyānāt karma-phala-tyāgas tyāgāc chāntir anantaram ||12||
docs.text: Knowledge is indeed better than mechanical practice; meditation is superior to knowledge; renunciation of the fruits of action is better than meditation — for peace immediately follows such renunciation.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: adveṣṭā sarva-bhūtānām maitraḥ karuṇaḥ eva ca nirmamaḥ nirahaṅkāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣamī
adveṣṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca | nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣamī ||13||
docs.text: He who has no hatred toward any being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, equal in pain and pleasure, and forgiving —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: santuṣṭaḥ satatam yogī yatātmā dṛḍha-niścayaḥ mayi arpita-mano-buddhiḥ yaḥ mad-bhaktaḥ saḥ me priyaḥ
santuṣṭaḥ satataṁ yogī yatātmā dṛḍha-niścayaḥ | mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||14||
docs.text: He who is always content, a yogi, self-controlled, with firm resolve, with mind and intellect offered to Me — that devotee of Mine is dear to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate ca yaḥ | harṣāmarṣa-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ ||15||
yasmāt na udvijate lokaḥ lokāt na udvijate ca yaḥ harṣa amarṣa bhaya udvegaiḥ muktaḥ yaḥ saḥ ca me priyaḥ
docs.text: He by whom the world is not agitated and who is not agitated by the world, who is free from elation, envy, fear, and anxiety — he too is dear to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: anapekṣaḥ śucir dakṣa udāsīno gata-vyathaḥ | sarvārambha-parityāgī yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||16||
anapekṣaḥ śuciḥ dakṣaḥ udāsīnaḥ gata-vyathaḥ sarvārambha-parityāgī yaḥ mad-bhaktaḥ saḥ me priyaḥ
docs.text: He who is free from expectation, pure, skillful, impartial, free from distress, and who has renounced all selfish undertakings — that devotee of Mine is dear to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yaḥ na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati śubha aśubha parityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ saḥ me priyaḥ
yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati | śubhāśubha-parityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||17||
docs.text: He who neither rejoices nor hates, neither grieves nor desires, who has renounced both the auspicious and the inauspicious, and who is full of devotion — he is dear to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā māna apamānayoḥ śīta uṣṇa sukha duḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅga-vivarjitaḥ
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ | śītoṣṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅga-vivarjitaḥ ||18||
docs.text: He who is equal toward friend and foe, in honor and dishonor, in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, and who is free from attachment —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tulya nindā stutiḥ maunī santuṣṭaḥ yena kenacit aniketaḥ sthira-matiḥ bhaktimān me priyaḥ naraḥ
tulya-nindā-stutir maunī santuṣṭo yena kenacit | aniketaḥ sthira-matir bhaktimān me priyo naraḥ ||19||
docs.text: He who is equal in blame and praise, contemplative, content with anything, without a fixed abode, steady-minded, and full of devotion — that person is dear to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ye tu dharmyāmṛtam idam yathoktam paryupāsate śraddadhānāḥ mat-paramāḥ bhaktāḥ te atīva me priyāḥ
ye tu dharmyāmṛtam idaṁ yathoktaṁ paryupāsate | śraddadhānā mat-paramā bhaktās te'tīva me priyāḥ ||20||
docs.text: But those who follow this immortal nectar of dharma as I have declared, endowed with faith, regarding Me as supreme — those devotees are exceedingly dear to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 12.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca prakṛtim puruṣam ca eva kṣetram kṣetrajñam etat veditum icchāmi jñānam jñeyam keśava
arjuna uvāca | prakṛtiṁ puruṣaṁ caiva kṣetraṁ kṣetrajñam eva ca | etad veditum icchāmi jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ ca keśava ||1||
docs.text: Arjuna said: O Keshava, I wish to know about Prakriti (nature) and Purusha (consciousness), the field and the knower of the field, and about knowledge and the object of knowledge.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca idam śarīram kaunteya kṣetram iti abhidhīyate etat yaḥ vetti tam prāhuḥ kṣetrajñaḥ tad-vidaḥ
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | idaṁ śarīraṁ kaunteya kṣetram ity abhidhīyate | etad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tad-vidaḥ ||2||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: This body, O son of Kunti, is called the field (kshetra). He who knows this field is called the knower of the field (kshetragna) by those who know.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kṣetrajñam ca api mām viddhi sarva-kṣetreṣu bhārata kṣetra-kṣetrajñayoḥ jñānam yat tat jñānam matam mama
kṣetrajñaṁ cāpi māṁ viddhi sarva-kṣetreṣu bhārata | kṣetra-kṣetrajñayor jñānaṁ yat taj jñānaṁ mataṁ mama ||3||
docs.text: Know Me also as the knower of the field in all fields, O Bharata. The knowledge of the field and its knower — that I consider to be true knowledge.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tat kṣetram yat yādṛk yad-vikāri yataḥ saḥ yaḥ yat-prabhāvaḥ samāsena me śṛṇu
tat kṣetraṁ yac ca yādṛk ca yad-vikāri yataś ca yat | sa ca yo yat-prabhāvaś ca tat samāsena me śṛṇu ||4||
docs.text: Hear from Me in brief what that field is, what its nature is, what its modifications are, from where it arises, who the knower is, and what his powers are.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ṛṣibhir bahudhā gītaṁ chandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛthak | brahma-sūtra-padaiś caiva hetumadbhir viniścitaiḥ ||5||
ṛṣibhiḥ bahudhā gītam chandobhiḥ vividhaiḥ pṛthak brahma-sūtra-padaiḥ hetumadbhiḥ viniścitaiḥ
docs.text: This truth has been sung by the sages in many ways, in various Vedic hymns, and especially in the well-reasoned and conclusive aphorisms of the Brahma Sutra.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mahā-bhūtāni ahaṁkāraḥ buddhiḥ avyaktam indriyāṇi daśa ekam pañca indriya-gocarāḥ
mahā-bhūtāny ahaṁkāro buddhir avyaktam eva ca | indriyāṇi daśaikaṁ ca pañca cendriya-gocarāḥ ||6||
docs.text: The five great elements, ego, intellect, the unmanifest prakriti, the ten senses and the mind, and the five objects of the senses —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: icchā dveṣaḥ sukham duḥkham saṅghātaḥ cetanā dhṛtiḥ etat kṣetram samāsena savikāram udāhṛtam
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaś cetanā dhṛtiḥ | etat kṣetraṁ samāsena savikāram udāhṛtam ||7||
docs.text: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, the aggregate body, consciousness, and fortitude — this, in brief, is the field with its modifications.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: amānitvam adambhitvam ahiṁsā kṣāntir ārjavam | ācāryopāsanaṁ śaucaṁ sthairyam ātma-vinigrahaḥ ||8||
amānitvam adambhitvam ahiṁsā kṣāntiḥ ārjavam ācāryopāsanam śaucam sthairyam ātma-vinigrahaḥ
docs.text: Humility, absence of hypocrisy, non-violence, tolerance, straightforwardness, service to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, and self-control —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: indriyārtheṣu vairāgyam anahaṁkāra eva ca | janma-mṛtyu-jarā-vyādhi-duḥkha-doṣānudarśanam ||9||
indriyārtheṣu vairāgyam anahaṁkāraḥ janma mṛtyu jarā vyādhi duḥkha doṣa anudarśanam
docs.text: Detachment from sense objects, absence of ego, and reflection upon the evils of birth, death, old age, disease, and suffering —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: asaktir anabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putra-dāra-gṛhādiṣu | nityaṁ ca sama-cittatvam iṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu ||10||
asaktiḥ anabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putra dāra gṛha ādiṣu nityam sama-cittatvam iṣṭa aniṣṭa upapattiṣu
docs.text: Non-attachment and absence of clinging to son, spouse, home, and the rest; constant evenness of mind upon the occurrence of desirable and undesirable events —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mayi ananya-yogena bhaktiḥ avyabhicāriṇī vivikta-deśa-sevitvam aratiḥ jana-saṁsadi
mayi cānanya-yogena bhaktir avyabhicāriṇī | vivikta-deśa-sevitvam aratir jana-saṁsadi ||11||
docs.text: Unwavering devotion to Me through exclusive yoga, resorting to solitary places, and having no delight in the company of worldly people —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: adhyātma-jñāna-nityatvam tattva-jñānārtha-darśanam etat jñānam iti proktam ajñānam yat ataḥ anyathā
adhyātma-jñāna-nityatvaṁ tattva-jñānārtha-darśanam | etaj jñānam iti proktam ajñānaṁ yad ato'nyathā ||12||
docs.text: Constancy in self-knowledge, perception of the goal of true knowledge — all this is declared to be knowledge. Whatever is contrary to this is ignorance.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: jñeyam yat tat pravakṣyāmi jñātvā amṛtam aśnute anādimat param brahma na sat na asat ucyate
jñeyaṁ yat tat pravakṣyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛtam aśnute | anādimat paraṁ brahma na sat tan nāsad ucyate ||13||
docs.text: I shall declare that which is to be known, knowing which one attains immortality. The beginningless Supreme Brahman is said to be neither existent nor non-existent.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarvataḥ pāṇi-pādam tat sarvataḥ akṣi śiraḥ mukham sarvataḥ śrutimat loke sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati
sarvataḥ pāṇi-pādaṁ tat sarvato'kṣi-śiro-mukham | sarvataḥ śrutimal loke sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||14||
docs.text: With hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and faces everywhere, with ears everywhere — That exists pervading everything in the world.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarvendriya-guṇābhāsam sarvendriya-vivarjitam asaktam sarva-bhṛt nirguṇam guṇa-bhoktṛ
sarvendriya-guṇābhāsaṁ sarvendriya-vivarjitam | asaktaṁ sarva-bhṛc caiva nirguṇaṁ guṇa-bhoktṛ ca ||15||
docs.text: Illuminating all the functions of the senses, yet devoid of all senses; unattached, yet sustaining all; free from the gunas, yet the experiencer of the gunas.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: bahir antaś ca bhūtānām acaraṁ caram eva ca | sūkṣmatvāt tad avijñeyaṁ dūra-sthaṁ cāntike ca tat ||16||
bahiḥ antaḥ bhūtānām acaram caram sūkṣmatvāt tat avijñeyam dūra-stham antike
docs.text: Outside and inside all beings, the moving and the unmoving; because of Its subtlety, It is incomprehensible; It is far away and yet near.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: avibhaktam bhūteṣu vibhaktam iva sthitam bhūta-bhartṛ jñeyam grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu
avibhaktaṁ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktam iva ca sthitam | bhūta-bhartṛ ca taj jñeyaṁ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca ||17||
docs.text: Though undivided, It appears to be divided among beings. It is to be known as the sustainer, devourer, and creator of all beings.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: jyotiṣām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param ucyate | jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ jñāna-gamyaṁ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam ||18||
jyotiṣām api tat jyotiḥ tamasaḥ param ucyate jñānam jñeyam jñāna-gamyam hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
docs.text: That is the light of all lights, said to be beyond darkness. It is knowledge, the object of knowledge, and the goal of knowledge, seated in the hearts of all.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: iti kṣetram tathā jñānam jñeyam ca uktam samāsataḥ mad-bhaktaḥ etat vijñāya mad-bhāvāya upapadyate
iti kṣetraṁ tathā jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ coktaṁ samāsataḥ | mad-bhakta etad vijñāya mad-bhāvāyopapadyate ||19||
docs.text: Thus the Field, Knowledge, and the Knowable have been briefly described. My devotee, understanding all this, becomes worthy of attaining My nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: prakṛtim puruṣam ca eva viddhi anādī ubhau api vikārān guṇān prakṛti-sambhavān
prakṛtiṁ puruṣaṁ caiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api | vikārāṁś ca guṇāṁś caiva viddhi prakṛti-sambhavān ||20||
docs.text: Know that both Prakriti (material nature) and Purusha (the conscious self) are beginningless. And know that all modifications and qualities are born of Prakriti.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kārya kāraṇa kartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtiḥ ucyate puruṣaḥ sukha-duḥkhānām bhoktṛtve hetuḥ
kārya-kāraṇa-kartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtir ucyate | puruṣaḥ sukha-duḥkhānāṁ bhoktṛtve hetur ucyate ||21||
docs.text: In the creation of effects and instruments of action, Prakriti is said to be the cause. In the experience of pleasure and pain, Purusha is said to be the cause.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: puruṣaḥ prakṛti-sthaḥ hi bhuṅkte prakṛti-jān guṇān kāraṇam guṇa-saṅgaḥ asya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu
puruṣaḥ prakṛti-stho hi bhuṅkte prakṛti-jān guṇān | kāraṇaṁ guṇa-saṅgo'sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu ||22||
docs.text: The Purusha, seated in Prakriti, experiences the qualities born of Prakriti. Attachment to the gunas is the cause of its birth in good and evil wombs.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: upadraṣṭā anumantā bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ paramātmā iti ca api uktaḥ dehe asmin puruṣaḥ paraḥ
upadraṣṭānumantā ca bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ | paramātmeti cāpy ukto dehe'smin puruṣaḥ paraḥ ||23||
docs.text: The Supreme Self in this body is also called the Witness, the Permitter, the Sustainer, the Experiencer, the Great Lord, and the Paramatma (Supreme Soul).
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ya evaṁ vetti puruṣaṁ prakṛtiṁ ca guṇaiḥ saha | sarvathā vartamāno'pi na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate ||24||
yaḥ evam vetti puruṣam prakṛtim guṇaiḥ saha sarvathā vartamānaḥ api na saḥ bhūyaḥ abhijāyate
docs.text: He who thus knows the Purusha and Prakriti along with the gunas, regardless of his present condition, is not born again.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: dhyānena ātmani paśyanti kecit ātmānam ātmanā anye sāṅkhyena yogena karma-yogena apare
dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecid ātmānam ātmanā | anye sāṅkhyena yogena karma-yogena cāpare ||25||
docs.text: Some perceive the Self in the self by meditation, others by the path of knowledge (Sankhya), and yet others by the path of selfless action (Karma Yoga).
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: anye tu evam ajānantaḥ śrutvā anyebhyaḥ upāsate te api atitaranti eva mṛtyum śruti-parāyaṇāḥ
anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śrutvānyebhya upāsate | te'pi cātitaranty eva mṛtyuṁ śruti-parāyaṇāḥ ||26||
docs.text: Yet others, not knowing these paths, worship by hearing from others. They too cross beyond death, being devoted to what they have heard.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yāvat sañjāyate kiñcit sattvam sthāvara jaṅgamam kṣetra kṣetrajña saṁyogāt tat viddhi bharatarṣabha
yāvat sañjāyate kiñcit sattvaṁ sthāvara-jaṅgamam | kṣetra-kṣetrajña-saṁyogāt tad viddhi bharatarṣabha ||27||
docs.text: Whatever being is born, whether moving or unmoving, know that it arises from the union of the Field (Kshetra) and the Knower of the Field (Kshetrajna), O best of the Bharatas.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: samam sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantam parameśvaram vinaśyatsu avinaśyantam yaḥ paśyati saḥ paśyati
samaṁ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṁ parameśvaram | vinaśyatsv avinaśyantaṁ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati ||28||
docs.text: He who sees the Supreme Lord dwelling equally in all beings — the imperishable within the perishable — he truly sees.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: samam paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśvaram na hinasti ātmanā ātmānam tataḥ yāti parām gatim
samaṁ paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśvaram | na hinasty ātmanātmānaṁ tato yāti parāṁ gatim ||29||
docs.text: Seeing the Lord equally present everywhere, one does not degrade oneself by oneself, and thus attains the supreme goal.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: prakṛtyaiva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ | yaḥ paśyati tathātmānam akartāraṁ sa paśyati ||30||
prakṛtyā eva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ yaḥ paśyati tathā ātmānam akartāram saḥ paśyati
docs.text: He who sees that all actions are performed by Prakriti alone, and that the Self is not the doer — he truly sees.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yadā bhūta pṛthag-bhāvam eka-stham anupaśyati tataḥ eva vistāram brahma sampadyate tadā
yadā bhūta-pṛthag-bhāvam eka-stham anupaśyati | tata eva ca vistāraṁ brahma sampadyate tadā ||31||
docs.text: When one perceives the diversity of beings as rooted in One, and their expansion as coming from that One alone, then one attains Brahman.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: anāditvān nirguṇatvāt paramātmāyam avyayaḥ | śarīra-stho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate ||32||
anāditvāt nirguṇatvāt paramātmā ayam avyayaḥ śarīra-sthaḥ api kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
docs.text: Being beginningless and beyond the gunas, this imperishable Supreme Self, though dwelling in the body, O son of Kunti, neither acts nor is tainted.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yathā sarva-gatam saukṣmyāt ākāśam na upalipyate sarvatra avasthitaḥ dehe tathā ātmā na upalipyate
yathā sarva-gataṁ saukṣmyād ākāśaṁ nopalipyate | sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate ||33||
docs.text: Just as the all-pervading space is not tainted because of its subtlety, so the Self, though situated everywhere in the body, is not tainted.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yathā prakāśayati ekaḥ kṛtsnam lokam imam raviḥ kṣetram kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnam prakāśayati bhārata
yathā prakāśayaty ekaḥ kṛtsnaṁ lokam imaṁ raviḥ | kṣetraṁ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṁ prakāśayati bhārata ||34||
docs.text: Just as the one sun illuminates this entire world, so the Lord of the Field (the Soul) illuminates the entire field (the body), O Bharata.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kṣetra kṣetrajñayoḥ evam antaram jñāna-cakṣuṣā bhūta prakṛti mokṣam ca ye viduḥ yānti te param
kṣetra-kṣetrajñayor evam antaraṁ jñāna-cakṣuṣā | bhūta-prakṛti-mokṣaṁ ca ye vidur yānti te param ||35||
docs.text: Those who, with the eye of knowledge, perceive the distinction between the Field and the Knower of the Field, and the liberation of beings from material nature — they attain the Supreme.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 13.35

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca param bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānām jñānam uttamam yat jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parām siddhim itaḥ gatāḥ
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | paraṁ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṁ jñānam uttamam | yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhim ito gatāḥ ||1||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: I shall again declare that supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, having known which all the sages have attained the highest perfection from this world.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: idam jñānam upāśritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ sarge api na upajāyante pralaye vyathanti ca
idaṁ jñānam upāśritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ | sarge 'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca ||2||
docs.text: By taking refuge in this knowledge and attaining My nature, they are not born again even at the time of creation, nor are they disturbed at the time of dissolution.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmy aham | sambhavaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ tato bhavati bhārata ||3||
mama yoniḥ mahat brahma tasmin garbham dadhāmi aham sambhavaḥ sarva-bhūtānām tataḥ bhavati bhārata
docs.text: The great Brahman (material nature) is My womb. In that I place the seed. From that, O Bharata, is the birth of all living beings.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarva-yoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ tāsām brahma mahat yoniḥ aham bīja-pradaḥ pitā
sarva-yoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ | tāsāṁ brahma mahad yonir ahaṁ bīja-pradaḥ pitā ||4||
docs.text: Whatever forms are produced in all the wombs, O son of Kunti, the great Brahman (material nature) is their womb, and I am the seed-giving father.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sattvam rajaḥ tamaḥ iti guṇāḥ prakṛti-sambhavāḥ nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam
sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛti-sambhavāḥ | nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam ||5||
docs.text: Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas — these three gunas (qualities) born of Prakriti (material nature) bind the imperishable embodied soul in the body, O mighty-armed one.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tatra sattvam nirmalatvāt prakāśakam anāmayam sukha-saṅgena badhnāti jñāna-saṅgena ca anagha
tatra sattvaṁ nirmalatvāt prakāśakam anāmayam | sukha-saṅgena badhnāti jñāna-saṅgena cānagha ||6||
docs.text: Of these, Sattva, being pure, is illuminating and free from distress. It binds by attachment to happiness and by attachment to knowledge, O sinless one.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: rajaḥ rāgātmakam viddhi tṛṣṇā saṅga samudbhavam tat nibadhnāti kaunteya karma-saṅgena dehinam
rajo rāgātmakaṁ viddhi tṛṣṇā-saṅga-samudbhavam | tan nibadhnāti kaunteya karma-saṅgena dehinam ||7||
docs.text: Know that Rajas is of the nature of passion, born of craving and attachment. It binds the embodied soul by attachment to action, O son of Kunti.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tamas tv ajñāna-jaṁ viddhi mohanaṁ sarva-dehinām | pramādālasya-nidrābhis tan nibadhnāti bhārata ||8||
tamaḥ tu ajñāna-jam viddhi mohanam sarva-dehinām pramāda ālasya nidrābhiḥ tat nibadhnāti bhārata
docs.text: But know that Tamas is born of ignorance and deludes all embodied beings. It binds through negligence, laziness, and sleep, O Bharata.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sattvam sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata jñānam āvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayati uta
sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata | jñānam āvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayaty uta ||9||
docs.text: Sattva attaches one to happiness, Rajas to action, O Bharata; but Tamas, veiling knowledge, attaches one to negligence.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: rajas tamaś cābhibhūya sattvaṁ bhavati bhārata | rajaḥ sattvaṁ tamaś caiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajas tathā ||10||
rajaḥ tamaḥ ca abhibhūya sattvam bhavati bhārata rajaḥ sattvam tamaḥ ca eva tathā
docs.text: Sometimes Sattva prevails, overpowering Rajas and Tamas, O Bharata. Sometimes Rajas prevails over Sattva and Tamas, and sometimes Tamas prevails over Sattva and Rajas.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarva-dvāreṣu dehe 'smin prakāśa upajāyate | jñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛddhaṁ sattvam ity uta ||11||
sarva-dvāreṣu dehe asmin prakāśaḥ upajāyate jñānam yadā tadā vidyāt vivṛddham sattvam iti uta
docs.text: When the light of knowledge shines through all the gates (senses) of the body, then it should be known that Sattva is predominant.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: lobhaḥ pravṛttir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśamaḥ spṛhā | rajasy etāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha ||12||
lobhaḥ pravṛttiḥ ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśamaḥ spṛhā rajasi etāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha
docs.text: Greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, and longing — these arise when Rajas is predominant, O best of the Bharatas.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aprakāśaḥ apravṛttiḥ ca pramādaḥ mohaḥ eva ca tamasi etāni jāyante vivṛddhe kuru-nandana
aprakāśo 'pravṛttiś ca pramādo moha eva ca | tamasy etāni jāyante vivṛddhe kuru-nandana ||13||
docs.text: Darkness, inactivity, negligence, and delusion — these arise when Tamas is predominant, O joy of the Kurus.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayam yāti deha-bhṛt tadā uttama-vidām lokān amalān pratipadyate
yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛt | tadottama-vidāṁ lokān amalān pratipadyate ||14||
docs.text: When the embodied soul meets death while Sattva is predominant, then it attains the pure worlds of those who know the highest.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: rajasi pralayam gatvā karma-saṅgiṣu jāyate tathā pralīnaḥ tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣu jāyate
rajasi pralayaṁ gatvā karma-saṅgiṣu jāyate | tathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣu jāyate ||15||
docs.text: Dying in the mode of passion, one is born among those attached to action. Dying in the mode of ignorance, one is born in the wombs of the deluded (lower species).
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasya āhuḥ sāttvikam nirmalam phalam rajasaḥ tu phalam duḥkham ajñānam tamasaḥ phalam
karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṁ nirmalaṁ phalam | rajasas tu phalaṁ duḥkham ajñānaṁ tamasaḥ phalam ||16||
docs.text: The fruit of righteous action performed in Sattva is said to be pure and spotless. The fruit of Rajas is sorrow, and the fruit of Tamas is ignorance.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sattvāt sañjāyate jñānam rajasaḥ lobhaḥ eva ca pramāda mohau tamasaḥ bhavataḥ ajñānam eva ca
sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva ca | pramāda-mohau tamaso bhavato 'jñānam eva ca ||17||
docs.text: From Sattva arises knowledge, from Rajas arises greed, and from Tamas arise negligence, delusion, and ignorance.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ūrdhvam gacchanti sattva-sthāḥ madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ jaghanya-guṇa-vṛtti-sthāḥ adhaḥ gacchanti tāmasāḥ
ūrdhvaṁ gacchanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ | jaghanya-guṇa-vṛtti-sthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ ||18||
docs.text: Those situated in Sattva go upward, those in Rajas remain in the middle, and those abiding in the lowest quality of Tamas go downward.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na anyam guṇebhyaḥ kartāram yadā draṣṭā anupaśyati guṇebhyaḥ ca param vetti mad-bhāvam saḥ adhigacchati
nānyaṁ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṁ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati | guṇebhyaś ca paraṁ vetti mad-bhāvaṁ so 'dhigacchati ||19||
docs.text: When the seer perceives no doer other than the gunas, and knows that which is beyond the gunas, he attains My divine nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān janma mṛtyu jarā duḥkhaiḥ vimuktaḥ amṛtam aśnute
guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān | janma-mṛtyu-jarā-duḥkhair vimukto 'mṛtam aśnute ||20||
docs.text: When the embodied soul transcends these three gunas that arise from the body, it is freed from birth, death, old age, and sorrow, and attains immortality.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca kaiḥ liṅgaiḥ trīn guṇān etān atītaḥ bhavati prabho kim ācāraḥ katham ca etān ativartate
arjuna uvāca | kair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho | kim ācāraḥ kathaṁ caitāṁs trīn guṇān ativartate ||21||
docs.text: Arjuna said: By what signs is one who has transcended the three gunas recognized, O Lord? What is his conduct? And how does he transcend the three gunas?
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca prakāśam ca pravṛttim ca moham eva pāṇḍava na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | prakāśaṁ ca pravṛttiṁ ca moham eva ca pāṇḍava | na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati ||22||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: He who does not hate illumination (sattva), activity (rajas), or delusion (tamas) when they arise, O Pandava, nor longs for them when they cease.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
