tags: udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vicālyate | guṇā vartanta ity evaṁ yo 'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate ||23||
udāsīna-vat āsīnaḥ guṇaiḥ yaḥ na vicālyate guṇāḥ vartante iti evam yaḥ avatiṣṭhati na iṅgate
docs.text: He who sits like one unconcerned, undisturbed by the gunas, who knows that the gunas alone are acting and remains firm without wavering.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ svasthaḥ sama-loṣṭāśma-kāñcanaḥ tulya-priyāpriyaḥ dhīraḥ tulya-nindātma-saṁstutiḥ
sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ svasthaḥ sama-loṣṭāśma-kāñcanaḥ | tulya-priyāpriyo dhīras tulya-nindātma-saṁstutiḥ ||24||
docs.text: He who is equal in pleasure and pain, self-poised, to whom a lump of earth, a stone, and gold are alike, who is the same toward the pleasant and unpleasant, who is wise, and equal in blame and praise.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mānāpamānayos tulyas tulyo mitrāri-pakṣayoḥ | sarvārambha-parityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate ||25||
mānāpamānayoḥ tulyaḥ tulyaḥ mitrāri-pakṣayoḥ sarvārambha-parityāgī guṇātītaḥ saḥ ucyate
docs.text: He who is equal in honor and dishonor, equal toward friend and foe, who has renounced all selfish undertakings — he is said to have transcended the gunas.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mām ca yaḥ avyabhicāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate saḥ guṇān samatītya etān brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
māṁ ca yo 'vyabhicāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate | sa guṇān samatītyaitān brahma-bhūyāya kalpate ||26||
docs.text: And he who serves Me with unfailing devotion through the yoga of devotion, he, transcending these gunas, is fit for becoming one with Brahman.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: brahmaṇaḥ hi pratiṣṭhā aham amṛtasya avyayasya ca śāśvatasya dharmasya sukhasya aikāntikasya ca
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāham amṛtasyāvyayasya ca | śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca ||27||
docs.text: For I am the abode of Brahman — the immortal, the imperishable, the eternal dharma, and absolute bliss.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 14.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śākham aśvatthaṁ prāhur avyayam | chandāṁsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit ||1||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca ūrdhva mūlam adhaḥ śākham aśvattham prāhuḥ avyayam chandāṁsi yasya parṇāni yaḥ tam veda saḥ veda-vit
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: They speak of an imperishable Ashvattha (fig) tree with its roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the Vedic hymns. He who knows this tree is a knower of the Vedas.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: adhaś cordhvaṁ prasṛtās tasya śākhā guṇa-pravṛddhā viṣaya-pravālāḥ | adhaś ca mūlāny anusantatāni karmānubandhīni manuṣya-loke ||2||
adhaḥ ca ūrdhvam prasṛtāḥ tasya śākhāḥ guṇa-pravṛddhāḥ viṣaya-pravālāḥ mūlāni anusantatāni karmānubandhīni manuṣya-loke
docs.text: Its branches spread below and above, nourished by the three gunas, with sense objects as its buds. Its roots also extend downward in the human world, bound by the results of actions (karma).
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na rūpam asya iha tathā upalabhyate na antaḥ ādiḥ sampratiṣṭhā aśvattham enam su-virūḍha-mūlam asaṅga-śastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā
na rūpam asyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādir na ca sampratiṣṭhā | aśvattham enaṁ su-virūḍha-mūlam asaṅga-śastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā ||3||
docs.text: The real form of this tree is not perceived here, nor its end, beginning, or foundation. Having cut down this deeply-rooted Ashvattha tree with the strong axe of detachment...
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tataḥ padam tat parimārgitavyam yasmin gatāḥ na nivartanti bhūyaḥ tam eva ādyam puruṣam prapadye yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
tataḥ padaṁ tat parimārgitavyaṁ yasmin gatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ | tam eva cādyaṁ puruṣaṁ prapadye yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī ||4||
docs.text: Then one must seek that supreme abode, having reached which one never returns again, and surrender to that original Supreme Person from whom this ancient flow of creation has streamed forth.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: nirmāna-mohā jita-saṅga-doṣā adhyātma-nityā vinivṛtta-kāmāḥ | dvandvair vimuktāḥ sukha-duḥkha-saṁjñair gacchanty amūḍhāḥ padam avyayaṁ tat ||5||
nirmāna-mohāḥ jita-saṅga-doṣāḥ adhyātma-nityāḥ vinivṛtta-kāmāḥ dvandvaiḥ vimuktāḥ sukha-duḥkha-saṁjñaiḥ gacchanti amūḍhāḥ padam avyayam tat
docs.text: Those who are free from pride and delusion, who have conquered the evil of attachment, who are ever devoted to the Self, whose desires have ceased, who are liberated from the dualities of pleasure and pain — such undeluded ones reach that imperishable abode.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ | yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama ||6||
na tat bhāsayate sūryaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ pāvakaḥ yat gatvā nivartante tat dhāma paramam mama
docs.text: That supreme abode of Mine is not illumined by the sun, nor the moon, nor fire. Having reached it, one never returns.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mama eva aṁśaḥ jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ manaḥ ṣaṣṭhāni indriyāṇi prakṛti-sthāni karṣati
mamaivāṁśo jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ | manaḥ-ṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛti-sthāni karṣati ||7||
docs.text: An eternal fragment of Myself becomes the living entity in the world of life and draws to itself the six senses — the five senses and the mind — which rest in material nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śarīram yat avāpnoti yat ca api utkrāmati īśvaraḥ gṛhītvā etāni saṁyāti vāyuḥ gandhān iva āśayāt
śarīraṁ yad avāpnoti yac cāpy utkrāmatīśvaraḥ | gṛhītvaitāni saṁyāti vāyur gandhān ivāśayāt ||8||
docs.text: When the soul, the lord of the body, acquires a body and when it leaves it, it takes these (senses and mind) and goes, as the wind carries fragrances from their source.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrotram cakṣuḥ sparśanam ca rasanam ghrāṇam eva adhiṣṭhāya manaḥ ca ayam viṣayān upasevate
śrotraṁ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṁ ca rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva ca | adhiṣṭhāya manaś cāyaṁ viṣayān upasevate ||9||
docs.text: Presiding over the ears, eyes, touch, taste, smell, and the mind, the soul enjoys the objects of the senses.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: utkrāmantam sthitam vā api bhuñjānam guṇānvitam vimūḍhāḥ na anupaśyanti paśyanti jñāna-cakṣuṣaḥ
utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam | vimūḍhā nānupaśyanti paśyanti jñāna-cakṣuṣaḥ ||10||
docs.text: The deluded do not perceive the soul as it departs from or dwells in the body, or as it enjoys under the influence of the gunas. But those with the eye of knowledge can see it.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yatantaḥ yoginaḥ ca enam paśyanti ātmani avasthitam yatantaḥ api akṛtātmānaḥ na enam paśyanti acetasaḥ
yatanto yoginaś cainaṁ paśyanty ātmany avasthitam | yatanto 'py akṛtātmāno nainaṁ paśyanty acetasaḥ ||11||
docs.text: Striving yogis perceive this Self situated within themselves. But those whose minds are not purified cannot perceive it, even though they strive.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yad āditya-gataṁ tejo jagad bhāsayate 'khilam | yac candramasi yac cāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam ||12||
yat āditya-gatam tejaḥ jagat bhāsayate akhilam yat candramasi yat ca agnau tat tejaḥ viddhi māmakam
docs.text: The light that resides in the sun, illuminating the entire world, and that which is in the moon and in fire — know that brilliance to be Mine.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: gām āviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmi aham ojasā puṣṇāmi ca auṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somaḥ bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
gām āviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā | puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ ||13||
docs.text: Entering the earth, I sustain all beings with My energy. And becoming the moon (Soma), the essence of all sap, I nourish all plants.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aham vaiśvānaraḥ bhūtvā prāṇinām deham āśritaḥ prāṇāpāna-samāyuktaḥ pacāmi annam catur-vidham
ahaṁ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśritaḥ | prāṇāpāna-samāyuktaḥ pacāmy annaṁ catur-vidham ||14||
docs.text: Becoming the digestive fire (Vaishvanara) in the bodies of all living beings, and joined with the prana and apana breaths, I digest the four kinds of food.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarvasya ca aham hṛdi sanniviṣṭaḥ mattaḥ smṛtiḥ jñānam apohanam ca vedaiḥ sarvaiḥ aham eva vedyaḥ vedānta-kṛt veda-vit
sarvasya cāhaṁ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo mattaḥ smṛtir jñānam apohanaṁ ca | vedaiś ca sarvair aham eva vedyo vedānta-kṛd veda-vid eva cāham ||15||
docs.text: I am seated in the hearts of all beings. From Me come memory, knowledge, and the removal of doubts. I alone am to be known by all the Vedas. I am the author of Vedanta and the knower of the Vedas.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: dvau imau puruṣau loke kṣaraḥ ca akṣaraḥ eva sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭa-sthaḥ akṣaraḥ ucyate
dvāv imau puruṣau loke kṣaraś cākṣara eva ca | kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭa-stho 'kṣara ucyate ||16||
docs.text: There are two purushas (beings) in this world — the perishable and the imperishable. All created beings are perishable. The unchanging one is called the imperishable.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: uttamaḥ puruṣas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛtaḥ | yo loka-trayam āviśya bibharty avyaya īśvaraḥ ||17||
uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ tu anyaḥ paramātmā iti udāhṛtaḥ yaḥ loka-trayam āviśya bibharti avyayaḥ īśvaraḥ
docs.text: But other than these two is the Supreme Person (Purushottama), declared as the Paramatma (Supreme Self), who, entering the three worlds, sustains them — the imperishable Lord.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yasmāt kṣaram atītaḥ aham akṣarāt api ca uttamaḥ ataḥ asmi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
yasmāt kṣaram atīto 'ham akṣarād api cottamaḥ | ato 'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||18||
docs.text: Because I transcend the perishable and am even higher than the imperishable, I am celebrated in the world and in the Vedas as the Supreme Person (Purushottama).
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yaḥ mām evam asammūḍhaḥ jānāti puruṣottamam saḥ sarva-vit bhajati mām sarva-bhāvena bhārata
yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam | sa sarva-vid bhajati māṁ sarva-bhāvena bhārata ||19||
docs.text: He who, undeluded, thus knows Me as the Supreme Person — he is the knower of all, and he worships Me with his whole being, O Bharata.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: iti guhyatamam śāstram idam uktam mayā anagha etat buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛta-kṛtyaḥ ca bhārata
iti guhyatamaṁ śāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha | etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛta-kṛtyaś ca bhārata ||20||
docs.text: Thus, this most secret teaching has been spoken by Me, O sinless one. Understanding this, one becomes truly wise and has fulfilled all duties, O Bharata.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 15.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca abhayam sattva-saṁśuddhiḥ jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ dānam damaḥ ca yajñaḥ svādhyāyaḥ tapaḥ ārjavam
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | abhayaṁ sattva-saṁśuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ | dānaṁ damaś ca yajñaś ca svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam ||1||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in knowledge and yoga, charity, self-control, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and simplicity —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ahiṁsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śāntir apaiśunam | dayā bhūteṣv aloluptvaṁ mārdavaṁ hrīr acāpalam ||2||
ahiṁsā satyam akrodhaḥ tyāgaḥ śāntiḥ apaiśunam dayā bhūteṣu aloluptvam mārdavam hrīḥ acāpalam
docs.text: Non-violence, truthfulness, freedom from anger, renunciation, tranquility, aversion to fault-finding, compassion towards all beings, freedom from greed, gentleness, modesty, and steadiness —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucam adrohaḥ na atimānitā bhavanti sampadam daivīm abhijātasya bhārata
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucam adroho nātimānitā | bhavanti sampadaṁ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata ||3||
docs.text: Vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of hatred, and absence of excessive pride — these belong to one born with divine qualities, O Bharata.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: dambhaḥ darpaḥ abhimānaḥ ca krodhaḥ pāruṣyam eva ajñānam abhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm
dambho darpo 'bhimānaś ca krodhaḥ pāruṣyam eva ca | ajñānaṁ cābhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm ||4||
docs.text: Hypocrisy, arrogance, excessive pride, anger, harshness, and ignorance — these belong to one born with demonic qualities, O Partha.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: daivī sampad vimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā | mā śucaḥ sampadaṁ daivīm abhijāto 'si pāṇḍava ||5||
daivī sampat vimokṣāya nibandhāya āsurī matā mā śucaḥ sampadam daivīm abhijātaḥ asi pāṇḍava
docs.text: Divine qualities lead to liberation, while demonic qualities lead to bondage. Do not grieve, O Pandava, for you are born with divine qualities.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: dvau bhūta-sargau loke 'smin daiva āsura eva ca | daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śṛṇu ||6||
dvau bhūta-sargau loke asmin daivaḥ āsuraḥ eva ca daivaḥ vistaraśaḥ proktaḥ āsuram pārtha me śṛṇu
docs.text: There are two types of created beings in this world — the divine and the demonic. The divine has been described in detail. Now hear from Me about the demonic, O Partha.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: pravṛttim ca nivṛttim janāḥ na viduḥ āsurāḥ śaucam na api ācāraḥ satyam teṣu vidyate
pravṛttiṁ ca nivṛttiṁ ca janā na vidur āsurāḥ | na śaucaṁ nāpi cācāro na satyaṁ teṣu vidyate ||7||
docs.text: Persons of demonic nature do not know what to do and what to refrain from. Neither purity, nor proper conduct, nor truth is found in them.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: asatyam apratiṣṭham te jagat āhuḥ anīśvaram aparaspara-sambhūtam kim anyat kāma-haitukam
asatyam apratiṣṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśvaram | aparaspara-sambhūtaṁ kim anyat kāma-haitukam ||8||
docs.text: They say the world is unreal, without foundation, without God, not produced by mutual causation — what else is it but driven by desire alone?
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: etām dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmānaḥ alpa-buddhayaḥ prabhavanti ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagataḥ ahitāḥ
etāṁ dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno 'lpa-buddhayaḥ | prabhavanty ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato 'hitāḥ ||9||
docs.text: Clinging to this view, these lost souls of meager intellect and cruel deeds arise as enemies of the world, working for its destruction.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kāmam āśritya duṣpūram dambha māna mada anvitāḥ mohāt gṛhītvā asad-grāhān pravartante aśuci-vratāḥ
kāmam āśritya duṣpūraṁ dambha-māna-madānvitāḥ | mohād gṛhītvāsad-grāhān pravartante 'śuci-vratāḥ ||10||
docs.text: Taking refuge in insatiable desire, full of hypocrisy, pride, and arrogance, they hold false ideals through delusion and act with impure resolves.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: cintām aparimeyām ca pralayāntām upāśritāḥ kāmopabhoga paramāḥ etāvat iti niścitāḥ
cintām aparimeyāṁ ca pralayāntām upāśritāḥ | kāmopabhoga-paramā etāvad iti niścitāḥ ||11||
docs.text: Beset with immeasurable anxieties that last until death, they regard the gratification of desires as the highest goal, firmly convinced that this is all there is.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: āśā-pāśa-śatair baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ | īhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyenārtha-sañcayān ||12||
āśā-pāśa-śataiḥ baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ īhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyena artha-sañcayān
docs.text: Bound by hundreds of bonds of desire, devoted to lust and anger, they strive to amass wealth by unjust means for the gratification of their desires.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: idam adya mayā labdham imam prāpsye manoratham asti api me bhaviṣyati punaḥ dhanam
idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham | idam astīdam api me bhaviṣyati punar dhanam ||13||
docs.text: This has been gained by me today; this desire I shall fulfill; this wealth is mine, and that also shall be mine in the future.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: asau mayā hataḥ śatrur haniṣye cāparān api | īśvaro 'ham ahaṁ bhogī siddho 'haṁ balavān sukhī ||14||
asau mayā hataḥ śatruḥ haniṣye ca aparān api īśvaraḥ aham bhogī siddhaḥ balavān sukhī
docs.text: That enemy has been destroyed by me, and I shall destroy others too. I am the lord, the enjoyer, I am perfect, powerful, and happy.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: āḍhyaḥ abhijanavān asmi kaḥ anyaḥ asti sadṛśaḥ mayā yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣye iti ajñāna-vimohitāḥ
āḍhyo 'bhijanavān asmi ko 'nyo 'sti sadṛśo mayā | yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ity ajñāna-vimohitāḥ ||15||
docs.text: I am wealthy and of noble birth. Who else is equal to me? I shall perform sacrifices, I shall give charity, I shall rejoice — thus they are deluded by ignorance.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ | prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣu patanti narake 'śucau ||16||
aneka-citta-vibhrāntāḥ moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣu patanti narake aśucau
docs.text: Bewildered by many anxieties, entangled in a net of delusion, deeply attached to the enjoyment of desires, they fall into a foul hell.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ | yajante nāma-yajñais te dambhenāvidhi-pūrvakam ||17||
ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhāḥ dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ yajante nāma-yajñaiḥ te dambhena avidhi-pūrvakam
docs.text: Self-conceited, stubborn, intoxicated by wealth and pride, they perform sacrifices in name only, with ostentation and without following proper rules.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ahaṅkāram balam darpam kāmam krodham ca saṁśritāḥ mām ātma-para-deheṣu pradviṣantaḥ abhyasūyakāḥ
ahaṅkāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca saṁśritāḥ | mām ātma-para-deheṣu pradviṣanto 'bhyasūyakāḥ ||18||
docs.text: Taking shelter of ego, force, arrogance, desire, and anger, these envious persons hate Me, who dwells in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tān aham dviṣataḥ krūrān saṁsāreṣu narādhamān kṣipāmi ajasram aśubhān āsurīṣu eva yoniṣu
tān ahaṁ dviṣataḥ krūrān saṁsāreṣu narādhamān | kṣipāmy ajasram aśubhān āsurīṣv eva yoniṣu ||19||
docs.text: Those hateful, cruel, and lowest of mankind, who are inauspicious, I perpetually cast into demonic wombs in the cycle of birth and death.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: āsurīm yonim āpannāḥ mūḍhāḥ janmani janmani mām aprāpya eva kaunteya tataḥ yānti adhamām gatim
āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani | mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṁ gatim ||20||
docs.text: Attaining demonic births repeatedly, birth after birth, these deluded souls never reach Me, O Kaunteya, and thus sink to the lowest state.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tri-vidham narakasya idam dvāram nāśanam ātmanaḥ kāmaḥ krodhaḥ tathā lobhaḥ tasmāt etat trayam tyajet
tri-vidhaṁ narakasyedaṁ dvāraṁ nāśanam ātmanaḥ | kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet ||21||
docs.text: There are three gates to hell that lead to the destruction of the self — lust, anger, and greed. Therefore, one should abandon these three.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ | ācaraty ātmanaḥ śreyas tato yāti parāṁ gatim ||22||
etaiḥ vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvāraiḥ tribhiḥ naraḥ ācarati ātmanaḥ śreyaḥ tataḥ yāti parām gatim
docs.text: A person who is freed from these three gates of darkness, O Kaunteya, practices what is good for the self, and thus attains the supreme destination.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yaḥ śāstra-vidhim utsṛjya vartate kāma-kārataḥ na saḥ siddhim avāpnoti sukham parām gatim
yaḥ śāstra-vidhim utsṛjya vartate kāma-kārataḥ | na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim ||23||
docs.text: He who discards the injunctions of the scriptures and acts according to his own desires attains neither perfection, nor happiness, nor the supreme destination.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tasmāc chāstraṁ pramāṇaṁ te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau | jñātvā śāstra-vidhānoktaṁ karma kartum ihārhasi ||24||
tasmāt śāstram pramāṇam te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau jñātvā śāstra-vidhānoktam karma kartum iha arhasi
docs.text: Therefore, let the scripture be your authority in determining what should be done and what should not be done. Having known the scriptural injunctions, you should perform actions in this world accordingly.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 16.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca ye śāstra-vidhim utsṛjya yajante śraddhayā anvitāḥ teṣām niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvam āho rajaḥ tamaḥ
arjuna uvāca | ye śāstra-vidhim utsṛjya yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ | teṣāṁ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ ||1||
docs.text: Arjuna said: Those who, setting aside the injunctions of scripture, perform worship endowed with faith — what is their position, O Krishna? Is it in goodness, passion, or ignorance?
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca tri-vidhā bhavati śraddhā dehinām sā svabhāva-jā sāttvikī rājasī tāmasī ca iti tām śṛṇu
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāva-jā | sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṁ śṛṇu ||2||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: The faith of embodied beings is of three kinds, born of their own nature — sattvic (goodness), rajasic (passion), and tamasic (ignorance). Hear about it.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sattva-anurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata śraddhā-mayaḥ ayam puruṣaḥ yaḥ yat śraddhaḥ saḥ eva saḥ
sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata | śraddhā-mayo'yaṁ puruṣo yo yac-chraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ||3||
docs.text: The faith of each person conforms to their nature, O Bharata. A person is made of their faith — whatever their faith is, that indeed they are.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣa-rakṣāṁsi rājasāḥ | pretān bhūta-gaṇāṁś cānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ ||4||
yajante sāttvikāḥ devān yakṣa-rakṣāṁsi rājasāḥ pretān bhūta-gaṇān ca anye yajante tāmasāḥ janāḥ
docs.text: Those in goodness worship the gods; those in passion worship yakshas and rakshasas; and others — those in ignorance — worship ghosts and spirits of the dead.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aśāstra-vihitam ghoram tapyante ye tapaḥ janāḥ dambha ahaṁkāra saṁyuktāḥ kāma rāga balānvitāḥ
aśāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ | dambhāhaṁkāra-saṁyuktāḥ kāma-rāga-balānvitāḥ ||5||
docs.text: Those who practise terrible austerities not ordained by scripture, possessed by hypocrisy and egoism, driven by the force of desire and attachment —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: karśayantaḥ śarīra-stham bhūta-grāmam acetasaḥ mām ca eva antaḥ-śarīra-stham tān viddhi āsura-niścayān
karśayantaḥ śarīra-sthaṁ bhūta-grāmam acetasaḥ | māṁ caivāntaḥ-śarīra-sthaṁ tān viddhyāsura-niścayān ||6||
docs.text: Senselessly torturing the elements of the body and also Me who dwells within — know them to be of demoniac resolve.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ | yajñas tapas tathā dānaṁ teṣāṁ bhedam imaṁ śṛṇu ||7||
āhāraḥ tu api sarvasya tri-vidhaḥ bhavati priyaḥ yajñaḥ tapaḥ tathā dānam teṣām bhedam imam śṛṇu
docs.text: The food that is preferred by everyone is also of three kinds. So too are sacrifice, austerity, and charity. Hear now the distinction between them.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: āyuḥ sattva bala ārogya sukha prīti vivardhanāḥ rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirāḥ hṛdyāḥ āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ
āyuḥ-sattva-balārogya-sukha-prīti-vivardhanāḥ | rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ ||8||
docs.text: Foods that promote longevity, vitality, strength, health, happiness, and satisfaction, which are juicy, nourishing, substantial, and pleasing to the heart — such foods are dear to those in goodness.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kaṭu amla lavaṇa ati-uṣṇa tīkṣṇa rūkṣa vidāhinaḥ āhārāḥ rājasasya iṣṭāḥ duḥkha śoka āmaya pradāḥ
kaṭv-amla-lavaṇāty-uṣṇa-tīkṣṇa-rūkṣa-vidāhinaḥ | āhārā rājasasyeṣṭā duḥkha-śokāmaya-pradāḥ ||9||
docs.text: Foods that are bitter, sour, salty, excessively hot, pungent, dry, and burning are preferred by those in passion. They cause pain, grief, and disease.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yāta-yāmam gata-rasam pūti paryuṣitam ca yat ucchiṣṭam api ca amedhyam bhojanam tāmasa-priyam
yāta-yāmaṁ gata-rasaṁ pūti paryuṣitaṁ ca yat | ucchiṣṭam api cāmedhyaṁ bhojanaṁ tāmasa-priyam ||10||
docs.text: Food that is stale, tasteless, putrid, leftover, and impure is dear to those in the mode of ignorance.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aphala-ākāṅkṣibhiḥ yajñaḥ vidhi-diṣṭaḥ yaḥ ijyate yaṣṭavyam eva iti manaḥ samādhāya saḥ sāttvikaḥ
aphalākāṅkṣibhir yajño vidhi-diṣṭo ya ijyate | yaṣṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ ||11||
docs.text: That sacrifice which is performed according to scriptural injunction, by those who expect no reward, with the firm conviction that it is a duty — that is sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: abhisandhāya tu phalam dambha-artham api ca eva yat ijyate bharata-śreṣṭha tam yajñam viddhi rājasam
abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārtham api caiva yat | ijyate bharata-śreṣṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam ||12||
docs.text: But that sacrifice which is performed with an eye on the result, or merely for show, O best of Bharatas — know that to be rajasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vidhi-hīnam asṛṣṭa-annam mantra-hīnam adakṣiṇam śraddhā-virahitam yajñam tāmasam paricakṣate
vidhi-hīnam asṛṣṭānnaṁ mantra-hīnam adakṣiṇam | śraddhā-virahitaṁ yajñaṁ tāmasaṁ paricakṣate ||13||
docs.text: That sacrifice which is performed without regard for scriptural injunctions, without distribution of food, without proper hymns, without remuneration to the priests, and devoid of faith — is declared to be tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: deva dvija guru prājña pūjanam śaucam ārjavam brahmacaryam ahiṁsā ca śārīram tapaḥ ucyate
deva-dvija-guru-prājña-pūjanaṁ śaucam ārjavam | brahmacaryam ahiṁsā ca śārīraṁ tapa ucyate ||14||
docs.text: Worship of the gods, the twice-born, teachers, and the wise; purity, straightforwardness, celibacy, and non-violence — this is called the austerity of the body.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: anudvega-karam vākyam satyam priya hitam ca yat svādhyāya abhyasanam ca eva vāṅ-mayam tapaḥ ucyate
anudvega-karaṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priya-hitaṁ ca yat | svādhyāyābhyasanaṁ caiva vāṅ-mayaṁ tapa ucyate ||15||
docs.text: Speech that causes no agitation, that is truthful, pleasant, and beneficial, as well as the practice of self-study — this is called the austerity of speech.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: manaḥ-prasādaḥ saumyatvam maunam ātma-vinigrahaḥ bhāva-saṁśuddhiḥ iti etat tapaḥ mānasam ucyate
manaḥ-prasādaḥ saumyatvaṁ maunam ātma-vinigrahaḥ | bhāva-saṁśuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam ucyate ||16||
docs.text: Serenity of mind, gentleness, silence, self-control, and purity of thought — this is called the austerity of the mind.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śraddhayā parayā taptam tapaḥ tat tri-vidham naraiḥ aphala-ākāṅkṣibhiḥ yuktaiḥ sāttvikam paricakṣate
śraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapas tat tri-vidhaṁ naraiḥ | aphalākāṅkṣibhir yuktaiḥ sāttvikaṁ paricakṣate ||17||
docs.text: This threefold austerity (of body, speech, and mind) practised with supreme faith by steadfast persons who desire no fruit — that is declared to be sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: satkāra māna pūjā artham tapaḥ dambhena ca eva yat kriyate tat iha proktam rājasam calam adhruvam
satkāra-māna-pūjārthaṁ tapo dambhena caiva yat | kriyate tad iha proktaṁ rājasaṁ calam adhruvam ||18||
docs.text: Austerity that is practised with hypocrisy, for the sake of gaining respect, honor, and adoration — that is said to be rajasic, unstable, and impermanent.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mūḍha-grāheṇa ātmanaḥ yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ parasya utsādana-artham vā tat tāmasam udāhṛtam
mūḍha-grāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ | parasyotsādanārthaṁ vā tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||19||
docs.text: Austerity that is practised with foolish stubbornness, through self-torture, or for the purpose of destroying others — that is declared to be tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: dātavyam iti yad dānaṁ dīyate'nupakāriṇe | deśe kāle ca pātre ca tad dānaṁ sāttvikaṁ smṛtam ||20||
dātavyam iti yat dānam dīyate anupakāriṇe deśe kāle ca pātre ca tat dānam sāttvikam smṛtam
docs.text: That charity which is given as a matter of duty, to one who cannot reciprocate, at the proper place and time, and to a worthy person — that is considered sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yat tu pratyupakāra-artham phalam uddiśya vā punaḥ dīyate ca parikliṣṭam tat dānam rājasam smṛtam
yat tu pratyupakārārthaṁ phalam uddiśya vā punaḥ | dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smṛtam ||21||
docs.text: But that charity which is given with the aim of getting something in return, or with expectation of fruit, or given reluctantly — that is considered rajasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: adeśa-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaś ca dīyate | asat-kṛtam avajñātaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||22||
adeśa-kāle yat dānam apātrebhyaḥ ca dīyate asat-kṛtam avajñātam tat tāmasam udāhṛtam
docs.text: That charity which is given at the wrong place and time, to unworthy recipients, without respect or with contempt — that is declared to be tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśo brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛtaḥ | brāhmaṇās tena vedāś ca yajñāś ca vihitāḥ purā ||23||
oṁ tat sat iti nirdeśaḥ brahmaṇaḥ tri-vidhaḥ smṛtaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ tena vedāḥ ca yajñāḥ ca vihitāḥ purā
docs.text: Om Tat Sat — this has been declared as the threefold designation of Brahman. By that were the brahmins, the Vedas, and the sacrifices ordained in the beginning.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tasmād om ity udāhṛtya yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ | pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṁ brahma-vādinām ||24||
tasmāt om iti udāhṛtya yajña dāna tapaḥ kriyāḥ pravartante vidhāna-uktāḥ satatam brahma-vādinām
docs.text: Therefore, acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity as prescribed by the scriptures are always commenced by the knowers of Brahman with the utterance of Om.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tad ity anabhisandhāya phalaṁ yajña-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ | dāna-kriyāś ca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣa-kāṅkṣibhiḥ ||25||
tat iti anabhisandhāya phalam yajña tapaḥ kriyāḥ dāna-kriyāḥ ca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣa-kāṅkṣibhiḥ
docs.text: With the utterance of 'Tat' and without aiming at any fruit, various acts of sacrifice, austerity, and charity are performed by those who desire liberation.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve ca sad ity etat prayujyate | praśaste karmaṇi tathā sac-chabdaḥ pārtha yujyate ||26||
sat-bhāve sādhu-bhāve ca sat iti etat prayujyate praśaste karmaṇi tathā sat-śabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
docs.text: The word 'Sat' is used in the sense of reality and goodness. Likewise, O Partha, the word 'Sat' is used for auspicious action.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ sad iti cocyate | karma caiva tad-arthīyaṁ sad ity evābhidhīyate ||27||
yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ sat iti ca ucyate karma ca eva tad-arthīyam sat iti eva abhidhīyate
docs.text: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and charity is also called 'Sat.' And action performed for the sake of That (Brahman) is also designated as 'Sat.'
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aśraddhayā hutam dattam tapaḥ taptam kṛtam ca yat asat iti ucyate pārtha na ca tat pretya no iha
aśraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛtaṁ ca yat | asad ity ucyate pārtha na ca tat pretya no iha ||28||
docs.text: Whatever is sacrificed, given, or performed, and whatever austerity is practised without faith — it is called 'Asat,' O Partha. It is of no avail either here or hereafter.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 17.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca sannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam icchāmi veditum tyāgasya ca hṛṣīkeśa pṛthak keśi-niṣūdana
arjuna uvāca | sannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam icchāmi veditum | tyāgasya ca hṛṣīkeśa pṛthak keśi-niṣūdana ||1||
docs.text: Arjuna said: O mighty-armed one, I wish to know the truth about renunciation (sannyasa) and relinquishment (tyaga) separately, O Hrishikesha, O slayer of Keshi.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śrī-bhagavān uvāca kāmyānām karmaṇām nyāsam sannyāsam kavayaḥ viduḥ sarva-karma-phala-tyāgam prāhuḥ tyāgam vicakṣaṇāḥ
śrī-bhagavān uvāca | kāmyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nyāsaṁ sannyāsaṁ kavayo viduḥ | sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ prāhus tyāgaṁ vicakṣaṇāḥ ||2||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord said: The learned understand sannyasa as the giving up of desire-motivated actions. The wise declare tyaga as the abandonment of the fruits of all actions.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tyājyam doṣavat iti eke karma prāhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ yajña dāna tapaḥ karma na tyājyam apare
tyājyaṁ doṣavad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ | yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyam iti cāpare ||3||
docs.text: Some wise thinkers declare that all action should be abandoned as evil, while others say that acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity should not be given up.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: niścayam śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama tyāgaḥ hi puruṣa-vyāghra tri-vidhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ
niścayaṁ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama | tyāgo hi puruṣa-vyāghra tri-vidhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ ||4||
docs.text: Hear from Me the definitive conclusion about relinquishment, O best of the Bharatas. Relinquishment, O tiger among men, has been declared to be of three kinds.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yajña dāna tapaḥ karma na tyājyam kāryam eva tat yajñaḥ dānam tapaḥ pāvanāni manīṣiṇām
yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṁ kāryam eva tat | yajño dānaṁ tapaś caiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām ||5||
docs.text: Acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity should not be abandoned; they must indeed be performed. Sacrifice, charity, and austerity are purifying for the wise.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: etāni api tu karmāṇi saṅgam tyaktvā phalāni ca kartavyāni iti me pārtha niścitam matam uttamam
etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni ca | kartavyānīti me pārtha niścitaṁ matam uttamam ||6||
docs.text: But even these actions should be performed abandoning attachment and the fruits — this is My definite and highest conclusion, O Partha.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ na upapadyate mohāt tasya parityāgaḥ tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate | mohāt tasya parityāgas tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||7||
docs.text: The renunciation of prescribed duties is not proper. Abandoning them out of delusion is declared to be tamasic (in the mode of ignorance).
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: duḥkham iti eva yat karma kāya-kleśa-bhayāt tyajet saḥ kṛtvā rājasam tyāgam na eva tyāga-phalam labhet
duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśa-bhayāt tyajet | sa kṛtvā rājasaṁ tyāgaṁ naiva tyāga-phalaṁ labhet ||8||
docs.text: One who gives up action because it is painful or out of fear of physical discomfort — such renunciation is rajasic, and one never obtains the fruit of true relinquishment.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kāryam iti eva yat karma niyatam kriyate arjuna saṅgam tyaktvā phalam ca eva saḥ tyāgaḥ sāttvikaḥ mataḥ
kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṁ kriyate 'rjuna | saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalaṁ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ ||9||
docs.text: When prescribed action is performed simply because it ought to be done, O Arjuna, abandoning attachment and the fruit — that relinquishment is considered sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na dveṣṭi akuśalam karma kuśale na anuṣajjate tyāgī sattva-samāviṣṭaḥ medhāvī chinna-saṁśayaḥ
na dveṣṭy akuśalaṁ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate | tyāgī sattva-samāviṣṭo medhāvī chinna-saṁśayaḥ ||10||
docs.text: The wise renouncer, imbued with sattva, intelligent and free from doubts, neither hates disagreeable work nor is attached to agreeable work.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na hi deha-bhṛtā śakyam tyaktum karmāṇi aśeṣataḥ yaḥ tu karma-phala-tyāgī saḥ tyāgī iti abhidhīyate
na hi deha-bhṛtā śakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇy aśeṣataḥ | yas tu karma-phala-tyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate ||11||
docs.text: It is indeed impossible for an embodied being to abandon actions entirely. But one who renounces the fruits of action is called a true renouncer (tyagi).
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: aniṣṭam iṣṭam miśram ca tri-vidham karmaṇaḥ phalam bhavati atyāginām pretya na tu sannyāsinām kvacit
aniṣṭam iṣṭaṁ miśraṁ ca tri-vidhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam | bhavaty atyāgināṁ pretya na tu sannyāsināṁ kvacit ||12||
docs.text: The threefold fruit of action — undesirable, desirable, and mixed — accrues after death to those who have not renounced, but never to those who have truly renounced.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: pañca etāni mahā-bāho kāraṇāni nibodha me sāṅkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarva-karmaṇām
pañcaitāni mahā-bāho kāraṇāni nibodha me | sāṅkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarva-karmaṇām ||13||
docs.text: Learn from Me, O mighty-armed one, the five factors declared in Sankhya philosophy for the accomplishment of all actions.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: adhiṣṭhānam tathā kartā karaṇam ca pṛthag-vidham vividhāḥ pṛthak ceṣṭāḥ daivam ca eva atra pañcamam
adhiṣṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ ca pṛthag-vidham | vividhāś ca pṛthak ceṣṭā daivaṁ caivātra pañcamam ||14||
docs.text: The body (seat of action), the doer, the various instruments (senses and organs), the various kinds of efforts, and divine providence as the fifth — these are the five factors of action.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śarīra vāk manobhiḥ yat karma prārabhate naraḥ nyāyyam vā viparītam pañca ete tasya hetavaḥ
śarīra-vāṅ-manobhir yat karma prārabhate naraḥ | nyāyyaṁ vā viparītaṁ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ ||15||
docs.text: Whatever action a person undertakes by body, speech, or mind — whether right or wrong — these five are its causes.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tatra evam sati kartāram ātmānam kevalam tu yaḥ paśyati akṛta-buddhitvāt na saḥ paśyati durmatiḥ
tatraivaṁ sati kartāram ātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ | paśyaty akṛta-buddhitvān na sa paśyati durmatiḥ ||16||
docs.text: Therefore, one who — due to an untrained intellect — sees oneself alone as the doer, that person of poor understanding does not truly see.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yasya na ahaṁkṛtaḥ bhāvaḥ buddhiḥ yasya na lipyate hatvā api saḥ imān lokān na hanti na nibadhyate
yasya nāhaṁkṛto bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate | hatvāpi sa imāṁl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate ||17||
docs.text: One whose nature is free from ego-sense, whose intellect is not tainted — even though slaying these people, does not truly slay, nor is bound by the action.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: jñānam jñeyam parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-codanā karaṇam karma kartā iti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ
jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-codanā | karaṇaṁ karma karteti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ ||18||
docs.text: Knowledge, the object of knowledge, and the knower — these three form the threefold impulse to action. The instrument, the action, and the doer — these three form the threefold basis of action.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: jñānam karma ca kartā ca tridhā eva guṇa-bhedataḥ procyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvat śṛṇu tāni api
jñānaṁ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ | procyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvac chṛṇu tāny api ||19||
docs.text: Knowledge, action, and the doer are each declared to be of three kinds according to the distinction of the gunas, as described in Sankhya philosophy. Hear about them properly.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarva-bhūteṣu yena ekam bhāvam avyayam īkṣate avibhaktam vibhakteṣu tat jñānam viddhi sāttvikam
sarva-bhūteṣu yenaikaṁ bhāvam avyayam īkṣate | avibhaktaṁ vibhakteṣu taj jñānaṁ viddhi sāttvikam ||20||
docs.text: That knowledge by which one sees a single imperishable reality in all beings — undivided among the divided — know that knowledge to be sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: pṛthaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛthag-vidhān | vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu taj jñānaṁ viddhi rājasam ||21||
pṛthaktvena tu yat jñānam nānā-bhāvān pṛthag-vidhān vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tat jñānam viddhi rājasam
docs.text: That knowledge which sees in all beings various distinct entities of different kinds, as separate from one another — know that knowledge to be rajasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yat tu kṛtsnavad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam | atattvārthavad alpaṁ ca tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||22||
yat tu kṛtsnavat ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam atattvārthavat alpam ca tat tāmasam udāhṛtam
docs.text: That knowledge which clings to one single effect as if it were the whole, which is irrational, without basis in truth, and trivial — that is declared to be tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: niyatam saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣataḥ kṛtam aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam ucyate
niyataṁ saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣataḥ kṛtam | aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam ucyate ||23||
docs.text: That action which is prescribed, performed without attachment, without likes or dislikes, and without desire for the fruit — that is called sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṁkāreṇa vā punaḥ kriyate bahulāyāsam tat rājasam udāhṛtam
yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṁkāreṇa vā punaḥ | kriyate bahulāyāsaṁ tad rājasam udāhṛtam ||24||
docs.text: That action which is performed with desire for fruits, with ego, and with great strain — that is declared to be rajasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: anubandham kṣayam hiṁsām anapekṣya ca pauruṣam mohāt ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam ucyate
anubandhaṁ kṣayaṁ hiṁsām anapekṣya ca pauruṣam | mohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam ucyate ||25||
docs.text: That action which is undertaken out of delusion, without regard for consequences, loss, injury to others, or one's own capability — that is called tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mukta-saṅgaḥ anahaṁ-vādī dhṛti utsāha samanvitaḥ siddhi asiddhyoḥ nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvikaḥ ucyate
mukta-saṅgo 'nahaṁ-vādī dhṛty-utsāha-samanvitaḥ | siddhyasiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate ||26||
docs.text: The doer who is free from attachment, non-egoistic, endowed with determination and enthusiasm, and unaffected by success or failure — is called sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: rāgī karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hiṁsātmako 'śuciḥ | harṣa-śokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||27||
rāgī karma-phala-prepsuḥ lubdhaḥ hiṁsātmakaḥ aśuciḥ harṣa-śokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
docs.text: The doer who is passionate, desirous of fruits of action, greedy, of violent nature, impure, and swayed by joy and sorrow — is declared to be rajasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭhaḥ naiṣkṛtikaḥ alasaḥ viṣādī dīrgha-sūtrī ca kartā tāmasaḥ ucyate
ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko 'lasaḥ | viṣādī dīrgha-sūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate ||28||
docs.text: The doer who is undisciplined, vulgar, obstinate, deceitful, malicious, lazy, despondent, and procrastinating — is called tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: buddher bhedaṁ dhṛteś caiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṁ śṛṇu | procyamānam aśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanañjaya ||29||
buddheḥ bhedam dhṛteḥ ca eva guṇataḥ tri-vidham śṛṇu procyamānam aśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanañjaya
docs.text: Hear now, O Dhananjaya, the threefold distinction of intellect and fortitude, according to the gunas, as I describe them fully and separately.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: pravṛttim ca nivṛttim kārya akārye bhaya abhaye bandham mokṣam ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
pravṛttiṁ ca nivṛttiṁ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye | bandhaṁ mokṣaṁ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||30||
docs.text: That intellect which knows when to engage and when to withdraw, what ought to be done and what ought not, what is to be feared and what is not, and what binds and what liberates — that intellect, O Partha, is sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yayā dharmam adharmam ca kāryam akāryam eva ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
yayā dharmam adharmaṁ ca kāryaṁ cākāryam eva ca | ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||31||
docs.text: That intellect which incorrectly understands dharma and adharma, and what ought to be done and what ought not to be done — that intellect, O Partha, is rajasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: adharmam dharmam iti yā manyate tamasā āvṛtā sarvārthān viparītān ca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
adharmaṁ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā | sarvārthān viparītāṁś ca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||32||
docs.text: That intellect which, enveloped in darkness, regards adharma as dharma and sees all things in a perverted way — that intellect, O Partha, is tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥ prāṇa indriya kriyāḥ yogena avyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥ-prāṇendriya-kriyāḥ | yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||33||
docs.text: That unwavering fortitude by which, through yoga, one sustains the activities of the mind, life-breath, and senses — that fortitude, O Partha, is sattvic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yayā tu dharma kāma arthān dhṛtyā dhārayate arjuna prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
yayā tu dharma-kāmārthān dhṛtyā dhārayate 'rjuna | prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||34||
docs.text: That fortitude by which one holds fast to duty, pleasure, and wealth with attachment and desire for their fruits — that fortitude, O Partha, is rajasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yayā svapnam bhayam śokam viṣādam madam eva ca na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
yayā svapnaṁ bhayaṁ śokaṁ viṣādaṁ madam eva ca | na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||35||
docs.text: That fortitude by which a person of poor understanding does not let go of excessive sleep, fear, grief, depression, and intoxication — that, O Partha, is tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.35

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sukham tu idānīm tri-vidham śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha abhyāsāt ramate yatra duḥkhāntam ca nigacchati
sukhaṁ tv idānīṁ tri-vidhaṁ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha | abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṁ ca nigacchati ||36||
docs.text: Now hear from Me, O best of the Bharatas, about the three kinds of happiness. That happiness which one enjoys through practice and by which one reaches the end of sorrow —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.36

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yat tad agre viṣam iva pariṇāme 'mṛtopamam | tat sukhaṁ sāttvikaṁ proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam ||37||
yat tat agre viṣam iva pariṇāme amṛtopamam tat sukham sāttvikam proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam
docs.text: That happiness which is like poison in the beginning but like nectar in the end, born from the clarity of self-knowledge — that is declared to be sattvic happiness.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.37

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: viṣaya indriya saṁyogāt yat tat agre amṛtopamam pariṇāme viṣam iva tat sukham rājasam smṛtam
viṣayendriya-saṁyogād yat tad agre 'mṛtopamam | pariṇāme viṣam iva tat sukhaṁ rājasaṁ smṛtam ||38||
docs.text: That happiness which arises from the contact of senses with sense objects, which is like nectar in the beginning but like poison in the end — that is declared to be rajasic happiness.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.38

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yad agre cānubandhe ca sukhaṁ mohanam ātmanaḥ | nidrālasya-pramādotthaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||39||
yat agre ca anubandhe sukham mohanam ātmanaḥ nidrā ālasya pramāda uttham tat tāmasam udāhṛtam
docs.text: That happiness which is deluding to the self both in the beginning and in the end, arising from sleep, laziness, and negligence — that is declared to be tamasic.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.39

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na tad asti pṛthivyāṁ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ | sattvaṁ prakṛti-jair muktaṁ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ ||40||
na tat asti pṛthivyām vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ sattvam prakṛti-jaiḥ muktam yat ebhiḥ syāt tribhiḥ guṇaiḥ
docs.text: There is no being on earth, or even among the gods in heaven, that is free from these three gunas born of material nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.40

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: brāhmaṇa kṣatriya viśām śūdrāṇām ca parantapa karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva-prabhavaiḥ guṇaiḥ
brāhmaṇa-kṣatriya-viśāṁ śūdrāṇāṁ ca parantapa | karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva-prabhavair guṇaiḥ ||41||
docs.text: The duties of brahmanas, kshatriyas, vaishyas, and shudras are distributed according to the qualities (gunas) born of their own nature, O Parantapa.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.41

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śamaḥ damaḥ tapaḥ śaucam kṣāntiḥ ārjavam jñānam vijñānam āstikyam brahma-karma svabhāva-jam
śamo damas tapaḥ śaucaṁ kṣāntir ārjavam eva ca | jñānaṁ vijñānam āstikyaṁ brahma-karma svabhāva-jam ||42||
docs.text: Serenity, self-control, austerity, purity, patience, honesty, knowledge, wisdom, and faith — these are the natural duties of a brahmana, born of their own nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.42

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śauryam tejaḥ dhṛtiḥ dākṣyam yuddhe ca api apalāyanam dānam īśvara-bhāvaḥ ca kṣātram karma svabhāva-jam
śauryaṁ tejo dhṛtir dākṣyaṁ yuddhe cāpy apalāyanam | dānam īśvara-bhāvaś ca kṣātraṁ karma svabhāva-jam ||43||
docs.text: Valor, vigor, firmness, resourcefulness, not fleeing in battle, generosity, and lordly nature — these are the natural duties of a kshatriya, born of their own nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.43

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kṛṣi gau-rakṣya vāṇijyam vaiśya-karma svabhāva-jam paricaryātmakam karma śūdrasya api svabhāva-jam
kṛṣi-gau-rakṣya-vāṇijyaṁ vaiśya-karma svabhāva-jam | paricaryātmakaṁ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāva-jam ||44||
docs.text: Agriculture, cattle-rearing, and trade are the natural duties of a vaishya, born of their own nature. Service is the natural duty of a shudra, born of their own nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.44

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sve sve karmaṇi abhirataḥ saṁsiddhim labhate naraḥ sva-karma-nirataḥ siddhim yathā vindati tat śṛṇu
sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ saṁsiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ | sva-karma-nirataḥ siddhiṁ yathā vindati tac chṛṇu ||45||
docs.text: Each person, devoted to their own duty, attains perfection. Hear how one devoted to their own work finds perfection.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.45

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yataḥ pravṛttir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam | sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarcya siddhiṁ vindati mānavaḥ ||46||
yataḥ pravṛttiḥ bhūtānām yena sarvam idam tatam sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarcya siddhim vindati mānavaḥ
docs.text: By worshipping through one's own duty Him from whom all beings originate and by whom all this is pervaded, a person attains perfection.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.46

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śreyān sva-dharmaḥ viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣṭhitāt svabhāva-niyatam karma kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam
śreyān sva-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣṭhitāt | svabhāva-niyataṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam ||47||
docs.text: Better is one's own dharma, though imperfectly performed, than the dharma of another, well performed. One does not incur sin performing duty prescribed by one's own nature.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.47

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sa-jam karma kaunteya sa-doṣam api na tyajet sarvārambhāḥ hi doṣeṇa dhūmena agniḥ iva āvṛtāḥ
sa-jaṁ karma kaunteya sa-doṣam api na tyajet | sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnir ivāvṛtāḥ ||48||
docs.text: One should not abandon one's inborn duty, O son of Kunti, even if it has faults. For all undertakings are enveloped by faults, as fire is covered by smoke.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.48

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigata-spṛhaḥ naiṣkarmya-siddhim paramām sannyāsena adhigacchati
asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigata-spṛhaḥ | naiṣkarmya-siddhiṁ paramāṁ sannyāsenādhigacchati ||49||
docs.text: One whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has conquered the self, and who is free from desires — such a person attains the supreme perfection of freedom from karma through renunciation.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.49

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: siddhim prāptaḥ yathā brahma tathā āpnoti nibodha me samāsena eva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me | samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā ||50||
docs.text: Learn from Me in brief, O son of Kunti, how one who has attained perfection also attains Brahman — the supreme culmination of knowledge.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.50

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: buddhyā viśuddhayā yuktaḥ dhṛtyā ātmānam niyamya ca śabdādīn viṣayān tyaktvā rāga-dveṣau vyudasya ca
buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṁ niyamya ca | śabdādīn viṣayāṁs tyaktvā rāga-dveṣau vyudasya ca ||51||
docs.text: Endowed with a purified intellect, controlling the self with fortitude, relinquishing sense objects like sound and others, and casting aside attachment and aversion —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.51

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vivikta-sevī laghv-āśī yata vāk kāya mānasaḥ dhyāna-yoga-paraḥ nityam vairāgyam samupāśritaḥ
vivikta-sevī laghv-āśī yata-vāk-kāya-mānasaḥ | dhyāna-yoga-paro nityaṁ vairāgyaṁ samupāśritaḥ ||52||
docs.text: Dwelling in solitude, eating lightly, controlling speech, body, and mind, constantly devoted to meditation, and taking refuge in dispassion —
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.52

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ahaṁkāram balam darpam kāmam krodham parigraham vimucya nirmamaḥ śāntaḥ brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
ahaṁkāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham | vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahma-bhūyāya kalpate ||53||
docs.text: Having given up ego, force, arrogance, desire, anger, and possessiveness — free from the sense of 'mine,' and peaceful — one becomes fit for becoming one with Brahman.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.53

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu mad-bhaktim labhate parām
brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati | samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu mad-bhaktiṁ labhate parām ||54||
docs.text: Established in Brahman, serene-souled, one neither grieves nor desires. Equal toward all beings, such a person attains supreme devotion to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.54

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaś cāsmi tattvataḥ | tato māṁ tattvato jñātvā viśate tad-anantaram ||55||
bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaḥ ca asmi tattvataḥ tataḥ mām tattvataḥ jñātvā viśate tad-anantaram
docs.text: Through devotion, one truly knows Me — who I am and how great I am, in truth. Then, having known Me in truth, one enters into Me immediately.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.55

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarva-karmāṇi api sadā kurvāṇaḥ mad-vyapāśrayaḥ mat-prasādāt avāpnoti śāśvatam padam avyayam
sarva-karmāṇy api sadā kurvāṇo mad-vyapāśrayaḥ | mat-prasādād avāpnoti śāśvataṁ padam avyayam ||56||
docs.text: Always performing all actions, but taking refuge in Me, one attains by My grace the eternal, imperishable abode.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.56

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: cetasā sarva-karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ buddhi-yogam upāśritya mac-cittaḥ satatam bhava
cetasā sarva-karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ | buddhi-yogam upāśritya mac-cittaḥ satataṁ bhava ||57||
docs.text: Mentally surrendering all actions to Me, regarding Me as the Supreme, taking refuge in the yoga of intellect — fix your mind on Me constantly.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.57

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: mac-cittaḥ sarva-durgāṇi mat-prasādāt tariṣyasi atha cet tvam ahaṁkārāt na śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi
mac-cittaḥ sarva-durgāṇi mat-prasādāt tariṣyasi | atha cet tvam ahaṁkārān na śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi ||58||
docs.text: With your mind fixed on Me, you will cross over all difficulties by My grace. But if, out of ego, you do not listen, you will perish.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.58

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yad ahaṁkāram āśritya na yotsya iti manyase | mithyaiṣa vyavasāyas te prakṛtis tvāṁ niyokṣyati ||59||
yat ahaṁkāram āśritya na yotsye iti manyase mithyā eṣaḥ vyavasāyaḥ te prakṛtiḥ tvām niyokṣyati
docs.text: If, taking refuge in your ego, you think 'I will not fight' — that resolve is false. Your own nature will compel you.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.59

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: svabhāva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā kartum na icchasi yat mohāt kariṣyasi avaśaḥ api tat
svabhāva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā | kartuṁ necchasi yan mohāt kariṣyasy avaśo 'pi tat ||60||
docs.text: Bound by your own karma born of your nature, O son of Kunti, that which you do not wish to do out of delusion, you will helplessly do even against your will.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.60

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: īśvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānām hṛd-deśe arjuna tiṣṭhati bhrāmayan sarva-bhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
īśvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ hṛd-deśe 'rjuna tiṣṭhati | bhrāmayan sarva-bhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā ||61||
docs.text: The Supreme Lord dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, causing all beings — mounted on the machine (of the body) — to revolve through Maya.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.61

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tam eva śaraṇam gaccha sarva-bhāvena bhārata tat-prasādāt parām śāntim sthānam prāpsyasi śāśvatam
tam eva śaraṇaṁ gaccha sarva-bhāvena bhārata | tat-prasādāt parāṁ śāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śāśvatam ||62||
docs.text: Take refuge in Him alone with all your being, O Bharata. By His grace, you will attain supreme peace and the eternal abode.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.62

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: iti jñānam ākhyātam guhyāt guhyataram vimṛśya aśeṣeṇa yathā icchasi tathā kuru
iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā | vimṛśyaitad aśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru ||63||
docs.text: Thus I have explained to you knowledge more secret than the secret. Reflect on it fully, and then do as you wish.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.63

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarva-guhyatamam bhūyaḥ śṛṇu paramam vacaḥ iṣṭaḥ asi me dṛḍham hitam
sarva-guhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṁ vacaḥ | iṣṭo'si me dṛḍham iti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam ||64||
docs.text: Hear again My supreme word, the most secret of all. You are very dear to Me, therefore I shall speak what is beneficial for you.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.64

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru | mām evaiṣyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo'si me ||65||
man-manāḥ bhava mad-bhaktaḥ mad-yājī mām namaskuru mām eva eṣyasi satyam pratijāne priyaḥ asi
docs.text: Fix your mind on Me, be devoted to Me, worship Me, bow to Me. You shall come to Me alone. I promise you truly, for you are dear to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.65

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekam śaraṇam vraja aham tvā sarva-pāpebhyaḥ mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja | ahaṁ tvā sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ ||66||
docs.text: Abandoning all dharmas, take refuge in Me alone. I shall liberate you from all sins. Do not grieve.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.66

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: idam na atapaskāya na abhaktāya kadācana na aśuśrūṣave na abhyasūyati
idaṁ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana | na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṁ na ca māṁ yo'bhyasūyati ||67||
docs.text: This should never be spoken to one who is without austerity, without devotion, who does not wish to hear, or who speaks ill of Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.67

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: ya imaṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ mad-bhakteṣv abhidhāsyati | bhaktiṁ mayi parāṁ kṛtvā mām evaiṣyaty asaṁśayaḥ ||68||
yaḥ imam paramam guhyam mad-bhakteṣu abhidhāsyati bhaktim parām mām eva eṣyati asaṁśayaḥ
docs.text: Whoever teaches this supreme secret to My devotees, performing the highest devotion to Me, shall undoubtedly come to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.68

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: na ca tasmān manuṣyeṣu kaścin me priya-kṛttamaḥ | bhavitā na ca me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi ||69||
na kaścit manuṣyeṣu priya-kṛttamaḥ bhavitā priyataraḥ bhuvi
docs.text: No one among humans is more dear to Me in service than such a person, nor shall anyone on earth be dearer to Me.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.69

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ | jñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ ||70||
adhyeṣyate dharmyam saṁvādam āvayoḥ jñāna-yajñena iṣṭaḥ syām matiḥ
docs.text: And whoever studies this sacred dialogue of ours — by that sacrifice of knowledge, I consider Myself worshipped. This is My conviction.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.70

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: śraddhāvān anasūyaś ca śṛṇuyād api yo naraḥ | so'pi muktaḥ śubhāṁl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām ||71||
śraddhāvān anasūyaḥ śṛṇuyāt naraḥ muktaḥ śubhān lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām
docs.text: Even the person who merely listens to this with faith and without envy shall be liberated and attain the auspicious worlds of the righteous.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.71

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: kaccid etac chrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā | kaccid ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣṭas te dhanañjaya ||72||
kaccit etat śrutam ekāgreṇa cetasā ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣṭaḥ dhanañjaya
docs.text: Has this been heard by you, O Partha, with one-pointed mind? Has your delusion born of ignorance been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.72

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: arjuna uvāca | naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayācyuta | sthito'smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṁ tava ||73||
naṣṭaḥ mohaḥ smṛtiḥ labdhā tvat-prasādāt acyuta sthitaḥ asmi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣye vacanam tava
docs.text: Arjuna said: My delusion is destroyed. I have gained wisdom by Your grace, O Achyuta. I am firm, free from doubt. I shall act according to Your word.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.73

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: sañjaya uvāca | ity ahaṁ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ | saṁvādam imam aśrauṣam adbhutaṁ roma-harṣaṇam ||74||
sañjayaḥ vāsudevasya pārthasya mahātmanaḥ saṁvādam aśrauṣam adbhutam roma-harṣaṇam
docs.text: Sanjaya said: Thus I have heard this wonderful dialogue between Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna, which makes the hair stand on end.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.74

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: vyāsa-prasādāc chrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param | yogaṁ yogeśvarāt kṛṣṇāt sākṣāt kathayataḥ svayam ||75||
vyāsa-prasādāt śrutavān guhyam param yogam yogeśvarāt kṛṣṇāt sākṣāt kathayataḥ svayam
docs.text: By the grace of Vyasa, I have heard this supreme and most secret yoga directly from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, speaking Himself.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.75

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: rājan saṁsmṛtya saṁsmṛtya saṁvādam adbhutam keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyam hṛṣyāmi muhuḥ muhuḥ
rājan saṁsmṛtya saṁsmṛtya saṁvādam imam adbhutam | keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṁ hṛṣyāmi ca muhur muhuḥ ||76||
docs.text: O King, remembering again and again this wonderful and sacred dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.76

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: tac ca saṁsmṛtya saṁsmṛtya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ | vismayo me mahān rājan hṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ ||77||
tat saṁsmṛtya saṁsmṛtya rūpam aty-adbhutam hareḥ vismayaḥ mahān hṛṣyāmi punaḥ punaḥ
docs.text: And remembering again and again that most wonderful form of Hari, great is my wonder, O King, and I rejoice again and again.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.77

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Bhagavad Gita
tags: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārthaḥ dhanur-dharaḥ tatra śrīḥ vijayaḥ bhūtiḥ dhruvā nītiḥ matiḥ mama
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ | tatra śrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama ||78||
docs.text: Wherever there is Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna, the wielder of the bow — there will be fortune, victory, glory, and firm righteousness. This is my conviction.
docs.title: Bhagavad Gita 18.78

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सावर्णिः सूर्यतनयो यो मनुः कथ्यतेऽष्टमः। निशामय तदुत्पत्तिं विस्तराद् गदतो मम॥
docs.text: Sāvarṇi, the Sun’s son, is spoken of as the eighth Manu. Listen as I tell you at length how he came to be.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: महामायानुभावेन यथा मन्वन्तराधिपः। स बभूव महाभागः सावर्णिस्तनयो रवेः॥
docs.text: Hear how, by the grace of Mahāmāyā, that blessed Sāvarṇi, son of the Sun, came to rule an age of the world.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे पूर्वं चैत्रवंशसमुद्भवः। सुरथो नाम राजाभूत्समस्ते क्षितिमण्डले॥
docs.text: Long ago, in the age of Svārociṣa Manu, there lived a king named Suratha, of the line of Caitra, who ruled the whole earth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्य पालयतः सम्यक् प्रजाः पुत्रानिवौरसान्। बभूवुः शत्रवो भूपाः कोलाविध्वंसिनस्तदा॥
docs.text: While he ruled his people justly, as though they were his own children, the kings called the Kolāvidhvaṃsins rose against him as enemies.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्य तैरभवद् युद्धमतिप्रबलदण्डिनः। न्यूनैरपि स तैर्युद्धे कोलाविध्वंसिभिर्जितः॥
docs.text: War broke out between them and the king, mighty as his forces were; and though they were the weaker side, the Kolāvidhvaṃsins defeated him in battle.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः स्वपुरमायातो निजदेशाधिपोऽभवत्। आक्रान्तः स महाभागस्तैस्तदा प्रबलारिभिः॥
docs.text: Then he withdrew to his own city and ruled only his own land; and even there that noble king was assailed by those enemies, now grown strong.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अमात्यैर्बलिभिर्दुष्टैर्दुर्बलस्य दुरात्मभिः। कोशो बलं चापहृतं तत्रापि स्वपुरे ततः॥
docs.text: Then, in his own city too, his powerful ministers — corrupt and wicked men — seized the weakened king’s treasury and army.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो मृगयाव्याजेन हृतस्वाम्यः स भूपतिः। एकाकी हयमारुह्य जगाम गहनं वनम्॥
docs.text: Stripped of his kingdom, the king rode out alone on horseback under the pretext of a hunt, and went into a deep forest.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स तत्राश्रममद्राक्षीद् द्विजवर्यस्य मेधसः। प्रशान्तश्वापदाकीर्णं मुनिशिष्योपशोभितम्॥
docs.text: There he came upon the hermitage of Medhas, foremost of brahmins — a place where even the wild beasts had grown gentle, graced by the sage’s disciples.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्थौ कंचित्स कालं च मुनिना तेन सत्कृतः। इतश्चेतश्च विचरंस्तस्मिन्मुनिवराश्रमे॥
docs.text: Welcomed with honour by the sage, he stayed there for a while, wandering here and there about the great sage’s hermitage.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सोऽचिन्तयत्तदा तत्र ममत्वाकृष्टचेतनः। मत्पूर्वैः पालितं पूर्वं मया हीनं पुरं हि तत् ॥
docs.text: Then, his mind still held by the sense of ‘mine’, he brooded: ‘That city my forefathers once protected, now bereft of me —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मद्भृत्यैस्तैरसद्वृत्तैर्धर्मतः पाल्यते न वा। न जाने स प्रधानो मे शूरहस्ती सदामदः॥
docs.text: is it being ruled justly by those faithless servants of mine, or not? I cannot know. And my chief war-elephant, ever in rut —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मम वैरिवशं यातः कान् भोगानुपलप्स्यते। ये ममानुगता नित्यं प्रसादधनभोजनैः॥
docs.text: now fallen into my enemies’ hands, what comforts will it find? And those who always followed me, won by my favour, my gifts and my table —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अनुवृत्तिं ध्रुवं तेऽद्य कुर्वन्त्यन्यमहीभृताम्। असम्यग्व्ययशीलैस्तैः कुर्वद्भिः सततं व्ययम्॥
docs.text: surely they now pay court to other kings. And by those wastrels, spending without pause —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: संचितः सोऽतिदुःखेन क्षयं कोशो गमिष्यति। एतच्चान्यच्च सततं चिन्तयामास पार्थिवः॥
docs.text: the treasury I gathered with such toil will be drained away.’ These and other thoughts filled the king’s mind without rest.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तत्र विप्राश्रमाभ्याशे वैश्यमेकं ददर्श सः। स पृष्टस्तेन कस्त्वं भो हेतुश्चागमनेऽत्र कः॥
docs.text: There, near the sage’s hermitage, he saw a merchant, and asked him: ‘Who are you, friend? What has brought you here?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सशोक इव कस्मात्त्वं दुर्मना इव लक्ष्यसे। इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य भूपतेः प्रणयोदितम्॥
docs.text: Why do you look so sorrowful, so heavy-hearted?’ Hearing these kindly words of the king,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: प्रत्युवाच स तं वैश्यः प्रश्रयावनतो नृपम्॥
docs.text: the merchant bowed respectfully and answered him.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: समाधिर्नाम वैश्योऽहमुत्पन्नो धनिनां कुले॥
docs.text: I am a merchant named Samādhi, born into a wealthy family.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पुत्रदारैर्निरस्तश्च धनलोभादसाधुभिः। विहीनश्च धनैर्दारैः पुत्रैरादाय मे धनम्॥
docs.text: My wicked sons and wife, greedy for my wealth, have driven me out. I am left without money, wife or sons; they have taken all I had,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: वनमभ्यागतो दुःखी निरस्तश्चाप्तबन्धुभिः। सोऽहं न वेद्मि पुत्राणां कुशलाकुशलात्मिकाम्॥
docs.text: and, cast off by the kinsmen I trusted, I have come to this forest in grief. Now I do not know whether things go well or ill with my sons,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: प्रवृत्तिं स्वजनानां च दाराणां चात्र संस्थितः। किं नु तेषां गृहे क्षेममक्षेमं किं नु साम्प्रतम्॥
docs.text: or with my kin and my wife, for I am here, far away. Is all well in their home now, or is it not?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कथं ते किं नु सद्वृत्ता दुर्वृत्ताः किं नु मे सुताः॥
docs.text: How are they? Are my sons living rightly now, or have they gone astray?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यैर्निरस्तो भवाँल्लुब्धैः पुत्रदारादिभिर्धनैः॥
docs.text: Those greedy ones — your sons, your wife and the rest — who drove you out for the sake of your wealth:
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तेषु किं भवतः स्नेहमनुबध्नाति मानसम्॥
docs.text: why does your mind still hold to them in affection?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एवमेतद्यथा प्राह भवानस्मद्गतं वचः॥
docs.text: It is just as you say about me.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: किं करोमि न बध्नाति मम निष्ठुरतां मनः। यैः संत्यज्य पितृस्नेहं धनलुब्धैर्निराकृतः॥
docs.text: What can I do? My heart will not grow hard. Those who, greedy for my wealth, threw off the love they owed their father and drove me out —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पतिस्वजनहार्दं च हार्दि तेष्वेव मे मनः। किमेतन्नाभिजानामि जानन्नपि महामते॥
docs.text: who threw off all feeling for husband and kinsman — toward them, still, my heart is full of love. I know all this, wise king, and yet I cannot understand it.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यत्प्रेमप्रवणं चित्तं विगुणेष्वपि बन्धुषु। तेषां कृते मे निःश्वासो दौर्मनस्यं च जायते॥
docs.text: — that my heart leans in love toward kinsfolk who have shown no virtue, and that I sigh and grieve for their sake.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: करोमि किं यन्न मनस्तेष्वप्रीतिषु निष्ठुरम्॥
docs.text: What am I to do? My heart will not harden against those who have no love for me.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततस्तौ सहितौ विप्र तं मुनिं समुपस्थितौ॥
docs.text: Then, O brahmin, the two went together to the sage:
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.36

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: समाधिर्नाम वैश्योऽसौ स च पार्थिवसत्तमः। कृत्वा तु तौ यथान्यायं यथार्हं तेन संविदम्॥
docs.text: the merchant Samādhi and the noble king. When they had greeted him with due courtesy, as was fitting,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.37

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: उपविष्टौ कथाः काश्चिच्चक्रतुर्वैश्यपार्थिवौ॥
docs.text: the merchant and the king sat down and spoke with him a while.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.38

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भगवंस्त्वामहं प्रष्टुमिच्छाम्येकं वदस्व तत्॥
docs.text: Revered sir, there is one thing I wish to ask you. Please explain it to me.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.40

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दुःखाय यन्मे मनसः स्वचित्तायत्ततां विना। ममत्वं गतराज्यस्य राज्याङ्गेष्वखिलेष्वपि॥
docs.text: My kingdom is gone, yet I still feel that every part of it is mine — against my own will, and to my mind’s distress,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.41

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: जानतोऽपि यथाज्ञस्य किमेतन्मुनिसत्तम। अयं च निकृतः पुत्रैर्दारैर्भृत्यैस्तथोज्झितः॥
docs.text: though I know better, as if I did not. What is this, best of sages? And this man too has been wronged and cast off by his sons, his wife and his servants,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.42

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स्वजनेन च संत्यक्तस्तेषु हार्दी तथाप्यति। एवमेष तथाहं च द्वावप्यत्यन्तदुःखितौ॥
docs.text: and deserted by his kin; yet he loves them dearly. So he and I alike are both in deep distress,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.43

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दृष्टदोषेऽपि विषये ममत्वाकृष्टमानसौ। तत्किमेतन्महाभाग यन्मोहो ज्ञानिनोरपि॥
docs.text: our minds dragged by the sense of ‘mine’ toward things whose faults we have plainly seen. Then what is this, blessed one — that even we, who know, are deluded?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.44

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ममास्य च भवत्येषा विवेकान्धस्य मूढता॥
docs.text: — this bewilderment, in him and in me, blind as we are to discernment.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.45

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ज्ञानमस्ति समस्तस्य जन्तोर्विषयगोचरे॥
docs.text: Every living creature has knowledge in the realm of the senses.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 1.47

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
