docs.text: Indra and all the gods could not hold their ground in battle against Śumbha and his host. How will you, a woman, go out to face them?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 5.125

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सा त्वं गच्छ मयैवोक्ता पार्श्वं शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः। केशाकर्षणनिर्धूतगौरवा मा गमिष्यसि॥
docs.text: Go, then, to Śumbha and Niśumbha now, at my word alone — lest you go dragged there by the hair, stripped of your honour.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 5.126

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एवमेतद् बली शुम्भो निशुम्भश्चातिवीर्यवान्। किं करोमि प्रतिज्ञा मे यदनालोचिता पुरा॥
docs.text: It is just as you say: Śumbha is mighty, and Niśumbha of surpassing valour. But what can I do? My vow was made long ago, without thought.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 5.128

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स त्वं गच्छ मयोक्तं ते यदेतत्सर्वमादृतः। तदाचक्ष्वासुरेन्द्राय स च युक्तं करोतु तत्॥
docs.text: Go, then, and tell the lord of the asuras faithfully all that I have said to you; and let him do whatever he thinks fit.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 5.129

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: इत्याकर्ण्य वचो देव्याः स दूतोऽमर्षपूरितः। समाचष्ट समागम्य दैत्यराजाय विस्तरात्॥
docs.text: When he had heard these words of the Devī, the messenger, seething with indignation, went back and told the king of the daityas everything at length.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्य दूतस्य तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्यासुरराट् ततः। सक्रोधः प्राह दैत्यानामधिपं धूम्रलोचनम्॥
docs.text: When the lord of the asuras heard the messenger’s report, he flew into a rage and said to Dhūmralocana, a commander of the daityas:
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हे धूम्रलोचनाशु त्वं स्वसैन्यपरिवारितः। तामानय बलाद् दुष्टां केशाकर्षणविह्वलाम्॥
docs.text: Dhūmralocana, take your army and bring that insolent woman here at once — by force, dragged helpless by the hair.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तत्परित्राणदः कश्चिद्यदि वोत्तिष्ठतेऽपरः। स हन्तव्योऽमरो वापि यक्षो गन्धर्व एव वा॥
docs.text: And if anyone else comes forward to protect her — god, yakṣa or gandharva — kill him.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तेनाज्ञप्तस्ततः शीघ्रं स दैत्यो धूम्रलोचनः। वृतः षष्ट्या सहस्राणामसुराणां द्रुतं ययौ॥
docs.text: So commanded, the daitya Dhūmralocana set off at once and marched in haste, with sixty thousand asuras around him.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स दृष्ट्वा तां ततो देवीं तुहिनाचलसंस्थिताम्। जगादोच्चैः प्रयाहीति मूलं शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः॥
docs.text: When he saw the Devī standing on the snowy mountain, he called out loudly: “Go to Śumbha and Niśumbha!”
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: न चेत्प्रीत्याद्य भवती मद्भर्तारमुपैष्यति। ततो बलान्नयाम्येष केशाकर्षणविह्वलाम्॥
docs.text: If you will not come to my master willingly now, then I will take you there by force, dragged helpless by the hair.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दैत्येश्वरेण प्रहितो बलवान् बलसंवृतः। बलान्नयसि मामेवं ततः किं ते करोम्यहम्॥
docs.text: You were sent by the lord of the daityas; you are strong, and you have an army with you. If you take me by force like this, what can I do to you?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: इत्युक्तः सोऽभ्यधावत्तामसुरो धूम्रलोचनः। हुंकारेणैव तं भस्म सा चकाराम्बिका ततः॥
docs.text: At these words the asura Dhūmralocana rushed at her; and Ambikā, with nothing more than the sound ‘huṃ’, burned him to ashes.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अथ क्रुद्धं महासैन्यमसुराणां तथाम्बिका। ववर्ष सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तथा शक्तिपरश्वधैः॥
docs.text: Then Ambikā showered the furious host of the asuras with sharp arrows, with spears and with axes.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो धुतसटः कोपात्कृत्वा नादं सुभैरवम्। पपातासुरसेनायां सिंहो देव्याः स्ववाहनः॥
docs.text: Then the lion, the Devī’s own mount, shook its mane in fury, let out a terrible roar, and fell upon the asura army.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कांश्चित् करप्रहारेण दैत्यानास्येन चापरान्। आक्रम्य चाधरेणान्यान् स जघान महासुरान्॥
docs.text: He slew the great asuras: some with a blow of his paw, others with his jaws, and others he pinned down and killed with his lower jaw.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: केषांचित्पाटयामास नखैः कोष्ठानि केसरी। तथा तलप्रहारेण शिरांसि कृतवान् पृथक्॥
docs.text: With his claws the lion ripped open the bellies of some; with blows of his paw he struck off heads.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: विच्छिन्नबाहुशिरसः कृतास्तेन तथापरे। पपौ च रुधिरं कोष्ठादन्येषां धुतकेसरः॥
docs.text: Others he left with arms and heads hewn off; and, tossing his mane, he drank the blood from the bellies of others.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: क्षणेन तद्बलं सर्वं क्षयं नीतं महात्मना। तेन केसरिणा देव्या वाहनेनातिकोपिना॥
docs.text: In a moment the whole army was destroyed by that mighty lion, the Devī’s furious mount.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: श्रुत्वा तमसुरं देव्या निहतं धूम्रलोचनम्। बलं च क्षयितं कृत्स्नं देवीकेसरिणा ततः॥
docs.text: When he heard that the asura Dhūmralocana had been slain by the Devī, and his whole army destroyed by her lion,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: चुकोप दैत्याधिपतिः शुम्भः प्रस्फुरिताधरः। आज्ञापयामास च तौ चण्डमुण्डौ महासुरौ॥
docs.text: Śumbha, lord of the daityas, was enraged; his lip trembled, and he gave his orders to the two great asuras Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa:
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हे चण्ड हे मुण्ड बलैर्बहुभिः परिवारितौ। तत्र गच्छत गत्वा च सा समानीयतां लघु॥
docs.text: Caṇḍa! Muṇḍa! Take a great force with you and go there; and when you arrive, have her brought here at once.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: केशेष्वाकृष्य बद्ध्वा वा यदि वः संशयो युधि। तदाशेषायुधैः सर्वैरसुरैर्विनिहन्यताम्॥
docs.text: Drag her by the hair or bind her, and bring her. If the fight should leave the outcome in doubt, then let all the asuras strike her down with every weapon they have.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्यां हतायां दुष्टायां सिंहे च विनिपातिते। शीघ्रमागम्यतां बद्ध्वा गृहीत्वा तामथाम्बिकाम्॥
docs.text: When that wicked woman has been struck down and her lion felled, then seize Ambikā, bind her, and come back at once.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 6.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: आज्ञप्तास्ते ततो दैत्याश्चण्डमुण्डपुरोगमाः। चतुरङ्गबलोपेता ययुरभ्युद्यतायुधाः॥
docs.text: So commanded, the Daityas marched out, Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa at their head, with an army of all four arms and their weapons raised.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ददृशुस्ते ततो देवीमीषद्धासां व्यवस्थिताम्। सिंहस्योपरि शैलेन्द्रशृङ्गे महति काञ्चने॥
docs.text: There they saw the Goddess, a faint smile on her face, seated on her lion upon a great golden summit of the king of mountains.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ते दृष्ट्वा तां समादातुमुद्यमं चक्रुरुद्यताः। आकृष्टचापासिधरास्तथान्ये तत्समीपगाः॥
docs.text: Seeing her, some made ready and moved to seize her; others, with bows drawn and swords bared, closed in around her.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः कोपं चकारोच्चैरम्बिका तानरीन् प्रति। कोपेन चास्या वदनं मषीवर्णमभूत्तदा॥
docs.text: Then Ambikā’s anger rose high against those enemies, and in her wrath her face turned black as ink.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भ्रुकुटीकुटिलात्तस्या ललाटफलकाद्द्रुतम्। काली करालवदना विनिष्क्रान्तासिपाशिनी॥
docs.text: From her forehead, knotted in a frown, there sprang at once Kālī, terrible of face, armed with sword and noose.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: विचित्रखट्वाङ्गधरा नरमालाविभूषणा। द्वीपिचर्मपरीधाना शुष्कमांसातिभैरवा॥
docs.text: She bore a strange skull-staff and wore a garland of human heads; a leopard’s hide was her garment, and her withered flesh made her more terrible still.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अतिविस्तारवदना जिह्वाललनभीषणा। निमग्नारक्तनयना नादापूरितदिङ्मुखा॥
docs.text: Her mouth gaped wide, her lolling tongue struck terror, her sunken eyes were red, and her roar filled every quarter of the sky.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सा वेगेनाभिपतिता घातयन्ती महासुरान्। सैन्ये तत्र सुरारीणामभक्षयत तद्बलम्॥
docs.text: She fell upon them with a rush, cutting down the great asuras, and there in the ranks of the gods’ enemies she devoured that host.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पार्ष्णिग्राहाङ्कुशग्राहियोधघण्टासमन्वितान्। समादायैकहस्तेन मुखे चिक्षेप वारणान्॥
docs.text: Gathering up the war elephants in one hand, with their rear-riders, their drivers, their fighting men and their bells, she flung them into her mouth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तथैव योधं तुरगै रथं सारथिना सह। निक्षिप्य वक्त्रे दशनैश्चर्वयन्त्यतिभैरवम्॥
docs.text: In the same way she thrust into her mouth the horsemen with their horses and the chariots with their drivers, and crunched them hideously between her teeth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एकं जग्राह केशेषु ग्रीवायामथ चापरम्। पादेनाक्रम्य चैवान्यमुरसान्यमपोथयत्॥
docs.text: One she caught by the hair, another by the throat; one she trampled underfoot, and another she crushed against her breast.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तैर्मुक्तानि च शस्त्राणि महास्त्राणि तथासुरैः। मुखेन जग्राह रुषा दशनैर्मथितान्यपि॥
docs.text: The weapons and the great missiles the asuras hurled at her she caught in her mouth in her fury, and ground them to pieces between her teeth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: बलिनां तद् बलं सर्वमसुराणां दुरात्मनाम्। ममर्दाभक्षयच्चान्यानन्यांश्चाताडयत्तथा॥
docs.text: She trampled that whole army of mighty, evil-minded asuras: some she devoured, and others she beat to the ground.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: असिना निहताः केचित्केचित्खट्वाङ्गताडिताः। जग्मुर्विनाशमसुरा दन्ताग्राभिहतास्तथा॥
docs.text: Some fell to her sword, some to her skull-staff, and others to the points of her teeth: so the asuras perished.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: क्षणेन तद् बलं सर्वमसुराणां निपातितम्। दृष्ट्वा चण्डोऽभिदुद्राव तां कालीमतिभीषणाम्॥
docs.text: When Caṇḍa saw the whole asura army laid low in a moment, he rushed at Kālī, terrible as she was.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शरवर्षैर्महाभीमैर्भीमाक्षीं तां महासुरः। छादयामास चक्रैश्च मुण्डः क्षिप्तैः सहस्रशः॥
docs.text: The great asura Caṇḍa buried the dread-eyed goddess under volleys of fearsome arrows, and Muṇḍa under discuses hurled by the thousand.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तानि चक्राण्यनेकानि विशमानानि तन्मुखम्। बभुर्यथार्कबिम्बानि सुबहूनि घनोदरम्॥
docs.text: The countless discuses vanishing into her mouth shone like a multitude of suns sinking into the heart of a dark cloud.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो जहासातिरुषा भीमं भैरवनादिनी। कालीकरालवक्त्रान्तर्दुर्दर्शदशनोज्ज्वला॥
docs.text: Then Kālī, roaring dreadfully, laughed a terrible laugh in her fury, the fearsome teeth in her gaping mouth flashing with light.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: उत्थाय च महासिंहं देवी चण्डमधावत। गृहीत्वा चास्य केशेषु शिरस्तेनासिनाच्छिनत्॥
docs.text: Mounting the great lion, the Goddess charged at Caṇḍa, seized him by the hair, and with that sword struck off his head.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अथ मुण्डोऽभ्यधावत्तां दृष्ट्वा चण्डं निपातितम्। तमप्यपातयद्भूमौ सा खड्गाभिहतं रुषा॥
docs.text: Seeing Caṇḍa fallen, Muṇḍa charged at her; and she in her fury struck him with her sword and brought him to the ground as well.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हतशेषं ततः सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा चण्डं निपातितम्। मुण्डं च सुमहावीर्यं दिशो भेजे भयातुरम्॥
docs.text: Then the remnant of the army, seeing Caṇḍa slain and the mighty Muṇḍa too, scattered in terror to every quarter.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शिरश्चण्डस्य काली च गृहीत्वा मुण्डमेव च। प्राह प्रचण्डाट्टहासमिश्रमभ्येत्य चण्डिकाम्॥
docs.text: Then Kālī took up the heads of Caṇḍa and of Muṇḍa, came to Caṇḍikā, and spoke, breaking into savage peals of laughter:
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मया तवात्रोपहृतौ चण्डमुण्डौ महापशू। युद्धयज्ञे स्वयं शुम्भं निशुम्भं च हनिष्यसि॥
docs.text: Here I have brought you Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa, two great victims for your offering. In this sacrifice of battle you yourself shall slay Śumbha and Niśumbha.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तावानीतौ ततो दृष्ट्वा चण्डमुण्डौ महासुरौ। उवाच कालीं कल्याणी ललितं चण्डिका वचः॥
docs.text: Seeing the two great asuras, Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa, brought before her, gracious Caṇḍikā spoke gently to Kālī:
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यस्माच्चण्डं च मुण्डं च गृहीत्वा त्वमुपागता। चामुण्डेति ततो लोके ख्याता देवि भविष्यसि॥
docs.text: Since you have come to me bearing Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa, you shall be known in the world, O Goddess, as Cāmuṇḍā.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 7.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: चण्डे च निहते दैत्ये मुण्डे च विनिपातिते। बहुलेषु च सैन्येषु क्षयितेष्वसुरेश्वरः॥
docs.text: When the demon Caṇḍa had been slain and Muṇḍa struck down, and their many troops destroyed, the lord of the asuras —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः कोपपराधीनचेताः शुम्भः प्रतापवान्। उद्योगं सर्वसैन्यानां दैत्यानामादिदेश ह॥
docs.text: — Śumbha, the mighty, his mind wholly mastered by anger, ordered all the Daitya armies to march.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अद्य सर्वबलैर्दैत्याः षडशीतिरुदायुधाः। कम्बूनां चतुरशीतिर्निर्यान्तु स्वबलैर्वृताः॥
docs.text: “Today let the eighty-six Daitya clans march out with all their forces, weapons raised, and the eighty-four clans of the Kambus, each surrounded by its own troops.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कोटिवीर्याणि पञ्चाशदसुराणां कुलानि वै। शतं कुलानि धौम्राणां निर्गच्छन्तु ममाज्ञया॥
docs.text: Let the fifty asura clans of the Koṭivīryas, and the hundred clans of the Dhaumras, march out at my command.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कालका दौर्हृदा मौर्याः कालकेयास्तथासुराः। युद्धाय सज्जा निर्यान्तु आज्ञया त्वरिता मम॥
docs.text: Let the Kālakas, the Daurhṛdas, the Mauryas and the Kālakeyas — every asura — march out at once at my command, armed for battle.”
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: इत्याज्ञाप्यासुरपतिः शुम्भो भैरवशासनः। निर्जगाम महासैन्यसहस्रैर्बहुभिर्वृतः॥
docs.text: Having given these orders, Śumbha, lord of the asuras, whose commands were dreaded, set out, surrounded by many thousands of mighty troops.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: आयान्तं चण्डिका दृष्ट्वा तत्सैन्यमतिभीषणम्। ज्यास्वनैः पूरयामास धरणीगगनान्तरम्॥
docs.text: Seeing Śumbha approach with his dreadful army, Caṇḍikā filled the space between earth and sky with the twanging of her bowstring.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः सिंहो महानादमतीव कृतवान् नृप। घण्टास्वनेन तन्नादमम्बिका चोपबृंहयत्॥
docs.text: Then, O king, the lion gave a mighty roar, and Ambikā swelled that roar with the clanging of her bell.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: धनुर्ज्यासिंहघण्टानां नादापूरितदिङ्मुखा। निनादैर्भीषणैः काली जिग्ये विस्तारितानना॥
docs.text: With the twang of the bow, the lion’s roar and the clang of the bell filling every quarter, Kālī, her mouth gaping wide, outdid them all with her terrible roars.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तं निनादमुपश्रुत्य दैत्यसैन्यैश्चतुर्दिशम्। देवी सिंहस्तथा काली सरोषैः परिवारिताः॥
docs.text: Hearing that roar, the furious Daitya armies closed in on every side around the Goddess, the lion and Kālī.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भूप विनाशाय सुरद्विषाम्। भवायामरसिंहानामतिवीर्यबलान्विताः॥
docs.text: At that very moment, O king, to destroy the enemies of the gods and for the good of the foremost of the immortals, (powers) endowed with surpassing valour and might —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ब्रह्मेशगुहविष्णूनां तथेन्द्रस्य च शक्तयः। शरीरेभ्यो विनिष्क्रम्य तद्रूपैश्चण्डिकां ययुः॥
docs.text: — the Śaktis of Brahmā, Śiva, Skanda and Viṣṇu, and of Indra too, came forth from their bodies and went to Caṇḍikā, each in the form of her god.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यस्य देवस्य यद्रूपं यथाभूषणवाहनम्। तद्वदेव हि तच्छक्तिरसुरान् योद्धुमाययौ॥
docs.text: Whatever form each god had, whatever his ornaments and his mount, in just that form his Śakti came to fight the asuras.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हंसयुक्तविमानाग्रे साक्षसूत्रकमण्डलुः। आयाता ब्रह्मणः शक्तिर्ब्रह्माणी साभिधीयते॥
docs.text: Brahmā’s Śakti came seated in a chariot drawn by swans, bearing a rosary and a water-pot. She is called Brahmāṇī.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: माहेश्वरी वृषारूढा त्रिशूलवरधारिणी। महाहिवलया प्राप्ता चन्द्ररेखाविभूषणा॥
docs.text: Māheśvarī came, riding the bull and bearing a mighty trident, with great serpents for her bracelets and the crescent moon for her ornament.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कौमारी शक्तिहस्ता च मयूरवरवाहना। योद्धुमभ्याययौ दैत्यानम्बिका गुहरूपिणी॥
docs.text: Kaumārī, spear in hand and riding a splendid peacock, came forward to fight the Daityas — the Mother in the form of Guha.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तथैव वैष्णवी शक्तिर्गरुडोपरि संस्थिता। शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गखड्गहस्ताभ्युपाययौ॥
docs.text: In the same way Viṣṇu’s Śakti, Vaiṣṇavī, came near, seated on Garuḍa, bearing conch, discus, mace, the bow Śārṅga and the sword.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यज्ञवाराहमतुलं रूपं या बिभ्रतो हरेः। शक्तिः साप्याययौ तत्र वाराहीं बिभ्रती तनुम्॥
docs.text: The Śakti of Hari — of him who takes the matchless form of the Sacrificial Boar — came there too, in the body of a boar.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: नारसिंही नृसिंहस्य बिभ्रती सदृशं वपुः। प्राप्ता तत्र सटाक्षेपक्षिप्तनक्षत्रसंहतिः॥
docs.text: Nārasiṃhī came there in a body like the Man-Lion’s, the tossing of her mane scattering the hosts of stars.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: वज्रहस्ता तथैवैन्द्री गजराजोपरि स्थिता। प्राप्ता सहस्रनयना यथा शक्रस्तथैव सा॥
docs.text: Aindrī came likewise, thunderbolt in hand, mounted on the king of elephants and thousand-eyed — in every way as Indra is.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः परिवृतस्ताभिरीशानो देवशक्तिभिः। हन्यन्तामसुराः शीघ्रं मम प्रीत्याऽऽह चण्डिकाम्॥
docs.text: Then Śiva, surrounded by those Śaktis of the gods, said to Caṇḍikā, “Let the asuras be slain at once, for my sake.”
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो देवीशरीरात्तु विनिष्क्रान्तातिभीषणा। चण्डिकाशक्तिरत्युग्रा शिवाशतनिनादिनी॥
docs.text: Then from the body of the Goddess there came forth Caṇḍikā’s Śakti — most terrible, exceedingly fierce, howling like a hundred jackals.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सा चाह धूम्रजटिलमीशानमपराजिता। दूत त्वं गच्छ भगवन् पार्श्वं शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः॥
docs.text: And she, the Unconquered, said to the ash-grey, matted-haired Śiva: “Go, Lord, as my messenger to Śumbha and Niśumbha.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ब्रूहि शुम्भं निशुम्भं च दानवावतिगर्वितौ। ये चान्ये दानवास्तत्र युद्धाय समुपस्थिताः॥
docs.text: Say to Śumbha and Niśumbha, those two arrogant Dānavas, and to all the other Dānavas gathered there for battle:
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: त्रैलोक्यमिन्द्रो लभतां देवाः सन्तु हविर्भुजः। यूयं प्रयात पातालं यदि जीवितुमिच्छथ॥
docs.text: ‘Let Indra have the three worlds, and let the gods receive the sacrificial offerings. As for you, go down to Pātāla, if you wish to live.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: बलावलेपादथ चेद्भवन्तो युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः। तदागच्छत तृप्यन्तु मच्छिवाः पिशितेन वः॥
docs.text: But if, proud of your strength, you long for battle, then come — and let my jackals feast on your flesh.’
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यतो नियुक्तो दौत्येन तया देव्या शिवः स्वयम्। शिवदूतीति लोकेस्मिंस्ततः सा ख्यातिमागता॥
docs.text: Because she made Śiva himself her messenger, the Goddess became known in this world as Śivadūtī — ‘she whose messenger is Śiva’.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तेऽपि श्रुत्वा वचो देव्याः शर्वाख्यातं महासुराः। अमर्षापूरिता जग्मुर्यत्र कात्यायनी स्थिता॥
docs.text: And the great asuras, hearing the Goddess’s message as Śiva delivered it, went, seething with indignation, to where Kātyāyanī stood.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः प्रथममेवाग्रे शरशक्त्यृष्टिवृष्टिभिः। ववर्षुरुद्धतामर्षास्तां देवीममरारयः॥
docs.text: Then the enemies of the gods, their fury roused, at once rained down on the Goddess from the front showers of arrows, spears and swords.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सा च तान् प्रहितान् बाणाञ्छूलशक्तिपरश्वधान्। चिच्छेद लीलयाऽऽध्मातधनुर्मुक्तैर्महेषुभिः॥
docs.text: And with great arrows loosed from her thrumming bow she cut down, as if in play, the arrows, pikes, spears and axes they had hurled.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्याग्रतस्तथा काली शूलपातविदारितान्। खट्वाङ्गपोथितांश्चारीन् कुर्वती व्यचरत्तदा॥
docs.text: So too Kālī ranged at the front of the fight, tearing the foe with blows of her spear and crushing them with her skull-staff.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कमण्डलुजलाक्षेपहतवीर्यान् हतौजसः। ब्रह्माणी चाकरोच्छत्रून् येन येन स्म धावति॥
docs.text: Wherever Brahmāṇī moved, she sprinkled the enemies with water from her water-pot and left them drained of valour and strength.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: माहेश्वरी त्रिशूलेन तथा चक्रेण वैष्णवी। दैत्याञ्जघान कौमारी तथा शक्त्यातिकोपना॥
docs.text: Māheśvarī struck the Daityas down with her trident, Vaiṣṇavī with her discus, and Kaumārī, blazing with anger, with her spear.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ऐन्द्रीकुलिशपातेन शतशो दैत्यदानवाः। पेतुर्विदारिताः पृथ्व्यां रुधिरौघप्रवर्षिणः॥
docs.text: Torn apart by the strokes of Aindrī’s thunderbolt, Daityas and Dānavas fell to the earth in their hundreds, pouring out streams of blood.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.35

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तुण्डप्रहारविध्वस्ता दंष्ट्राग्रक्षतवक्षसः। वाराहमूर्त्या न्यपतंश्चक्रेण च विदारिताः॥
docs.text: Shattered by the blows of her snout, their chests gored by the tips of her tusks, torn apart by her discus, the asuras fell before Vārāhī.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.36

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: नखैर्विदारितांश्चान्यान् भक्षयन्ती महासुरान्। नारसिंही चचाराजौ नादापूर्णदिगम्बरा॥
docs.text: Nārasiṃhī ranged over the field, filling the quarters and the sky with her roar, tearing other great asuras with her claws and devouring them.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.37

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: चण्डाट्टहासैरसुराः शिवदूत्यभिदूषिताः। पेतुः पृथिव्यां पतितांस्तांश्चखादाथ सा तदा॥
docs.text: Struck down by Śivadūtī’s fierce peals of laughter, the asuras fell to the ground, and there she devoured them.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.38

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: इति मातृगणं क्रुद्धं मर्दयन्तं महासुरान्। दृष्ट्वाभ्युपायैर्विविधैर्नेशुर्देवारिसैनिकाः॥
docs.text: When they saw the furious band of Mothers crushing the great asuras, the soldiers of the gods’ enemies slipped away, each however he could.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.39

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पलायनपरान् दृष्ट्वा दैत्यान् मातृगणार्दितान्। योद्धुमभ्याययौ क्रुद्धो रक्तबीजो महासुरः॥
docs.text: When he saw the Daityas, harried by the Mothers, turning to flee, the great asura Raktabīja advanced in fury to fight.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.40

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: रक्तबिन्दुर्यदा भूमौ पतत्यस्य शरीरतः। समुत्पतति मेदिन्यां तत्प्रमाणस्तदासुरः॥
docs.text: Whenever a drop of his blood fell to the ground, an asura of his own stature sprang up from the earth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.41

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: युयुधे स गदापाणिरिन्द्रशक्त्या महासुरः। ततश्चैन्द्री स्ववज्रेण रक्तबीजमताडयत्॥
docs.text: Mace in hand, the great asura fought with Indra’s power, and Aindrī struck Raktabīja with her thunderbolt.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.42

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कुलिशेनाहतस्याशु बहु सुस्राव शोणितम्। समुत्तस्थुस्ततो योधास्तद्रूपास्तत्पराक्रमाः॥
docs.text: Struck by the thunderbolt, he bled at once and freely, and from that blood rose warriors with his form and his strength.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.43

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यावन्तः पतितास्तस्य शरीराद्रक्तबिन्दवः। तावन्तः पुरुषा जातास्तद्वीर्यबलविक्रमाः॥
docs.text: For every drop of blood that fell from his body a warrior was born, with his valour, his strength and his prowess.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.44

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ते चापि युयुधुस्तत्र पुरुषा रक्तसम्भवाः। समं मातृभिरत्युग्रशस्त्रपातातिभीषणम्॥
docs.text: The warriors born of the blood fought the Mothers too, a battle made terrible by the crash of savage weapons.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.45

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पुनश्च वज्रपातेन क्षतमस्य शिरो यदा। ववाह रक्तं पुरुषास्ततो जाताः सहस्रशः॥
docs.text: Again the thunderbolt struck and wounded his head; the blood poured out, and from it warriors were born in their thousands.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.46

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: वैष्णवी समरे चैनं चक्रेणाभिजघान ह। गदया ताडयामास ऐन्द्री तमसुरेश्वरम्॥
docs.text: Vaiṣṇavī struck him in battle with her discus, and Aindrī struck the asura lord with a mace.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.47

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: वैष्णवीचक्रभिन्नस्य रुधिरस्रावसम्भवैः। सहस्रशो जगद्व्याप्तं तत्प्रमाणैर्महासुरैः॥
docs.text: From the blood that streamed from him when Vaiṣṇavī’s discus split him open, great asuras of his stature were born in thousands and filled the world.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.48

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शक्त्या जघान कौमारी वाराही च तथासिना। माहेश्वरी त्रिशूलेन रक्तबीजं महासुरम्॥
docs.text: Kaumārī struck the great asura Raktabīja with her spear, Vārāhī with her sword, and Māheśvarī with her trident.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.49

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स चापि गदया दैत्यः सर्वा एवाहनत् पृथक्। मातॄः कोपसमाविष्टो रक्तबीजो महासुरः॥
docs.text: Raktabīja, the great asura, in a fury, struck back at every one of the Mothers in turn with his mace.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.50

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्याहतस्य बहुधा शक्तिशूलादिभिर्भुवि। पपात यो वै रक्तौघस्तेनासञ्छतशोऽसुराः॥
docs.text: Struck again and again by spears, tridents and the rest, he poured a flood of blood upon the ground, and from it asuras arose in their hundreds.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.51

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तैश्चासुरासृक्सम्भूतैरसुरैः सकलं जगत्। व्याप्तमासीत्ततो देवा भयमाजग्मुरुत्तमम्॥
docs.text: The whole world was overrun by those asuras born of the asura’s blood, and the gods were seized with the greatest fear.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.52

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तान् विषण्णान् सुरान् दृष्ट्वा चण्डिका प्राहसत्वरा। उवाच कालीं चामुण्डे विस्तीर्णं वदनं कुरु॥
docs.text: Seeing the gods in despair, Caṇḍikā spoke at once. She said to Kālī: ‘Cāmuṇḍā, open your mouth wide.’
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.53

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मच्छस्त्रपातसम्भूतान् रक्तबिन्दून्महासुरान्। रक्तबिन्दोः प्रतीच्छ त्वं वक्त्रेणानेन वेगिना॥
docs.text: With this swift mouth of yours catch the drops of blood my weapons draw from him, and the great asuras born from those drops.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.54

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भक्षयन्ती चर रणे तदुत्पन्नान्महासुरान्। एवमेष क्षयं दैत्यः क्षीणरक्तो गमिष्यति॥
docs.text: Range over the field and devour the great asuras born from his blood. So, drained of blood, this Daitya will perish.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.55

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भक्ष्यमाणास्त्वया चोग्रा न चोत्पत्स्यन्ति चापरे। इत्युक्त्वा तां ततो देवी शूलेनाभिजघान तम्॥
docs.text: ‘As you devour the fierce ones, no others will be born.’ So she spoke to Kālī, and then the Goddess struck him with her spear.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.56

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मुखेन काली जगृहे रक्तबीजस्य शोणितम्। ततोऽसावाजघानाथ गदया तत्र चण्डिकाम्॥
docs.text: Kālī caught Raktabīja’s blood in her mouth. Then he struck at Caṇḍikā there with his mace.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.57

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: न चास्या वेदनां चक्रे गदापातोऽल्पिकामपि। तस्याहतस्य देहात्तु बहु सुस्राव शोणितम्॥
docs.text: His mace-blow caused her not the slightest pain, while from his wounded body the blood poured out.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.58

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यतस्ततस्तद्वक्त्रेण चामुण्डा सम्प्रतीच्छति। मुखे समुद्गता येऽस्या रक्तपातान्महासुराः॥
docs.text: Wherever it flowed, Cāmuṇḍā caught the blood in her mouth; and the great asuras who sprang up in her mouth from that blood —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.59

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तांश्चखादाथ चामुण्डा पपौ तस्य च शोणितम्। देवी शूलेन वज्रेण बाणैरसिभिर्ऋष्टिभिः॥
docs.text: — Cāmuṇḍā devoured them, and drank his blood. Then the Goddess, with spear and thunderbolt, with arrows, swords and double-edged blades …
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.60

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: जघान रक्तबीजं तं चामुण्डापीतशोणितम्। स पपात महीपृष्ठे शस्त्रसङ्घसमाहतः॥
docs.text: struck down Raktabīja, whose blood Cāmuṇḍā had drunk. Smitten by that host of weapons, he fell to the ground,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.61

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: नीरक्तश्च महीपाल रक्तबीजो महासुरः। ततस्ते हर्षमतुलमवापुस्त्रिदशा नृप॥
docs.text: drained of his blood, O lord of the earth — Raktabīja, the great asura. Then the gods, O king, were filled with boundless joy.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.62

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तेषां मातृगणो जातो ननर्तासृङ्मदोद्धतः॥
docs.text: And the band of Mothers born from the gods danced, wild with the blood they had drunk.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 8.63

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: विचित्रमिदमाख्यातं भगवन् भवता मम। देव्याश्चरितमाहात्म्यं रक्तबीजवधाश्रितम्॥
docs.text: Holy sir, what you have told me is wonderful: the glory of the Goddess’s deeds in the slaying of Raktabīja.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भूयश्चेच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं रक्तबीजे निपातिते। चकार शुम्भो यत्कर्म निशुम्भश्चातिकोपनः॥
docs.text: I wish to hear more: once Raktabīja had been struck down, what did Śumbha do, and Niśumbha in his towering rage?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: चकार कोपमतुलं रक्तबीजे निपातिते। शुम्भासुरो निशुम्भश्च हतेष्वन्येषु चाहवे॥
docs.text: With Raktabīja struck down and the others slain in battle, the asura Śumbha and Niśumbha flew into a rage beyond all measure.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हन्यमानं महासैन्यं विलोक्यामर्षमुद्वहन्। अभ्यधावन्निशुम्भोऽथ मुख्ययासुरसेनया॥
docs.text: Seeing his great army being cut down, Niśumbha, seething with fury, charged forward with the pick of the asura host.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्याग्रतस्तथा पृष्ठे पार्श्वयोश्च महासुराः। संदष्टौष्ठपुटाः क्रुद्धा हन्तुं देवीमुपाययुः॥
docs.text: Before him, behind him and on either flank the great asuras advanced, biting their lips in rage, bent on killing the Goddess.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: आजगाम महावीर्यः शुम्भोऽपि स्वबलैर्वृतः। निहन्तुं चण्डिकां कोपात्कृत्वा युद्धं तु मातृभिः॥
docs.text: Mighty Śumbha too came on, ringed by his own troops, to slay Caṇḍikā in his wrath, after doing battle with the Mothers.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो युद्धमतीवासीद्देव्या शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः। शरवर्षमतीवोग्रं मेघयोरिव वर्षतोः॥
docs.text: Then a furious battle broke out between the Goddess and Śumbha and Niśumbha, who poured on her a terrible shower of arrows, like two storm-clouds pouring rain.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: चिच्छेदास्ताञ्छरांस्ताभ्यां चण्डिका स्वशरोत्करैः। ताडयामास चाङ्गेषु शस्त्रौघैरसुरेश्वरौ॥
docs.text: Caṇḍikā cut down the arrows the two of them shot with volleys of her own, and struck the two asura lords all over their bodies with a torrent of weapons.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: निशुम्भो निशितं खड्गं चर्म चादाय सुप्रभम्। अताडयन्मूर्ध्नि सिंहं देव्या वाहनमुत्तमम्॥
docs.text: Niśumbha took up a keen sword and a gleaming shield and struck the lion, the Goddess’s noble mount, on the head.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ताडिते वाहने देवी क्षुरप्रेणासिमुत्तमम्। निशुम्भस्याशु चिच्छेद चर्म चाप्यष्टचन्द्रकम्॥
docs.text: When her mount was struck, the Goddess swiftly cut through Niśumbha’s fine sword with a razor-headed arrow, and his shield emblazoned with eight moons as well.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: छिन्ने चर्मणि खड्गे च शक्तिं चिक्षेप सोऽसुरः। तामप्यस्य द्विधा चक्रे चक्रेणाभिमुखागताम्॥
docs.text: With his shield and sword cut down, the asura hurled a śakti; and as it flew straight at her, she split it in two with her discus.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कोपाध्मातो निशुम्भोऽथ शूलं जग्राह दानवः। आयातं मुष्टिपातेन देवी तच्चाप्यचूर्णयत्॥
docs.text: Then Niśumbha the Dānava, bursting with rage, seized a spear; and as it came at her the Goddess smashed it to dust with a blow of her fist.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: आविध्याथ गदां सोऽपि चिक्षेप चण्डिकां प्रति। सापि देव्या त्रिशूलेन भिन्ना भस्मत्वमागता॥
docs.text: Then he whirled a mace and hurled it at Caṇḍikā; but it too, split by the Goddess’s trident, was reduced to ashes.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः परशुहस्तं तमायान्तं दैत्यपुङ्गवम्। आहत्य देवी बाणौघैरपातयत भूतले॥
docs.text: Then, as the chief of the Daityas came on, axe in hand, the Goddess struck him with volleys of arrows and brought him down to the ground.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्मिन्निपतिते भूमौ निशुम्भे भीमविक्रमे। भ्रातर्यतीव संक्रुद्धः प्रययौ हन्तुमम्बिकाम्॥
docs.text: When Niśumbha of terrible might, his brother, had fallen to the ground, Śumbha, wild with rage, set out to kill Ambikā.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स रथस्थस्तथात्युच्चैर्गृहीतपरमायुधैः। भुजैरष्टाभिरतुलैर्व्याप्याशेषं बभौ नभः॥
docs.text: Standing in his chariot, his eight matchless arms raised high, gripping mighty weapons, Śumbha blazed, filling the whole sky.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तमायान्तं समालोक्य देवी शङ्खमवादयत्। ज्याशब्दं चापि धनुषश्चकारातीव दुःसहम्॥
docs.text: Seeing him advance, the Goddess blew her conch and drew from her bowstring a twang that was all but unbearable.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पूरयामास ककुभो निजघण्टास्वनेन च। समस्तदैत्यसैन्यानां तेजोवधविधायिना॥
docs.text: And she filled every quarter of the sky with the ringing of her bell, a sound that drained the strength of all the Daitya hosts.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः सिंहो महानादैस्त्याजितेभमहामदैः। पूरयामास गगनं गां तथैव दिशो दश॥
docs.text: Then the lion filled the sky, the earth and all ten directions with thunderous roars that broke the frenzy of the war-elephants.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः काली समुत्पत्य गगनं क्ष्मामताडयत्। कराभ्यां तन्निनादेन प्राक्स्वनास्ते तिरोहिताः॥
docs.text: Then Kālī leapt up and struck the sky and the earth with both her hands, and the crash of it drowned every sound that had gone before.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अट्टाट्टहासमशिवं शिवदूती चकार ह। तैः शब्दैरसुरास्त्रेसुः शुम्भः कोपं परं ययौ॥
docs.text: Śivadūtī broke into a terrible, rolling laughter. At that sound the asuras shook with fear, and Śumbha flew into a towering rage.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दुरात्मंस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति व्याजहाराम्बिका यदा। तदा जयेत्यभिहितं देवैराकाशसंस्थितैः॥
docs.text: When Ambikā cried, ‘Stand, you wicked one, stand!’, the gods watching from the sky called out, ‘Victory!’
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शुम्भेनागत्य या शक्तिर्मुक्ता ज्वालातिभीषणा। आयान्ती वह्निकूटाभा सा निरस्ता महोल्कया॥
docs.text: Śumbha came on and hurled a dart wreathed in dreadful flames. As it came, blazing like a mountain of fire, it was struck aside by a great firebrand.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सिंहनादेन शुम्भस्य व्याप्तं लोकत्रयान्तरम्। निर्घातनिःस्वनो घोरो जितवानवनीपते॥
docs.text: Śumbha’s lion-like roar filled the whole expanse of the three worlds; but a dreadful crash like thunder drowned it, O king.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शुम्भमुक्ताञ्छरान्देवी शुम्भस्तत्प्रहिताञ्छरान्। चिच्छेद स्वशरैरुग्रैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
docs.text: The Goddess cut down the arrows Śumbha loosed, and Śumbha the arrows she sent, each with fierce arrows of their own, by hundreds and by thousands.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः सा चण्डिका क्रुद्धा शूलेनाभिजघान तम्। स तदाभिहतो भूमौ मूर्च्छितो निपपात ह॥
docs.text: Then Caṇḍikā in her anger struck him with her spear, and Śumbha, struck down, fell senseless to the earth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो निशुम्भः सम्प्राप्य चेतनामात्तकार्मुकः। आजघान शरैर्देवीं कालीं केसरिणं तथा॥
docs.text: Then Niśumbha came to his senses, seized his bow, and shot his arrows at the Goddess, at Kālī, and at the lion.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पुनश्च कृत्वा बाहूनामयुतं दनुजेश्वरः। चक्रायुधेन दितिजश्छादयामास चण्डिकाम्॥
docs.text: Again the Dānava lord took on ten thousand arms, and the son of Diti buried Caṇḍikā under a hail of discuses.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो भगवती क्रुद्धा दुर्गा दुर्गार्तिनाशिनी। चिच्छेद तानि चक्राणि स्वशरैः सायकांश्च तान्॥
docs.text: Then the blessed Durgā, who ends all distress in hard places, in her anger cut those discuses to pieces with her arrows, and his arrows too.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो निशुम्भो वेगेन गदामादाय चण्डिकाम्। अभ्यधावत वै हन्तुं दैत्यसेनासमावृतः॥
docs.text: Then Niśumbha seized a mace and, with the daitya army all around him, charged at Caṇḍikā to kill her.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्यापतत एवाशु गदां चिच्छेद चण्डिका। खड्गेन शितधारेण स च शूलं समाददे॥
docs.text: Before he could reach her, Caṇḍikā’s keen sword had cut through his mace; and he snatched up a spear.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शूलहस्तं समायान्तं निशुम्भममरार्दनम्। हृदि विव्याध शूलेन वेगाविद्धेन चण्डिका॥
docs.text: As Niśumbha, scourge of the gods, came at her spear in hand, Caṇḍikā drove her spear with all her force into his heart.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भिन्नस्य तस्य शूलेन हृदयान्निःसृतोऽपरः। महाबलो महावीर्यस्तिष्ठेति पुरुषो वदन्॥
docs.text: Out of his pierced heart came another being, mighty and valiant, crying, ‘Stop!’
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.35

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्य निष्क्रामतो देवी प्रहस्य स्वनवत्ततः। शिरश्चिच्छेद खड्गेन ततोऽसावपतद्भुवि॥
docs.text: Then the Goddess laughed aloud and with her sword struck off the head of the one who was coming forth, and he fell to the earth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.36

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः सिंहश्चखादोग्रं दंष्ट्राक्षुण्णशिरोधरान्। असुरांस्तांस्तथा काली शिवदूती तथापरान्॥
docs.text: Then the lion savagely devoured the asuras, crushing their necks in its jaws, and Kālī and Śivadūtī devoured others in the same way.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.37

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कौमारीशक्तिनिर्भिन्नाः केचिन्नेशुर्महासुराः। ब्रह्माणीमन्त्रपूतेन तोयेनान्ये निराकृताः॥
docs.text: Some of the great asuras perished, pierced by Kaumārī’s spear; others were routed by water hallowed with Brahmāṇī’s mantras.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.38

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: माहेश्वरीत्रिशूलेन भिन्नाः पेतुस्तथापरे। वाराहीतुण्डघातेन केचिच्चूर्णीकृता भुवि॥
docs.text: Others fell, run through by Māheśvarī’s trident; and some the blows of Vārāhī’s snout ground to dust upon the earth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.39

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: खण्डं खण्डं च चक्रेण वैष्णव्या दानवाः कृताः। वज्रेण चैन्द्रीहस्ताग्रविमुक्तेन तथापरे॥
docs.text: Vaiṣṇavī’s discus hacked the Dānavas to pieces, and others in the same way were cut down by the thunderbolt that flew from Aindrī’s hand.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.40

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: केचिद्विनेशुरसुराः केचिन्नष्टा महाहवात्। भक्षिताश्चापरे कालीशिवदूतीमृगाधिपैः॥
docs.text: Some of the asuras perished, some fled from the great battle, and others were devoured by Kālī, Śivadūtī and the lion.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 9.41

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: निशुम्भं निहतं दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं प्राणसम्मितम्। हन्यमानं बलं चैव शुम्भः क्रुद्धोऽब्रवीद्वचः॥
docs.text: When Śumbha saw his brother Niśumbha, dear to him as life, lying slain, and his army being cut down, he spoke in fury.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: बलावलेपाद् दुष्टे त्वं मा दुर्गे गर्वमावह। अन्यासां बलमाश्रित्य युद्ध्यसे यातिमानिनी॥
docs.text: Wicked Durgā, do not swell with pride in your power! For all your arrogance, you fight leaning on the strength of others.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एकैवाहं जगत्यत्र द्वितीया का ममापरा। पश्यैता दुष्ट मय्येव विशन्त्यो मद्विभूतयः॥
docs.text: I am alone in this world. Who else is there besides me? See, wicked one: these powers of mine are entering into me.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः समस्तास्ता देव्यो ब्रह्माणीप्रमुखा लयम्। तस्या देव्यास्तनौ जग्मुरेकैवासीत्तदाम्बिका॥
docs.text: Then all those goddesses, Brahmāṇī and the rest, dissolved into the Goddess’s body, and Ambikā stood alone.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अहं विभूत्या बहुभिरिह रूपैर्यदास्थिता। तत्संहृतं मयैकैव तिष्ठाम्याजौ स्थिरो भव॥
docs.text: Through my power I stood here in many forms; those I have withdrawn. Now I stand alone on the battlefield — stand firm!
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं देव्याः शुम्भस्य चोभयोः। पश्यतां सर्वदेवानामसुराणां च दारुणम्॥
docs.text: Then, as all the gods and the asuras looked on, a terrible battle began between the two, the Goddess and Śumbha.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शरवर्षैः शितैः शस्त्रैस्तथास्त्रैश्चैव दारुणैः। तयोर्युद्धमभूद्भूयः सर्वलोकभयङ्करम्॥
docs.text: With volleys of arrows, keen-edged weapons and fearsome missiles the battle between them raged on, terrifying all the worlds.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि शतशो मुमुचे यान्यथाम्बिका। बभञ्ज तानि दैत्येन्द्रस्तत्प्रतीघातकर्तृभिः॥
docs.text: The divine missiles Ambikā loosed by the hundred, the Daitya king shattered with counter-weapons.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मुक्तानि तेन चास्त्राणि दिव्यानि परमेश्वरी। बभञ्ज लीलयैवोग्रहुङ्कारोच्चारणादिभिः॥
docs.text: And the divine missiles he released, the supreme Goddess broke as if in play, with a fierce cry of ‘hum’ and other such means.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः शरशतैर्देवीमाच्छादयत सोऽसुरः। सापि तत्कुपिता देवी धनुश्चिच्छेद चेषुभिः॥
docs.text: Then the asura covered the Goddess with arrows by the hundred; and she, angered, cut his bow apart with her own arrows.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: छिन्ने धनुषि दैत्येन्द्रस्तथा शक्तिमथाददे। चिच्छेद देवी चक्रेण तामप्यस्य करे स्थिताम्॥
docs.text: His bow cut through, the Daitya lord seized a spear; that too the Goddess cut with her discus while it was still in his hand.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः खड्गमुपादाय शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्। अभ्यधावत्तदा देवीं दैत्यानामधिपेश्वरः॥
docs.text: Then the overlord of the Daityas took up a sword and a gleaming shield adorned with a hundred moons, and charged at the Goddess.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्यापतत एवाशु खड्गं चिच्छेद चण्डिका। धनुर्मुक्तैः शितैर्बाणैश्चर्म चार्ककरामलम्॥
docs.text: As he rushed in, Caṇḍikā swiftly cut his sword in two, and with keen arrows from her bow she split his shield, bright as sunlight.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हताश्वः स तदा दैत्यश्छिन्नधन्वा विसारथिः। जग्राह मुद्गरं घोरमम्बिकानिधनोद्यतः॥
docs.text: Then the Daitya, his horses killed, his bow cut, his charioteer gone, still bent on killing Ambikā, seized a dreadful mace.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: चिच्छेदापततस्तस्य मुद्गरं निशितैः शरैः। तथापि सोऽभ्यधावत्तां मुष्टिमुद्यम्य वेगवान्॥
docs.text: As he charged, she cut his mace apart with keen arrows; even so he rushed at her, fist raised, in his fury.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स मुष्टिं पातयामास हृदये दैत्यपुङ्गवः। देव्यास्तं चापि सा देवी तलेनोरस्यताडयत्॥
docs.text: The mightiest of the Daityas brought his fist down on the Goddess’s heart; and she in turn struck him on the chest with the flat of her hand.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तलप्रहाराभिहतो निपपात महीतले। स दैत्यराजः सहसा पुनरेव तथोत्थितः॥
docs.text: Felled by the blow of her open hand, he crashed to the ground — and at once the Daitya king was on his feet again.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: उत्पत्य च प्रगृह्योच्चैर्देवीं गगनमास्थितः। तत्रापि सा निराधारा युयुधे तेन चण्डिका॥
docs.text: He sprang up, seized the Goddess, and rose high into the sky; and there too, with nothing to stand on, Caṇḍikā fought him.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: नियुद्धं खे तदा दैत्यश्चण्डिका च परस्परम्। चक्रतुः प्रथमं सिद्धमुनिविस्मयकारकम्॥
docs.text: There in the sky the Daitya and Caṇḍikā grappled with each other, a fight such as had never been seen, which filled the siddhas and the sages with wonder.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो नियुद्धं सुचिरं कृत्वा तेनाम्बिका सह। उत्पात्य भ्रामयामास चिक्षेप धरणीतले॥
docs.text: After wrestling with him a long while, Ambikā lifted him high, whirled him round and flung him down to the earth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स क्षिप्तो धरणीं प्राप्य मुष्टिमुद्यम्य वेगितः। अभ्यधावत दुष्टात्मा चण्डिकानिधनेच्छया॥
docs.text: Hurled down, he struck the earth, then sprang at her, fist raised, the evil one, still longing to kill Caṇḍikā.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तमायान्तं ततो देवी सर्वदैत्यजनेश्वरम्। जगत्यां पातयामास भित्त्वा शूलेन वक्षसि॥
docs.text: Then, as the lord of all the Daityas came at her, the Goddess pierced his chest with her trident and struck him down to the earth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स गतासुः पपातोर्व्यां देवीशूलाग्रविक्षतः। चालयन् सकलां पृथ्वीं साब्धिद्वीपां सपर्वताम्॥
docs.text: Pierced by the point of the Goddess’s trident, he fell lifeless to the ground, and the whole earth shook — its oceans, its continents and its mountains.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः प्रसन्नमखिलं हते तस्मिन् दुरात्मनि। जगत्स्वास्थ्यमतीवाप निर्मलं चाभवन्नभः॥
docs.text: When that wicked one was slain, the whole world grew serene and was restored to perfect health, and the sky became clear.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: उत्पातमेघाः सोल्का ये प्रागासंस्ते शमं ययुः। सरितो मार्गवाहिन्यस्तथासंस्तत्र पातिते॥
docs.text: The ominous clouds and falling meteors that had been seen before all vanished, and once he had fallen, the rivers flowed again within their banks.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो देवगणाः सर्वे हर्षनिर्भरमानसाः। बभूवुर्निहते तस्मिन् गन्धर्वा ललितं जगुः॥
docs.text: Then, with Śumbha slain, all the hosts of the gods were filled with joy, and the gandharvas sang sweetly.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अवादयंस्तथैवान्ये ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः। ववुः पुण्यास्तथा वाताः सुप्रभोऽभूद्दिवाकरः॥
docs.text: Others played music, the apsarases danced, pure winds blew, and the sun shone brightly.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: जज्वलुश्चाग्नयः शान्ताः शान्ता दिग्जनितस्वनाः॥
docs.text: The fires blazed up, steady and calm, and the noises that had sounded from every quarter fell still.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 10.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: देव्या हते तत्र महासुरेन्द्रे सेन्द्राः सुरा वह्निपुरोगमास्ताम्। कात्यायनीं तुष्टुवुरिष्टलाभाद् विकाशिवक्त्राब्जविकाशिताशाः॥
docs.text: When the Goddess had slain the mighty lord of the asuras, the gods, with Indra among them and Agni at their head, their faces shining like opened lotuses and lighting up every quarter for joy at their wish fulfilled, sang the praise of Kātyāyanī.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: देवि प्रपन्नार्तिहरे प्रसीद प्रसीद मातर्जगतोऽखिलस्य। प्रसीद विश्वेश्वरि पाहि विश्वं त्वमीश्वरी देवि चराचरस्य॥
docs.text: O Goddess, who take away the sorrow of all who come to you for refuge, be gracious! Be gracious, Mother of the whole world! Be gracious, Queen of the universe, and protect it! For you, O Goddess, are sovereign over all that moves and all that is still.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: आधारभूता जगतस्त्वमेका महीस्वरूपेण यतः स्थितासि। अपां स्वरूपस्थितया त्वयैत- दाप्यायते कृत्स्नमलङ्घ्यवीर्ये॥
docs.text: You alone are the ground on which the world rests, for you abide as the earth. And as the waters you nourish this whole world, O Goddess of invincible power.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: त्वं वैष्णवी शक्तिरनन्तवीर्या विश्वस्य बीजं परमासि माया। सम्मोहितं देवि समस्तमेतत् त्वं वै प्रसन्ना भुवि मुक्तिहेतुः॥
docs.text: You are Viṣṇu’s own power, boundless in might, the seed of the universe, the supreme Māyā. By you, O Goddess, this whole world is held in enchantment; and you, when you are gracious, are the cause of liberation on earth.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: विद्याः समस्तास्तव देवि भेदाः स्त्रियः समस्ताः सकला जगत्सु। त्वयैकया पूरितमम्बयैतत् का ते स्तुतिः स्तव्यपरा परोक्तिः॥
docs.text: Every branch of knowledge, O Goddess, is a form of you, and so is every woman in all the worlds. You alone, the Mother, fill this whole world. What praise can there be of you? Praise is lofty speech about something to be praised.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सर्वभूता यदा देवी स्वर्गमुक्तिप्रदायिनी। त्वं स्तुता स्तुतये का वा भवन्तु परमोक्तयः॥
docs.text: When you, the Goddess who are all that is, who grant both heaven and liberation, have been praised as that, what loftier words could be left to praise you?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सर्वस्य बुद्धिरूपेण जनस्य हृदि संस्थिते। स्वर्गापवर्गदे देवि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: You dwell as understanding in the heart of every being, and you grant both heaven and final release: O Goddess Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: कलाकाष्ठादिरूपेण परिणामप्रदायिनि। विश्वस्योपरतौ शक्ते नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: As the moments and measures of time you bring all things through their changes, and yours is the power that brings the universe to rest: O Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके। शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Blessing of all that is blessed, auspicious Śivā, who bring every aim to fulfilment, our refuge, three-eyed Gaurī: O Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सृष्टिस्थितिविनाशानां शक्तिभूते सनातनि। गुणाश्रये गुणमये नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Eternal one, you are the power that creates, sustains and destroys; the guṇas rest in you and are made of you: O Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शरणागतदीनार्तपरित्राणपरायणे। सर्वस्यार्तिहरे देवि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: You live to rescue the helpless and suffering who come to you for shelter, and you take away the sorrow of all: O Goddess Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हंसयुक्तविमानस्थे ब्रह्माणीरूपधारिणि। कौशाम्भःक्षरिके देवि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Riding the swan-drawn chariot in the form of Brahmāṇī, sprinkling the water hallowed with kuśa grass: O Goddess Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: त्रिशूलचन्द्राहिधरे महावृषभवाहिनि। माहेश्वरीस्वरूपेण नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Bearing the trident, the crescent moon and the serpent, riding the great bull in the form of Māheśvarī: O Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मयूरकुक्कुटवृते महाशक्तिधरेऽनघे। कौमारीरूपसंस्थाने नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Attended by peacock and cock, holding the mighty spear, spotless one in the form of Kaumārī: O Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गगृहीतपरमायुधे। प्रसीद वैष्णवीरूपे नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Holding the conch, the discus, the mace and the bow Śārṅga, those supreme weapons, in the form of Vaiṣṇavī — be gracious, O Nārāyaṇī; salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: गृहीतोग्रमहाचक्रे दंष्ट्रोद्धृतवसुंधरे। वराहरूपिणि शिवे नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Wielding the fierce great discus, raising the earth upon your tusk, auspicious one in the form of the Boar: O Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: नृसिंहरूपेणोग्रेण हन्तुं दैत्यान् कृतोद्यमे। त्रैलोक्यत्राणसहिते नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: In the terrible form of the Man-Lion you rose to slay the demons, intent on saving the three worlds: O Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: किरीटिनि महावज्रे सहस्रनयनोज्ज्वले। वृत्रप्राणहरे चैन्द्रि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Crowned, wielding the great thunderbolt, ablaze with a thousand eyes, Aindrī who took the life of Vṛtra — Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शिवदूतीस्वरूपेण हतदैत्यमहाबले। घोररूपे महारावे नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Appearing as Śivadūtī, destroyer of the daityas’ mighty host, terrible of form, loud of roar — Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दंष्ट्राकरालवदने शिरोमालाविभूषणे। चामुण्डे मुण्डमथने नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Fanged and fearful of face, garlanded with heads, Cāmuṇḍā, slayer of Muṇḍa — Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: लक्ष्मि लज्जे महाविद्ये श्रद्धे पुष्टिस्वधे ध्रुवे। महारात्रि महाऽविद्ये नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Fortune, Modesty, Great Knowledge, Faith, Nourishment, Svadhā, the Steadfast; Great Night and Great Ignorance — Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मेधे सरस्वति वरे भूति बाभ्रवि तामसि। नियते त्वं प्रसीदेशे नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Intelligence, Sarasvatī, most excellent, Prosperity, tawny Bābhravī, dark Tāmasī, Ordaining Power — be gracious, sovereign Lady. Nārāyaṇī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सर्वस्वरूपे सर्वेशे सर्वशक्तिसमन्विते। भयेभ्यस्त्राहि नो देवि दुर्गे देवि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: Form of all things, Lady of all, possessed of every power — protect us from every fear, Devī. Durgā, Devī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एतत्ते वदनं सौम्यं लोचनत्रयभूषितम्। पातु नः सर्वभीतिभ्यः कात्यायनि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: May this gentle face of yours, graced with three eyes, protect us from every fear. Kātyāyanī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ज्वालाकरालमत्युग्रमशेषासुरसूदनम्। त्रिशूलं पातु नो भीतेर्भद्रकालि नमोऽस्तु ते॥
docs.text: May your trident, fearsome with flames, fiercer than fierce, slayer of every asura, protect us from fear. Bhadrakālī, salutation to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हिनस्ति दैत्यतेजांसि स्वनेनापूर्य या जगत्। सा घण्टा पातु नो देवि पापेभ्योऽनः सुतानिव॥
docs.text: Your bell, whose sound fills the world and breaks the daityas’ strength — may that bell, Devī, guard us from our sins, as children are guarded.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: असुरासृग्वसापङ्कचर्चितस्ते करोज्ज्वलः। शुभाय खड्गो भवतु चण्डिके त्वां नता वयम्॥
docs.text: Your sword, flashing in your hand and smeared with the blood and fat of the asuras — may it be for our good, Caṇḍikā. We bow to you.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: रोगानशेषानपहंसि तुष्टा रुष्टा तु कामान् सकलानभीष्टान्। त्वामाश्रितानां न विपन्नराणां त्वामाश्रिता ह्याश्रयतां प्रयान्ति॥
docs.text: Pleased, you take away every illness; angered, every cherished hope. No misfortune befalls those who take refuge in you; those who take refuge in you become a refuge themselves.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एतत्कृतं यत्कदनं त्वयाद्य धर्मद्विषां देवि महासुराणाम्। रूपैरनेकैर्बहुधाऽऽत्ममूर्तिं कृत्वाम्बिके तत्प्रकरोति कान्या॥
docs.text: Today, Devī, you made your own form manifold in many shapes and wrought this slaughter of the great asuras who hated dharma. Ambikā, who else could do such a thing?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: विद्यासु शास्त्रेषु विवेकदीपे- ष्वाद्येषु वाक्येषु च का त्वदन्या। ममत्वगर्तेऽतिमहान्धकारे विभ्रामयत्येतदतीव विश्वम्॥
docs.text: In all knowledge and every scripture, in the ancient words that are lamps of discernment, who is there but you? And who but you sets this whole world whirling in the dark abyss of ‘mine’?
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.31

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: रक्षांसि यत्रोग्रविषाश्च नागा यत्रारयो दस्युबलानि यत्र। दावानलो यत्र तथाब्धिमध्ये तत्र स्थिता त्वं परिपासि विश्वम्॥
docs.text: Where demons are, and serpents of deadly venom, where enemies and robber bands, where the forest is ablaze, and out on the open sea — there you stand and guard the world.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: विश्वेश्वरि त्वं परिपासि विश्वं विश्वात्मिका धारयसीति विश्वम्। विश्वेशवन्द्या भवती भवन्ति विश्वाश्रया ये त्वयि भक्तिनम्राः॥
docs.text: Queen of the universe, you guard the universe; as its very self you hold the universe up. The lords of the universe revere you, and those who bow to you in devotion become the shelter of the universe.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: देवि प्रसीद परिपालय नोऽरिभीते- र्नित्यं यथासुरवधादधुनैव सद्यः। पापानि सर्वजगतां प्रशमं नयाशु उत्पातपाकजनितांश्च महोपसर्गान्॥
docs.text: Be gracious, Devī. Guard us always from fear of our foes, as you did just now, at once, by slaying the asuras. Swiftly bring to rest the sins of all the worlds and the great calamities that ripen from evil portents.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: प्रणतानां प्रसीद त्वं देवि विश्वार्तिहारिणि। त्रैलोक्यवासिनामीड्ये लोकानां वरदा भव॥
docs.text: Be gracious to those who bow before you, Devī, who take away the sorrow of the world. Praised by all who dwell in the three worlds, be the giver of boons to all the worlds.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.35

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: वरदाहं सुरगणा वरं यन्मनसेच्छथ। तं वृणुध्वं प्रयच्छामि जगतामुपकारकम्॥
docs.text: I am the giver of boons, you hosts of gods. Choose the boon your minds desire, one that will benefit the worlds, and I shall grant it.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.37

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सर्वाबाधाप्रशमनं त्रैलोक्यस्याखिलेश्वरि। एवमेव त्वया कार्यमस्मद्वैरिविनाशनम्॥
docs.text: O Sovereign of all, quell every affliction of the three worlds, and destroy our enemies just as you have done now.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.39

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते अष्टाविंशतिमे युगे। शुम्भो निशुम्भश्चैवान्यावुत्पत्स्येते महासुरौ॥
docs.text: In the age of Vaivasvata Manu, in its twenty-eighth cycle, two other great asuras named Śumbha and Niśumbha will be born.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.41

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: नन्दगोपगृहे जाता यशोदागर्भसम्भवा। ततस्तौ नाशयिष्यामि विन्ध्याचलनिवासिनी॥
docs.text: Born in the house of Nanda the cowherd, from the womb of Yaśodā, I shall then dwell on the Vindhya mountain and destroy them both.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.42

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पुनरप्यतिरौद्रेण रूपेण पृथिवीतले। अवतीर्य हनिष्यामि वैप्रचित्तांस्तु दानवान्॥
docs.text: And again, descending to earth in a form of utter ferocity, I shall slay the Dānavas born of Vipracitti.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.43

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भक्षयन्त्याश्च तानुग्रान् वैप्रचित्तान्महासुरान्। रक्ता दन्ता भविष्यन्ति दाडिमीकुसुमोपमाः॥
docs.text: And as I devour those fierce great asuras of Vipracitti’s line, my teeth will turn red, like the flowers of the pomegranate.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.44

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो मां देवताः स्वर्गे मर्त्यलोके च मानवाः। स्तुवन्तो व्याहरिष्यन्ति सततं रक्तदन्तिकाम्॥
docs.text: So the gods in heaven and men on earth will praise me and call me ever by the name Raktadantikā, the Red-toothed.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.45

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भूयश्च शतवार्षिक्यामनावृष्ट्यामनम्भसि। मुनिभिः संस्तुता भूमौ सम्भविष्याम्ययोनिजा॥
docs.text: And once more, when the earth lies a hundred years without rain or water, I shall appear on earth at the sages’ praise, born of no womb.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.46

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततः शतेन नेत्राणां निरीक्षिष्यामि यन्मुनीन्। कीर्तयिष्यन्ति मनुजाः शताक्षीमिति मां ततः॥
docs.text: Because I shall look upon the sages with a hundred eyes, men will call me Śatākṣī, the Hundred-eyed.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.47

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततोऽहमखिलं लोकमात्मदेहसमुद्भवैः। भरिष्यामि सुराः शाकैरावृष्टेः प्राणधारकैः॥
docs.text: Then, O gods, until the rains return, I shall feed the whole world with life-giving plants grown from my own body.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.48

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शाकम्भरीति विख्यातिं तदा यास्याम्यहं भुवि। तत्रैव च वधिष्यामि दुर्गमाख्यं महासुरम्॥
docs.text: Then I shall be famed on earth as Śākambharī, and in that same descent I shall slay the great asura called Durgama.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.49

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दुर्गा देवीति विख्यातं तन्मे नाम भविष्यति। पुनश्चाहं यदा भीमं रूपं कृत्वा हिमाचले॥
docs.text: That name of mine, Durgā Devī, will be renowned. And again, when I take a terrible form on the Himālaya,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.50

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: रक्षांसि भक्षयिष्यामि मुनीनां त्राणकारणात्। तदा मां मुनयः सर्वे स्तोष्यन्त्यानम्रमूर्तयः॥
docs.text: and devour the rākṣasas to protect the sages, then all the sages will bow low and praise me,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.51

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भीमा देवीति विख्यातं तन्मे नाम भविष्यति। यदारुणाख्यस्त्रैलोक्ये महाबाधां करिष्यति॥
docs.text: and my name will be renowned as Bhīmā Devī. When the asura called Aruṇa brings great oppression on the three worlds,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.52

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तदाहं भ्रामरं रूपं कृत्वाऽसंख्येयषट्पदम्। त्रैलोक्यस्य हितार्थाय वधिष्यामि महासुरम्॥
docs.text: then I shall take a form of countless bees and slay that great asura for the good of the three worlds.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.53

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भ्रामरीति च मां लोकास्तदा स्तोष्यन्ति सर्वतः। इत्थं यदा यदा बाधा दानवोत्था भविष्यति॥
docs.text: and people everywhere will then praise me as Bhrāmarī. Thus, whenever oppression born of the demons arises,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.54

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तदा तदावतीर्याहं करिष्याम्यरिसंक्षयम्॥
docs.text: each time I shall descend and destroy the enemies.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 11.55

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एभिः स्तवैश्च मां नित्यं स्तोष्यते यः समाहितः। तस्याहं सकलां बाधां नाशयिष्याम्यसंशयम्॥
docs.text: Whoever praises me daily with these hymns, with a mind at rest in me, every trouble of his I will surely destroy.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मधुकैटभनाशं च महिषासुरघातनम्। कीर्तयिष्यन्ति ये तद्वद् वधं शुम्भनिशुम्भयोः॥
docs.text: Those who recite the destruction of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, the slaying of Mahiṣāsura, and likewise the killing of Śumbha and Niśumbha —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां नवम्यां चैकचेतसः। श्रोष्यन्ति चैव ये भक्त्या मम माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्॥
docs.text: and those who, on the eighth, the fourteenth and the ninth days of the lunar fortnight, listen with devotion and undivided mind to this supreme account of my glory —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: न तेषां दुष्कृतं किञ्चिद् दुष्कृतोत्था न चापदः। भविष्यति न दारिद्र्यं न चैवेष्टवियोजनम्॥
docs.text: For them no sin will remain, nor the misfortunes that sin brings; they will know neither poverty nor parting from those they love.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शत्रुतो न भयं तस्य दस्युतो वा न राजतः। न शस्त्रानलतोयौघात्कदाचित्सम्भविष्यति॥
docs.text: He need never fear enemies, robbers or the king, nor weapons, fire or flood.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्मान्ममैतन्माहात्म्यं पठितव्यं समाहितैः। श्रोतव्यं च सदा भक्त्या परं स्वस्त्ययनं हि तत्॥
docs.text: So let this account of my glory be recited with a gathered mind and always heard with devotion; for it is the highest blessing.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: उपसर्गानशेषांस्तु महामारीसमुद्भवान्। तथा त्रिविधमुत्पातं माहात्म्यं शमयेन्मम॥
docs.text: My Māhātmya stills every affliction that pestilence brings, and the three kinds of evil omen.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यत्रैतत्पठ्यते सम्यङ् नित्यमायतने मम। सदा न तद्विमोक्ष्यामि सांनिध्यं तत्र मे स्थितम्॥
docs.text: Wherever in my shrine this is rightly recited every day, that place I will never leave: there my presence abides.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: बलिप्रदाने पूजायामग्निकार्ये महोत्सवे। सर्वं ममैतच्चरितमुच्चार्यं श्राव्यमेव च॥
docs.text: At every offering, at worship, at the fire rite and at great festivals, this whole story of my deeds should be recited and heard.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: जानताऽजानता वापि बलिपूजां तथा कृताम्। प्रतीच्छिष्याम्यहं प्रीत्या वह्निहोमं तथा कृतम्॥
docs.text: Whether the worship and offerings are made with knowledge or without it, I will accept them gladly, and the fire oblation too.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शरत्काले महापूजा क्रियते या च वार्षिकी। तस्यां ममैतन्माहात्म्यं श्रुत्वा भक्तिसमन्वितः॥
docs.text: At the great yearly worship held in autumn, the one who hears this account of my glory with devotion
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सर्वाबाधाविनिर्मुक्तो धनधान्यसुतान्वितः। मनुष्यो मत्प्रसादेन भविष्यति न संशयः॥
docs.text: will by my grace be freed from every trouble and blessed with wealth, grain and children. Of this there is no doubt.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: श्रुत्वा ममैतन्माहात्म्यं तथा चोत्पत्तयः शुभाः। पराक्रमं च युद्धेषु जायते निर्भयः पुमान्॥
docs.text: One who hears this account of my glory — my auspicious manifestations and my valour in battle — becomes free of fear.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: रिपवः संक्षयं यान्ति कल्याणं चोपपद्यते। नन्दते च कुलं पुंसां माहात्म्यं मम शृण्वताम्॥
docs.text: For those who hear my glory, enemies perish, good fortune comes, and their family flourishes.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: शान्तिकर्मणि सर्वत्र तथा दुःस्वप्नदर्शने। ग्रहपीडासु चोग्रासु माहात्म्यं शृणुयान्मम॥
docs.text: At every rite for averting harm, after an evil dream, and when the planets afflict severely, let my glory be heard.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: उपसर्गाः शमं यान्ति ग्रहपीडाश्च दारुणाः। दुःस्वप्नं च नृभिर्दृष्टं सुस्वप्नमुपजायते॥
docs.text: Calamities are stilled, and the harsh afflictions of the planets; and the evil dream that men have seen turns into a good one.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: बालग्रहाभिभूतानां बालानां शान्तिकारकम्। संघातभेदे च नृणां मैत्रीकरणमुत्तमम्॥
docs.text: It brings peace to children seized by evil spirits, and when men who were bound together fall apart, it is the best way to make them friends again.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दुर्वृत्तानामशेषाणां बलहानिकरं परम्। रक्षोभूतपिशाचानां पठनादेव नाशनम्॥
docs.text: It utterly breaks the power of all evil-doers, and by its recitation alone it destroys demons, ghosts and goblins.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सर्वं ममैतन्माहात्म्यं मम सन्निधिकारकम्। पशुपुष्पार्घ्यधूपैश्च गन्धदीपैस्तथोत्तमैः॥
docs.text: This whole account of my glory makes me present. With offerings of animals, flowers, water and incense, with the finest perfumes and lamps —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: विप्राणां भोजनैर्होमैः प्रोक्षणीयैरहर्निशम्। अन्यैश्च विविधैर्भोगैः प्रदानैर्वत्सरेण या॥
docs.text: with the feeding of brāhmaṇas, with oblations and lustrations day and night, with every other kind of offering and gift — the delight these give me in a whole year
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: प्रीतिर्मे क्रियते सास्मिन् सकृत्सुचरिते श्रुते। श्रुतं हरति पापानि तथाऽऽरोग्यं प्रयच्छति॥
docs.text: The delight that a whole year of such worship gives me, a single hearing of this holy story gives me too. Heard, it takes away sins and grants health.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: रक्षां करोति भूतेभ्यो जन्मनां कीर्तनं मम। युद्धेषु चरितं यन्मे दुष्टदैत्यनिबर्हणम्॥
docs.text: The telling of my births guards against evil spirits. And the story of my battles, in which the wicked Daityas were destroyed —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तस्मिञ्छ्रुते वैरिकृतं भयं पुंसां न जायते। युष्माभिः स्तुतयो याश्च याश्च ब्रह्मर्षिभिः कृताः॥
docs.text: When it is heard, no fear of enemies arises in anyone. And the hymns that you have sung, and those composed by the great seers,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ब्रह्मणा च कृतास्तास्तु प्रयच्छन्ति शुभां मतिम्। अरण्ये प्रान्तरे वापि दावाग्निपरिवारितः॥
docs.text: and the hymn of Brahmā — these grant a mind turned to the good. In a forest or on a lonely road, ringed by a forest fire,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दस्युभिर्वा वृतः शून्ये गृहीतो वापि शत्रुभिः। सिंहव्याघ्रानुयातो वा वने वा वनहस्तिभिः॥
docs.text: beset by robbers in some lonely place, or captured by enemies, hunted by lions and tigers, or by wild elephants in the forest,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.26

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: राज्ञा क्रुद्धेन चाज्ञप्तो वध्यो बन्धगतोऽपि वा। आघूर्णितो वा वातेन स्थितः पोते महार्णवे॥
docs.text: condemned to death by an angry king, or lying in chains; or tossed by the gale on a ship on the great ocean,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पतत्सु चापि शस्त्रेषु संग्रामे भृशदारुणे। सर्वाबाधासु घोरासु वेदनाभ्यर्दितोऽपि वा॥
docs.text: when weapons rain down in a fearful battle, in every dire calamity, or racked with pain —
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स्मरन्ममैतच्चरितं नरो मुच्येत संकटात्। मम प्रभावात्सिंहाद्या दस्यवो वैरिणस्तथा॥
docs.text: whoever remembers this story of mine is set free from peril. By my power, lions and other wild beasts, robbers and enemies
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: दूरादेव पलायन्ते स्मरतश्चरितं मम॥
docs.text: flee far from anyone who remembers my story.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.30

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: इत्युक्त्वा सा भगवती चण्डिका चण्डविक्रमा॥
docs.text: Having spoken thus, the Blessed Caṇḍikā, fierce in her valour,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.32

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: पश्यतामेव देवानां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। तेऽपि देवा निरातङ्काः स्वाधिकारान् यथा पुरा॥
docs.text: vanished then and there before the very eyes of the gods. And the gods, their dread gone, took up their own offices as of old,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.33

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यज्ञभागभुजः सर्वे चक्रुर्विनिहतारयः। दैत्याश्च देव्या निहते शुम्भे देवरिपौ युधि॥
docs.text: all of them, their enemies destroyed, once more receiving their portions of the sacrifice. And when Śumbha, the gods’ enemy, had been slain by the Devī in battle,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.34

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: जगद्विध्वंसिनि तस्मिन् महोग्रेऽतुलविक्रमे। निशुम्भे च महावीर्ये शेषाः पातालमाययुः॥
docs.text: he, the world’s destroyer, fierce beyond measure and matchless in valour, and mighty Niśumbha too, the Daityas who were left went down to Pātāla.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.35

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एवं भगवती देवी सा नित्यापि पुनः पुनः। सम्भूय कुरुते भूप जगतः परिपालनम्॥
docs.text: In this way, O king, the Blessed Goddess, though she is eternal, comes forth again and again to protect the world.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.36

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तयैतन्मोह्यते विश्वं सैव विश्वं प्रसूयते। सा याचिता च विज्ञानं तुष्टा ऋद्धिं प्रयच्छति॥
docs.text: By her this universe is held in delusion, and she herself gives birth to it. Entreated, she grants knowledge; pleased, she grants prosperity.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.37

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
