tags: व्याप्तं तयैतत्सकलं ब्रह्माण्डं मनुजेश्वर। महाकाल्या महाकाले महामारीस्वरूपया॥
docs.text: O lord of men, this whole universe is pervaded by her — by Mahākālī, who at the great time of dissolution takes the form of Mahāmārī, the great destroyer.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.38

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सैव काले महामारी सैव सृष्टिर्भवत्यजा। स्थितिं करोति भूतानां सैव काले सनातनी॥
docs.text: She alone, when the time comes, is Mahāmārī, the great destroyer; she, the unborn, becomes creation; she, the eternal, sustains all beings in their time.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.39

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: भवकाले नृणां सैव लक्ष्मीर्वृद्धिप्रदा गृहे। सैवाभावे तथाऽलक्ष्मीर्विनाशायोपजायते॥
docs.text: In good times she is Lakṣmī in people’s homes, bringing increase; in times of decline she herself arises as Alakṣmī, bringing ruin.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.40

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स्तुता सम्पूजिता पुष्पैर्धूपगन्धादिभिस्तथा। ददाति वित्तं पुत्रांश्च मतिं धर्मे गतिं शुभाम्॥
docs.text: Praised and worshipped with flowers, incense, perfume and the like, she gives wealth and children, a mind set on dharma, and a blessed destiny.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 12.41

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: एतत्ते कथितं भूप देवीमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्। एवंप्रभावा सा देवी ययेदं धार्यते जगत्॥
docs.text: I have told you, O king, this supreme account of the Goddess’s greatness. Such is the power of the Goddess by whom this world is sustained.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: विद्या तथैव क्रियते भगवद्विष्णुमायया। तया त्वमेष वैश्यश्च तथैवान्ये विवेकिनः॥
docs.text: And knowledge, too, is wrought by the same Māyā of the Lord Viṣṇu. By her you and this merchant, and other discerning men as well,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मोह्यन्ते मोहिताश्चैव मोहमेष्यन्ति चापरे। तामुपैहि महाराज शरणं परमेश्वरीम्॥
docs.text: are deluded now; others have been deluded, and others yet will fall into delusion. Take refuge, great king, in her, the supreme Sovereign.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: आराधिता सैव नृणां भोगस्वर्गापवर्गदा॥
docs.text: Worshipped, she alone grants to men enjoyment, heaven and final liberation.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुरथः स नराधिपः॥
docs.text: When Suratha, lord of men, had heard the seer’s words,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: प्रणिपत्य महाभागं तमृषिं शंसितव्रतम्। निर्विण्णोऽतिममत्वेन राज्यापहरणेन च॥
docs.text: bowed low before that illustrious seer, so steadfast in his vows. Sick at heart from his own clinging and from the loss of his kingdom,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: जगाम सद्यस्तपसे स च वैश्यो महामुने। संदर्शनार्थमम्बाया नदीपुलिनसंस्थितः॥
docs.text: he went at once to practise austerity, great sage, and the merchant with him. To behold the Mother, they settled on the sandy bank of a river.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स च वैश्यस्तपस्तेपे देवीसूक्तं परं जपन्। तौ तस्मिन् पुलिने देव्याः कृत्वा मूर्तिं महीमयीम्॥
docs.text: There the king and the merchant practised austerities, chanting the supreme hymn to the Goddess. On that sandbank they shaped an image of the Goddess out of clay,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: अर्हणां चक्रतुस्तस्याः पुष्पधूपाग्नितर्पणैः। निराहारौ यताहारौ तन्मनस्कौ समाहितौ॥
docs.text: and worshipped her with flowers, incense, fire-offerings and libations of water — fasting, or eating little, their minds on her alone, wholly collected.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ददतुस्तौ बलिं चैव निजगात्रासृगुक्षितम्। एवं समाराधयतोस्त्रिभिर्वर्षैर्यतात्मनोः॥
docs.text: They offered, too, an oblation moistened with blood from their own bodies. When they had worshipped thus with self-restraint for three years,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: परितुष्टा जगद्धात्री प्रत्यक्षं प्राह चण्डिका॥
docs.text: Caṇḍikā, mother and sustainer of the world, well pleased, appeared before them and spoke.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: यत्प्रार्थ्यते त्वया भूप त्वया च कुलनन्दन। मत्तस्तत्प्राप्यतां सर्वं परितुष्टा ददामि तत्॥
docs.text: Whatever you ask, O king, and you, joy of your house — receive it all from me. I am well pleased; I grant it.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: ततो वव्रे नृपो राज्यमविभ्रंश्यन्यजन्मनि। अत्रैव च निजं राज्यं हतशत्रुबलं बलात्॥
docs.text: Then the king chose a kingdom that would never be lost, in another life — and, in this very life, his own kingdom back, his enemies’ power broken by force.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सोऽपि वैश्यस्ततो ज्ञानं वव्रे निर्विण्णमानसः। ममेत्यहमिति प्राज्ञः सङ्गविच्युतिकारकम्॥
docs.text: The merchant, his heart turned from the world, wisely chose knowledge — the knowledge that frees one from the attachment of ‘mine’ and ‘I’.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: स्वल्पैरहोभिर्नृपते स्वं राज्यं प्राप्स्यते भवान्॥
docs.text: Within a few days, O king, you will regain your own kingdom.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.20

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: हत्वा रिपूनस्खलितं तव तत्र भविष्यति॥
docs.text: You will slay your enemies, and your rule there will stand unshaken.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.21

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: मृतश्च भूयः सम्प्राप्य जन्म देवाद्विवस्वतः॥
docs.text: And when you have died, you will be born again of the Sun-god Vivasvat,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.22

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सावर्णिको नाम मनुर्भवान् भुवि भविष्यति॥
docs.text: and you will be the Manu on earth, named Sāvarṇi.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.23

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: वैश्यवर्य त्वया यश्च वरोऽस्मत्तोऽभिवाञ्छितः॥
docs.text: And you, best of merchants — the boon you have sought from me,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.24

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: तं प्रयच्छामि संसिद्ध्यै तव ज्ञानं भविष्यति॥
docs.text: I grant it. You shall have knowledge, for your final fulfilment.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.25

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: इति दत्त्वा तयोर्देवी यथाभिलषितं वरम्॥
docs.text: Having granted each of them the boon he desired, the Goddess
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.27

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: बभूवान्तर्हिता सद्यो भक्त्या ताभ्यामभिष्टुता। एवं देव्या वरं लब्ध्वा सुरथः क्षत्रियर्षभः॥
docs.text: vanished at once, as the two praised her with devotion. So Suratha, foremost of warriors, having received the Goddess’s boon,
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.28

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Devī Māhātmyam
tags: सूर्याज्जन्म समासाद्य सावर्णिर्भविता मनुः॥
docs.text: will be born of the Sun and become Sāvarṇi, the Manu.
docs.title: Devī Māhātmyam 13.29

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमस्ते रुद्र मन्यव उतो त इषवे नमः । नमस्ते अस्तु धन्वने बाहुभ्यामुत ते नमः ।
docs.text: O Rudra, homage to your wrath, and homage to your arrow; homage to your bow, and homage to your two arms.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: या त इषुश्शिवतमा शिवम्बभूव ते धनुः । शिवा शरव्या या तव तया नो रुद्र मृडय ।
docs.text: O Rudra, with your arrow made most kindly, your bow made kindly and your quiver made kindly, be gracious to us.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: या ते रुद्र शिवा तनूरघोरापापकाशिनी । तया नस्तनुवा शन्तमया गिरिशन्ताभि चाकशीहि ।
docs.text: O Rudra, your kindly body, not dreadful, showing no evil — with that most gracious body, Giriśanta, look upon us.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: यामिषुङ्गिरिशन्त हस्ते बिभर्ष्यस्तवे । शिवाङ्गिरित्र ताङ्कुरु मा हिँसीᳶ पुरुषञ्जगत् ।
docs.text: Giriśanta, the arrow you hold in your hand to shoot — make it kindly, protector of the mountain; harm neither man nor anything that moves.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: शिवेन वचसा त्वा गिरिशाच्छा वदामसि । यथा नस्सर्वमिज्जगदयक्ष्मँ सुमना असत् ।
docs.text: Giriśa, we call to you with words of good omen, that all our world may be free from sickness and glad at heart.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: अध्यवोचदधिवक्ता प्रथमो दैव्यो भिषक् । अहीँश्च सर्वाञ्जम्भयन्त्सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः ।
docs.text: He has spoken for us, the advocate, the first, the divine healer, crushing every snake and every sorceress.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: असौ यस्ताम्रो अरुण उत बभ्रुस्सुमङ्गलः । ये चेमाँ रुद्रा अभितो दिक्षु श्रितास्सहस्रशोऽवैषाँ हेड ईमहे ।
docs.text: He who is copper-red, ruddy and tawny, wholly auspicious, and the Rudras who abide in their thousands in every quarter around this earth — we pray their anger away.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: असौ योऽवसर्पति नीलग्रीवो विलोहितः । उतैनङ्गोपा अदृशन्नदृशन्नुदहार्यः । उतैनव्ँविश्वा भूतानि स दृष्टो मृडयाति नः ।
docs.text: He who glides down, blue-necked and deep red — the cowherds have seen him, the women carrying water have seen him, all creatures have seen him: seen, may he be gracious to us.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो अस्तु नीलग्रीवाय सहस्राक्षाय मीढुषे । अथो ये अस्य सत्वानोऽहन्तेभ्योऽकरन्नमः ।
docs.text: Homage to the blue-necked one, the thousand-eyed, the bountiful; and to his followers too I have paid homage.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: प्र मुञ्च धन्वनस्त्वमुभयोरार्त्नियोर्ज्याम् । याश्च ते हस्त इषवः परा ता भगवो वप ।
docs.text: Loosen the string at both ends of your bow, and the arrows in your hand, Lord, cast them away.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: अवतत्य धनुस्त्वँ सहस्राक्ष शतेषुधे । निशीर्य शल्यानाम्मुखा शिवो नस्सुमना भव ।
docs.text: Unstring your bow, thousand-eyed one with a hundred quivers; break off the points of your arrowheads, and be kind and gracious to us.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: विज्यन्धनुᳵ कपर्दिनो विशल्यो बाणवाँ उत । अनेशन्नस्येषव आभुरस्य निषङ्गथिः ।
docs.text: Stringless the bow of the one with braided hair, and his quiver without arrowheads; his arrows are gone, his sheath is empty.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: या ते हेतिर्मीढुष्टम हस्ते बभूव ते धनुः । तयास्मान्‌विश्वतस्त्वमयक्ष्मया परि ब्भुज ।
docs.text: Most bountiful one, with the weapon that is yours and the bow that has been in your hand, made harmless, shelter us on every side.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमस्ते अस्त्वायुधायानातताय धृष्णवे । उभाभ्यामुत ते नमो बाहुभ्यान्तव धन्वने ।
docs.text: Homage to your weapon, bold though not drawn; homage to both your arms, and to your bow.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: परि ते धन्वनो हेतिरस्मान्वृणक्तु विश्वतः । अथो य इषुधिस्तवारे अस्मन्नि धेहि तम् ॥
docs.text: May the missile of your bow pass us by on every side, and the quiver that is yours, lay it down far from us.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 1.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो हिरण्यबाहवे सेनान्ये दिशाञ्च पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the golden-armed leader of armies; homage to the lord of the quarters.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो वृक्षेभ्यो हरिकेशेभ्यᳶ पशूनाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the trees with their green hair; homage to the lord of the animals.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमस्सस्पिञ्जराय त्विषीमते पथीनाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the radiant one, tawny as young grass; homage to the lord of the paths.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो बभ्लुशाय विव्याधिनेऽन्नानाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to him who rides the bull and pierces through; homage to the lord of foods.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो हरिकेशायोपवीतिने पुष्टानाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the dark-haired one who wears the sacred cord; homage to the lord of those who thrive.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो भवस्य हेत्यै जगताम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the weapon of Bhava; homage to the lord of all that moves.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो रुद्रायातताविने क्षेत्राणाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to Rudra, who guards with his bow drawn; homage to the lord of the fields.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमस्सूतायाहन्त्याय वनानाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the charioteer whom none can slay; homage to the lord of the forests.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमः रोहिताय स्थपतये वृक्षाणाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the red one, the chief; homage to the lord of the trees.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो मन्त्रिणे वाणिजाय कक्षाणाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the counsellor and the merchant; homage to the lord of the thickets.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो भुवन्तये वारिवस्कृतायौषधीनाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to him who spreads out the earth and bestows wealth; homage to the lord of the plants.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम उच्चैर्घोषायाक्रन्दयते पत्तीनाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the loud-crying one who makes his enemies weep; homage to the lord of the foot-soldiers.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमᳵ कृत्स्नवीताय धावते सत्वनाम्पतये नमः ॥
docs.text: Homage to him who encircles the whole army and runs in pursuit; homage to the lord of the warriors.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 2.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमस्सहमानाय निव्याधिन आव्याधिनीनाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the victorious one who pierces; homage to the lord of the bands that attack.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमᳵ ककुभाय निषङ्गिणे स्तेनानाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the chief who bears a sword; homage to the lord of thieves.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो निषङ्गिण इषुधिमते तस्कराणाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to him who holds an arrow in his hand and a quiver on his back; homage to the lord of robbers.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो वञ्चते परिवञ्चते स्तायूनाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the sly one who prowls around; homage to the lord of thieves.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो निचेरवे परिचरायारण्यानाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the one who creeps about the house and the one who roams the streets; homage to the lord of the forest robbers.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमस्सृकाविभ्यो जिघाँसद्भ्यो मुष्णताम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to those armed with the spear and bent on killing; homage to the lord of those who steal.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमोऽसिमद्भ्यो नक्तञ्चरद्भ्यᳶ प्रकृन्तानाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the sword-bearers who roam by night; homage to the lord of those who kill and rob.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम उष्णीषिणे गिरिचराय कुलुञ्चानाम्पतये नमो
docs.text: Homage to the turbaned one who roams the hills; homage to the lord of those who seize land.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमः इषुमद्भ्यो धन्वाविभ्यश्च वो नमो
docs.text: Homage to you who bear arrows, and to you who bear bows, homage.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम आतन्वानेभ्यᳶ प्रतिदधानेभ्यश्च वो नमो
docs.text: Homage to you who string the bow, and to you who set the arrow to it, homage.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम आयच्छद्भ्यो विसृजद्भ्यश्च वो नमो
docs.text: Homage to you who draw the bow, and to you who loose the arrow, homage.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमोऽस्यद्भ्यो विध्यद्भ्यश्च वो नमो
docs.text: Homage to you who shoot, and to you who pierce, homage.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम आसीनेभ्यश्शयानेभ्यश्च वो नमो
docs.text: Homage to you who sit, and to you who lie down, homage.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 3.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमस्स्वपद्भ्यो जाग्रद्भ्यश्च वो नमो
docs.text: Homage to you who sleep, and to you who wake, homage.

tags: नमो ह्रदय्याय च निवेष्प्याय च
docs.text: Homage to him in the deep pool, and to him in the dew of the mist.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमᳶ पाँसव्याय च रजस्याय च
docs.text: Homage to him in the fine dust, and to him in the dust that rises.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमश्शुष्क्याय च हरित्याय च
docs.text: Homage to him in what is dry, and to him in what is green.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो लोप्याय चोलप्याय च
docs.text: Homage to him on the bare, hard ground, and to him in the soft grass.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम ऊर्व्याय च सूर्म्याय च
docs.text: Homage to him on the wide earth, and to him in the rippling river.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमᳶ पर्ण्याय च पर्णशद्याय च
docs.text: Homage to him in the leaves, and to him in the fallen leaves.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमोऽपगुरमाणाय चाभिघ्नते च
docs.text: Homage to him who lifts his weapon, and to him who strikes.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.13

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम आक्खिदते च प्रक्खिदते च
docs.text: Homage to him who troubles a little, and to him who troubles greatly.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.14

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो वᳵ किरिकेभ्यो देवानाँ हृदयेभ्यो
docs.text: Homage to you who scatter gifts, the hearts of the gods.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.15

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो विक्षीणकेभ्यो
docs.text: Homage to those who never waste away.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.16

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो विचिन्वत्केभ्यो
docs.text: Homage to those who search out what is sought.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.17

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम आनिर्हतेभ्यो
docs.text: Homage to those who strike out all wrong.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.18

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नम आमीवत्केभ्यः ॥
docs.text: Homage to those who grow great on every side.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 9.19

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: द्रापे अन्धसस्पते दरिद्रन्नीललोहित । एषाम्पुरुषाणामेषाम्पशूनाम्मा भेर्मारो मो एषाङ्किञ्चनाममत् ।
docs.text: O Drāpi, lord of food, you who own nothing, blue and red: do not frighten these our people and these our cattle, let none of them perish, and let none of them fall sick.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: या ते रुद्र शिवा तनूश्शिवा विश्वाहभेषजी । शिवा रुद्रस्य भेषजी तया नो मृड जीवसे ।
docs.text: O Rudra, with that kindly body of yours, kindly and healing at all times, the kindly healing form of Rudra, be gracious to us, that we may live.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: इमाँ रुद्राय तवसे कपर्दिने क्षयद्वीराय प्र भरामहे मतिम् । यथा नश्शमसद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे विश्वम्पुष्टङ्ग्रामे अस्मिन्न् अनातुरम् ।
docs.text: To Rudra, the mighty, with braided hair, who rules over heroes, we offer this prayer, that our people and our cattle may be well, and all in this village thrive, free from sickness.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: मृडा नो रुद्रोत नो मयस्कृधि क्षयद्वीराय नमसा विधेम ते । यच्छञ्च योश्च मनुरायजे पिता तदश्याम तव रुद्र प्रणीतौ ।
docs.text: Be gracious to us, O Rudra, and give us joy; we would worship you, ruler of heroes, with homage. The welfare and health that father Manu won by sacrifice — may we attain them, O Rudra, under your guidance.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: मा नो महान्तमुत मा नो अर्भकम्मा न उक्षन्तमुत मा न उक्षितम् । मा नो वधीᳶ पितरम्मोत मातरम्प्रिया मा नस्तनुवः रुद्र रीरिषः ।
docs.text: Do not harm our elders or our little ones, the young man who begets or the child yet unborn; do not slay our father or our mother; do not harm, O Rudra, our dear bodies.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: मा नस्तोके तनये मा न आयुषि मा नो गोषु मा नो अश्वेषु रीरिषः । वीरान्मा नो रुद्र भामितो वधीर्हविष्मन्तो नमसा विधेम ते ।
docs.text: Do not harm us in our children or our sons, in our life, our cattle or our horses; do not, O Rudra, in anger slay our men. With oblations we would worship you with homage.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: आरात्ते गोघ्न उत पूरुषघ्ने क्षयद्वीराय सुम्नमस्मे ते अस्तु । रक्षा च नो अधि च देव ब्रूह्यधा च नश्शर्म यच्छ द्विबर्हाः ।
docs.text: Far from us be your form that slays cattle and men, O ruler of heroes; let your kindness be with us. Protect us, O god, speak for us, and give us shelter, you who are doubly strong.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: स्तुहि श्रुतङ्गर्तसदय्ँयुवानम्मृगन्न भीममुपहत्नुमुग्रम् । मृडा जरित्रे रुद्र स्तवानो अन्यन्ते अस्मन्नि वपन्तु सेनाः ।
docs.text: Praise the renowned one, seated on his chariot, the young, fearsome as a wild beast, the fierce destroyer. Praised by us, O Rudra, be gracious to the one who sings to you; let your hosts strike down another, not us.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: परि णो रुद्रस्य हेतिर्वृणक्तु परि त्वेषस्य दुर्मतिरघायोः । अव स्थिरा मघवद्भ्यस्तनुष्व मीढ्वस्तोकाय तनयाय मृडय ।
docs.text: May Rudra’s weapon pass us by, and the ill-will of the fierce one bent on harm. Unstring your firm bows, away from those who give to you; O bountiful one, be gracious to our children and their children.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: मीढुष्टम शिवतम शिवो नस्सुमना भव । परमे वृक्ष आयुधन्निधाय कृत्तिव्ँवसान आ चर पिनाकम् बिभ्रदा गहि ।
docs.text: Most bountiful, most kindly one, be kind and gracious to us. Lay your weapon on the highest tree and come, wearing your hide; come carrying the Pināka.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: विकिरिद विलोहित नमस्ते अस्तु भगवः । यास्ते सहस्रँ हेतयोऽन्यमस्मन्नि वपन्तु ताः ।
docs.text: O Vikirida, deep-red one, homage to you, O Lord. Let your thousand weapons strike down another, not us.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: सहस्राणि सहस्रधा बाहुवोस्तव हेतयः । तासामीशानो भगवᳶ पराचीना मुखा कृधि ॥
docs.text: Thousands of weapons, of a thousand kinds, are in your arms; you who are their master, O Lord, turn their points away.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 10.12

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: सहस्राणि सहस्रशो ये रुद्रा अधि भूम्याम् । तेषाँ सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ।
docs.text: Of the Rudras who are upon the earth, thousands upon thousands, we unstring the bows a thousand yojanas away.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: अस्मिन्महत्यर्णवेऽन्तरिक्षे भवा अधि ।
docs.text: The Bhavas who dwell in this great flood, the atmosphere: [their bows we unstring, a thousand yojanas away].
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नीलग्रीवाश्शितिकण्ठाश्शर्वा अधः क्षमाचराः ।
docs.text: The blue-necked, white-throated Śarvas who roam beneath the earth: [their bows we unstring, a thousand yojanas away].
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नीलग्रीवाश्शितिकण्ठा दिवँ रुद्रा उपश्रिताः ।
docs.text: The blue-necked, white-throated Rudras who dwell in heaven: [their bows we unstring, a thousand yojanas away].
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: ये वृक्षेषु सस्पिञ्जरा नीलग्रीवा विलोहिताः ।
docs.text: Those in the trees, tawny like young grass, blue-necked and deep-red: [their bows we unstring, a thousand yojanas away].
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: ये भूतानामधिपतयो विशिखासᳵ कपर्दिनः ।
docs.text: The lords of the spirits, shaven-headed and with braided hair: [their bows we unstring, a thousand yojanas away].
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: ये अन्नेषु विविध्यन्ति पात्रेषु पिबतो जनान् ।
docs.text: Those who wound people in their food, and in their cups as they drink: [their bows we unstring, a thousand yojanas away].
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.7

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: ये पथाम्पथिरक्षय ऐलबृदा यव्युधः ।
docs.text: The guardians of every road, who bring food and are eager to fight: [their bows we unstring, a thousand yojanas away].
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.8

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: ये तीर्थानि प्रचरन्ति सृकावन्तो निषङ्गिणः ।
docs.text: Those who go about the sacred fords, armed with spears and quivers: [their bows we unstring, a thousand yojanas away].
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.9

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: य एतावन्तश्च भूयाँसश्च दिशो रुद्रा वितस्थिरे । तेषाँ सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि ।
docs.text: Of the Rudras, as many as these and more, who have spread through all the quarters, we unstring the bows a thousand yojanas away.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.10

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Namakam
tags: नमो रुद्रेभ्यो ये पृथिव्याय्ँयेऽन्तरिक्षे ये दिवि येषामन्नव्ँवातो वर्षमिषवस्तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर्दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर्दशोदीचीर्दशोर्ध्वास्तेभ्यो नमस्ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यन्द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तव्ँवो जम्भे दधामि ॥
docs.text: Homage to the Rudras who are on the earth, in the atmosphere and in heaven, whose arrows are food, wind and rain. To them, ten [fingers] to the east, ten to the south, ten to the west, ten to the north, ten upward; to them, homage. May they be gracious to us. The one we hate and the one who hates us — him I place in your jaws.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Namakam 11.11

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: अग्नाविष्णू सजोषसेमा वर्धन्तु वाङ्गिरः । द्युम्नैर्वाजेभिरागतम् ।
docs.text: Agni and Viṣṇu, be of one accord. May these songs to you grow strong. Come to us with splendour and with strength.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 1.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: वाजश्च मे प्रसवश्च मे प्रयतिश्च मे प्रसितिश्च मे धीतिश्च मे क्रतुश्च मे स्वरश्च मे श्लोकश्च मे श्रावश्च मे श्रुतिश्च मे
docs.text: May food be mine, and the impulse to act, and effort, and its continuance; may thought be mine, and resolve, and voice, and the hymn, and the power to hear and what is heard.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 1.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: ज्योतिश्च मे सुवश्च मे प्राणश्च मेऽपानः च मे व्यानश्च मेऽसुश्च मे
docs.text: May light be mine, and heaven; may the breaths be mine, prāṇa, apāna and vyāna, and life itself.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 1.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: चित्तञ्च म आधीतञ्च मे वाक्च मे मनश्च मे चक्षुश्च मे श्रोत्रञ्च मे
docs.text: May thought be mine, and what thought dwells on; may speech be mine, and mind, and sight, and hearing.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 1.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: दक्षश्च मे बलञ्च म ओजश्च मे सहश्च म आयुश्च मे जरा च म
docs.text: May skill be mine, and strength, and vigour, and the power to prevail; may life be mine, and old age.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 1.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: आत्मा च मे तनूश्च मे शर्म च मे वर्म च मेऽङ्गानि च मेऽस्थानि च मे परूँषि च मे शरीराणि च मे ॥
docs.text: May the self be mine, and the body; shelter and armour; the limbs, the bones, the joints, and every part of the body.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 1.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: ज्यैष्ठ्यञ्च म आधिपत्यञ्च मे मन्युश्च मे भामश्च मेऽमश्च मेऽम्भश्च मे
docs.text: May pre-eminence be mine, and lordship; may spirit be mine, and wrath, and force; and water.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 2.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: जेमा च मे महिमा च मे वरिमा च मे प्रथिमा च मे वर्ष्मा च मे द्राघुया च मे वृद्धञ्च मे वृद्धिश्च मे
docs.text: May victory be mine, and greatness, breadth and extent, height and length; may increase be mine, and growth.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 2.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: सत्यञ्च मे श्रद्धा च मे जगच्च मे धनञ्च मे वशश्च मे त्विषिश्च मे क्रीडा च मे मोदश्च मे
docs.text: May truth be mine, and faith; the living world, and wealth, and mastery; may brightness be mine, and play, and joy.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 2.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: जातञ्च मे जनिष्यमाणञ्च मे सूक्तञ्च मे सुकृतञ्च मे वित्तञ्च मे वेद्यञ्च मे भूतञ्च मे भविष्यच्च मे
docs.text: May what is born be mine, and what is yet to be born; the hymn and the good deed; what I have gained and what I am yet to gain; what has been and what will be.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 2.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: सुगञ्च मे सुपथञ्च म ऋद्धञ्च म ऋद्धिश्च मे कॢप्तञ्च मे कॢप्तिश्च मे मतिश्च मे सुमतिश्च मे ॥
docs.text: May an easy way be mine, and a good road; what has prospered, and prosperity; what is ready, and the power to make ready; may understanding be mine, and sound judgement.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 2.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: शञ्च मे मयश्च मे प्रियञ्च मेऽनुकामश्च मे कामश्च मे सौमनसश्च मे
docs.text: May welfare be mine, and delight; what is dear and what is wished for; the object of desire, and a mind at ease.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 3.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: भद्रञ्च मे श्रेयश्च मे वस्यश्च मे यशश्च मे भगश्च मे द्रविणञ्च मे
docs.text: May good fortune be mine, and what is better still; may welfare be mine, and fame, and fortune, and wealth.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 3.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: यन्ता च मे धर्ता च मे क्षेमश्च मे धृतिश्च मे विश्वञ्च मे महश्च मे
docs.text: May I have one to guide me and one to sustain me; may security be mine, and steadiness; may all be mine, and honour.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 3.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: सव्ँविच्च मे ज्ञात्रञ्च मे सूश्च मे प्रसूश्च मे सीरञ्च मे लयश्च म
docs.text: May knowledge be mine, and the power to know; the power to set others to work, and to direct them; the plough, and freedom from what hinders it.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 3.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: ऋतञ्च मेऽमृतञ्च मेऽयक्ष्मञ्च मेऽनामयच्च मे जीवातुश्च मे दीर्घायुत्वञ्च मेऽनमित्रञ्च मेऽभयञ्च मे
docs.text: May the rite be mine, and its undying fruit; may I be free of grave disease and of lesser sickness; may I have the means of life, and long life; may I be without enemies and without fear.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 3.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: सुगञ्च मे शयनञ्च मे सूषा च मे सुदिनञ्च मे ॥
docs.text: May my going be good, and my rest; may the dawn be fair for me, and the day.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 3.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: ऊर्क्च मे सूनृता च मे पयश्च मे रसश्च मे घृतञ्च मे मधु च मे
docs.text: May nourishment be mine, and kindly speech, milk and its essence, ghee and honey.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 4.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: सग्धिश्च मे सपीतिश्च मे कृषिश्च मे वृष्टिश्च मे जैत्रञ्च म औद्भिद्यञ्च मे
docs.text: May meals eaten together be mine, and drink shared, ploughing and rain, a fruitful field, and the springing up of plants.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 4.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: रयिश्च मे रायश्च मे पुष्टञ्च मे पुष्टिश्च मे विभु च मे प्रभु च मे बहु च मे भूयश्च मे
docs.text: May wealth be mine, and riches, abundance and nourishment; the ample, the abundant, much and more.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 4.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: पूर्णञ्च मे पूर्णतरञ्च मेऽक्षितिश्च मे कूयवाश्च मेऽन्नञ्च मेऽक्षुच्च मे
docs.text: May I have fullness, and greater fullness, and what does not run out; poor grain too, and food, and freedom from hunger.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 4.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: व्रीहयश्च मे यवाश्च मे माषाश्च मे तिलाश्च मे मुद्गाश्च मे खल्वाश्च मे
docs.text: May rice be mine, and barley, beans, sesame, mung beans and khalva.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 4.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: गोधूमाश्च मे मसुराश्च मे प्रियङ्गवश्च मेऽणवश्च मे श्यामाकाश्च मे नीवाराश्च मे ॥
docs.text: May wheat be mine, and lentils, millet, fine rice, śyāmāka, and wild rice.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 4.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: अश्मा च मे मृत्तिका च मे गिरयश्च मे पर्वताश्च मे सिकताश्च मे वनस्पतयश्च मे
docs.text: May stone be mine, and clay, hills and mountains, sand, and the trees of the forest.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 5.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: हिरण्यञ्च मेऽयश्च मे सीसञ्च मे त्रपुश्च मे श्यामञ्च मे लोहञ्च मेऽग्निश्च म
docs.text: May gold be mine, and metal, lead and tin, black iron, copper and bronze, and fire.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 5.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: आपश्च मे वीरुधश्च म ओषधयश्च मे कृष्टपच्यञ्च मेऽकृष्टपच्यञ्च मे
docs.text: May the waters be mine, and plants and herbs, the crops of ploughed land and what grows unploughed.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 5.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: ग्राम्याश्च मे पशव आरण्याश्च यज्ञेन कल्पन्ताव्ँ
docs.text: May the animals of the village and of the forest be mine, made fit through the sacrifice.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 5.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: वित्तञ्च मे वित्तिश्च मे भूतञ्च मे भूतिश्च मे वसु च मे वसतिश्च मे
docs.text: May wealth be mine, and gain to come; what has come to be and prosperity, goods and a dwelling.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 5.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: कर्म च मे शक्तिश्च मेऽर्थश्च म एमश्च म इतिश्च मे गतिश्च मे ॥
docs.text: May the rite be mine, and the power to perform it; my aim, the goal I move toward, the going, and the reaching.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 5.6

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: अग्निश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे सोमश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे सविता च म इन्द्रश्च मे सरस्वती च म इन्द्रश्च मे
docs.text: May there be for me Agni and Indra, Soma and Indra, Savitṛ and Indra, Sarasvatī and Indra.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 6.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: पूषा च म इन्द्रश्च मे बृहस्पतिश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे मित्रश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे वरुणश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे
docs.text: May there be for me Pūṣan and Indra, Bṛhaspati and Indra, Mitra and Indra, Varuṇa and Indra.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 6.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: त्वष्टा च म इन्द्रश्च मे धाता च म इन्द्रश्च मे विष्णुश्च म इन्द्रश्च मेऽश्विनौ च म इन्द्रश्च मे
docs.text: May there be for me Tvaṣṭṛ and Indra, Dhātṛ and Indra, Viṣṇu and Indra, the Aśvins and Indra.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 6.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: मरुतश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे विश्वे च मे देवा इन्द्रश्च मे पृथिवी च म इन्द्रश्च मेऽन्तरिक्षञ्च म इन्द्रश्च मे
docs.text: May there be for me the Maruts and Indra, the All-gods and Indra, the earth and Indra, the atmosphere and Indra.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 6.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: द्यौश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे दिशश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे मूर्धा च म इन्द्रश्च मे प्रजापतिश्च म इन्द्रश्च मे ॥
docs.text: May there be for me the sky and Indra, the quarters and Indra, the zenith and Indra, Prajāpati and Indra.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 6.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: अँशुश्च मे रश्मिश्च मेऽदाभ्यश्च मेऽधिपतिश्च म उपाँशुश्च मेऽन्तर्यामश्च म
docs.text: May the aṃśu cup be mine, and the raśmi, the adābhya, the overlord, the upāṃśu and the antaryāma.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 7.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: ऐन्द्रवायवश्च मे मैत्रावरुणश्च म आश्विनश्च मे प्रतिप्रस्थानश्च मे शुक्रश्च मे मन्थी च म
docs.text: May the cup for Indra and Vāyu be mine, and the cup for Mitra and Varuṇa, the cup for the Aśvins, the pratiprasthāna, the śukra and the manthin.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 7.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: आग्रयणश्च मे वैश्वदेवश्च मे ध्रुवश्च मे वैश्वानरश्च म ऋतुग्रहाश्च मेऽतिग्राह्याश्च म
docs.text: May the āgrayaṇa cup be mine, and the cup for the All-gods, the dhruva, the vaiśvānara, the cups for the seasons and the atigrāhya cups.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 7.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: ऐन्द्राग्नश्च मे वैश्वदेवश्च मे मरुत्वतीयाश्च मे माहेन्द्रश्च म आदित्यश्च मे सावित्रश्च मे
docs.text: May the cup for Indra and Agni be mine, and the cup for the All-gods, the marutvatīya cups, the cup for the great Indra, the āditya cup and the cup for Savitṛ.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 7.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: सारस्वतश्च मे पौष्णश्च मे पात्नीवतश्च मे हारियोजनश्च मे ॥
docs.text: May the sārasvata cup be mine, and the cup for Pūṣan, the pātnīvata and the hāriyojana.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 7.5

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: इध्मश्च मे बर्हिश्च मे वेदिश्च मे धिष्णियाश्च मे स्रुचश्च मे चमसाश्च मे
docs.text: May the kindling-wood be mine, and the strewn grass, the altar, the side-hearths, the ladles and the Soma cups.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 8.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: ग्रावाणश्च मे स्वरवश्च म उपरवाश्च मेऽधिषवणे च मे द्रोणकलशश्च मे वायव्यानि च मे
docs.text: May the pressing-stones be mine, and the strips of the post, the sounding-holes, the two pressing-boards, the great wooden Soma vessel and the vessels for Vāyu.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 8.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: पूतभृच्च म आधवनीयश्च म आग्नीध्रञ्च मे हविर्धानञ्च मे गृहाश्च मे सदश्च मे
docs.text: May the vessel for the strained Soma be mine, and the vessel in which it is stirred, the Agnīdh’s place, the shed of the Soma carts, the halls and the assembly shed.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 8.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: पुरोडाशाश्च मे पचताश्च मेऽवभृथश्च मे स्वगाकारश्च मे ॥
docs.text: May the sacrificial cakes be mine, and the cooking-fires, the closing bath and the call svagā.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 8.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: अग्निश्च मे घर्मश्च मेऽर्कश्च मे सूर्यश्च मे प्राणश्च मेऽश्वमेधश्च मे
docs.text: May the fire be mine, and the gharma, the arka, the sun, the breath and the horse sacrifice.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 9.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: पृथिवी च मेऽदितिश्च मे दितिश्च मे द्यौश्च मे शक्वरीरङ्गुलयो दिशश्च मे यज्ञेन कल्पन्तामृक्च मे साम च मे स्तोमश्च मे यजुश्च मे
docs.text: May earth be mine, and Aditi, Diti and the sky; may the Śakvarīs, the fingers and the quarters be made fit by my sacrifice; may the ṛc be mine, and the sāman, the stoma and the yajus.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 9.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: दीक्षा च मे तपश्च म ऋतुश्च मे व्रतञ्च मेऽहोरात्रयोर्वृष्ट्या बृहद्रथन्तरे च मे यज्ञेन कल्पेताम् ॥
docs.text: May consecration be mine, and austerity, the season and the vow; by the rain of day and night [may my crop be ready]; and may the Bṛhat and the Rathantara be made fit by my sacrifice.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 9.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: गर्भाश्च मे वत्साश्च मे त्र्यविश्च मे त्र्यवी च मे दित्यवाट्च मे दित्यौही च मे
docs.text: May the unborn young be mine, and the calves; the bull and the heifer of a year and a half, and the bull and the heifer of two years.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 10.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: पञ्चाविश्च मे पञ्चावी च मे त्रिवत्सश्च मे त्रिवत्सा च मे तुर्यवाट्च मे तुर्यौही च मे
docs.text: May the bull and the heifer of two and a half years be mine, the bull and the heifer of three years, and the bull and the heifer of three and a half.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 10.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: पष्ठवाच्च मे पष्ठौही च म उक्षा च मे वशा च म ऋषभश्च मे वेहच्च मेऽनड्वाञ्च मे धेनुश्च म
docs.text: May the bull and the heifer of four years be mine; the bull of breeding age and the barren cow; the older bull and the cow that has miscarried; the draught ox and the cow newly in milk.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 10.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: आयुर्यज्ञेन कल्पताम्प्राणो यज्ञेन कल्पतामपानो यज्ञेन कल्पताव्ँव्यानो यज्ञेन कल्पताञ्चक्षुर्यज्ञेन कल्पताँ श्रोत्रय्ँ यज्ञेन कल्पताम्मनो यज्ञेन कल्पताव्ँवाग्यज्ञेन कल्पतामात्मा यज्ञेन कल्पताय्ँयज्ञो यज्ञेन कल्पताम् ॥
docs.text: Through the sacrifice may life be made fit; through the sacrifice the breath, the down-breath and the diffused breath; through the sacrifice the eye and the ear, the mind and speech; through the sacrifice the self; and through the sacrifice may the sacrifice itself be made fit.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 10.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: एका च मे तिस्रश्च मे पञ्च च मे सप्त च मे नव च म एकादश च मे त्रयोदश च मे पञ्चदश च मे सप्तदश च मे
docs.text: May one be mine, and three, five, seven and nine, eleven, thirteen, fifteen and seventeen.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 11.1

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: नवदश च म एकविँशतिश्च मे त्रयोविँशतिश्च मे पञ्चविँशतिश्च मे सप्तविँशतिश्च मे नवविँशतिश्च म एकत्रिँशच्च मे त्रयस्त्रिँशच्च मे
docs.text: May nineteen be mine, and twenty-one, twenty-three, twenty-five, twenty-seven and twenty-nine, thirty-one and thirty-three.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 11.2

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: चतस्रश्च मेऽष्टौ च मे द्वादश च मे षोडश च मे विँशतिश्च मे चतुर्विँशतिश्च मेऽष्टाविँशतिश्च मे
docs.text: May four be mine, and eight, twelve and sixteen, twenty, twenty-four and twenty-eight.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 11.3

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: द्वात्रिँशच्च मे षट्त्रिँशच्च मे चत्वारिँशच्च मे चतुश्चत्वारिँशच्च मेऽष्टाचत्वारिँशच्च मे
docs.text: May thirty-two be mine, and thirty-six, forty, forty-four and forty-eight.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 11.4

docs.subtitle: Sacred text · Chamakam
tags: वाजश्च प्रसवश्चापिजश्च क्रतुश्च सुवश्च मूर्धा च व्यश्ञियश्चान्त्यायनश्चान्त्यश्च भौवनश्च भुवनश्चाधिपतिश्च ॥
docs.text: May food be mine, and impulse, the later-born, resolve and heaven, the head, Vyaśniya, Āntyāyana and Āntya, Bhauvana and Bhuvana, and the overlord.
docs.title: Śrī Rudram, Chamakam 11.5
